Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出AuthBench——一个大规模多语言作者身份表示基准，包含428,150篇文档、153,825位作者、10种语言、9大类型、66种细粒度类型和4个长度区间。支持作者归属（同作者检索）和作者验证（同作者二分判断）两大任务。在统一零样本协议下评测47个神经模型和3个非神经基线，最佳检索模型Success@5仅0.258，最佳验证模型EER 0.076、ROC-AUC 0.968，揭示作者身份表示远未解决，且不同模型家族在两任务上表现分化，跨语言、类型、长度差异显著。AuthBench定位为基准兼诊断资源，已开源数据集、评测工具包与排行榜。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有作者身份基准碎片化严重：通常仅覆盖窄语言集、单一体裁或有限文档长度，难以评估现代表示是否真正泛化。亟需一个广泛、标准化且真实的大规模多语言基准，以系统诊断作者身份表示在何时、为何成功或失效。

Method: 构建AuthBench：收集428,150篇文档、153,825位作者，跨越10种广泛使用语言、9个主要体裁、66种细粒度体裁、4个文档长度桶。设计两个互补任务——作者归属（同作者检索）与作者验证（同作者二分判断）。在统一零样本协议下，基准测试47个神经网络模型及3个非神经基线。

Result: 最佳检索模型Success@5仅0.258；最佳验证模型EER 0.076、ROC-AUC 0.968。排行榜揭示显著任务分化：不同模型家族在检索与验证任务上各有优劣。跨语言、体裁、文档长度的性能差异巨大，表明作者身份表示泛化能力仍受限。

Conclusion: AuthBench不仅是新基准，更是研究作者身份表示何时、为何成功或失效的诊断性资源。结果表明该任务远未解决，需针对多语言、多体裁、多长度场景设计更鲁棒的表示方法。作者已开源数据集、评测工具包与基准数据。

Abstract: Authorship signals matter in settings where writing style carries identity: digital forensics, plagiarism analysis, account linking, misinformation investigation, and machine-generated text detection. Yet current authorship benchmarks remain fragmented, usually covering only a narrow language set, a single genre, or a limited document-length regime, which makes it difficult to assess whether modern representations truly generalize. We introduce AuthBench, a large-scale multilingual benchmark for authorship representation that is designed to make this evaluation broad, standardized, and realistic. AuthBench contains 428,150 documents written by 153,825 individuals across ten widely used languages, 9 primary genres, 66 fine-grained genres, and four document-length buckets. It supports two complementary tasks: authorship attribution, formulated as same-author retrieval and authorship verification, formulated as same-author binary decision. We benchmark 47 neural models and three non-neural baselines under a unified zero-shot protocol. Results show that authorship representation remains far from solved: the best retrieval model reaches only 0.258 Success@5, while the best verification model achieves 0.076 EER and 0.968 ROC-AUC. The leaderboard also reveals a meaningful task split, with different model families leading retrieval and verification, and large performance differences across languages, genres, and lengths.
  These findings position AuthBench not only as a new benchmark, but as a diagnostic resource for studying when and why authorship representations succeed or fail. We release AuthBench, its evaluation toolkit, and benchmark data at https://github.com/mao-code/AuthBench and https://huggingface.co/datasets/MaoXun/AuthBench.

</details>


### [61] [Typed Federated Artifacts for the Agentic Web:Sharing Tool-Routing Knowledge Across Frozen,Heterogeneous LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06815)
*Abhijit Chakraborty,Ni Trieu,Vivek Gupta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 SYNAPSE1：一种基于类型化联邦制品的工具路由知识共享框架，通过模式验证的结构化对象实现跨平台知识迁移、隐私保护与冲突解决。实验显示联邦汇编在 StableToolBench 上路由性能接近中心化基线（差距 1.1 分），类型化字段渲染较扁平文本提升 8.5/7.4 分。但在 τ-bench retail 上性能增益归因于格式而非联邦经验，且 TF-IDF 基线因基准数据泄露大幅超越所有 LLM 路由臂，揭示现有基准无法评估无标签工具路由能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放网络环境下，智能体需在保持历史隐私的前提下协作调用多供应商冻结模型。扁平文本（提示词、示例池）难以让协议区分噪声统计、合并规则与文档；权重与适配器无法跨平台迁移知识。因此需要一种可共享、可验证、支持字段级隐私与争议解决的结构化知识表示。

Method: 设计类型化联邦制品——带有明确字段定义的模式验证对象，支持字段级隐私、争议解决与跨模型迁移，并将其实例化为 SYNAPSE1 通用工具路由知识库。在 StableToolBench（3,180 工具）上清洗 192 条垃圾条目与 1,916 条重复测试查询后，以每轮 20 MB JSON/客户端的通信量进行联邦汇编实验；对比类型化合并与扁平渲染、三种冲突策略；在 τ-bench retail 评估 GPT-4o 逐步工具调用准确率；另用 TF-IDF 分类器作为检索基线对比。

Result: 联邦汇编路由性能仅比中心化基线低 1.1 分；类型化字段渲染在干净数据上提升 8.5 分、60% 矛盾注入下提升 7.4 分；合并与渲染不可分离（类型化合并扁平渲染最差），三种冲突策略无显著差异。τ-bench retail 上各联邦臂均提升 GPT-4o 逐步准确率 ≥6.7 分，但归因于格式而非联邦经验。警示性发现：TF-IDF 在数学代理与 StableToolBench 上分别以 48、26 分优势击败所有 LLM 路由臂，主因是基准池包含每个所谓未见工具的标注查询及逐字测试查询，导致无法衡量无标签工具路由能力。

Conclusion: 类型化联邦制品能有效支撑跨平台工具路由知识共享，结构化字段表示是性能提升关键，而非联邦学习本身。现有工具路由基准存在严重数据泄露，高估 LLM 路由能力且无法评估零样本工具路由；未来需构建无标签泄露的基准并探索真正联邦化的知识迁移机制。

Abstract: An open, networked web will allow agents to run frozen models from multiple vendors, keep their history private, and teach each other which tool to call and when. Flat text (prompts, example pools) makes it difficult for the protocol to distinguish between noise statistics, merging rules, and documentation. Weights and adapters cannot transfer that knowledge between platforms. We suggest sharing typed federated artifacts, schema-validated objects with well-defined fields for per-field privacy (described here, but measured), dispute resolution, and cross-model transfer, and instantiating them as SYNAPSE1, a common tool-routing knowledge. After deleting 192 garbage entries and 1,916 training items that duplicate or almost duplicate test queries, a federated compendium routes within 1.1 points of a centralized one at 20 MB of JSON per client each round on StableToolBench (3,180 tools). The same experience merged and shown to the router as typed fields rather than one flat string is worth 8.5 points on clean data and 7.4 under 60% injected contradiction. Crossing merge and rendering shows the halves are inseparable (the typed merge shown flat is the worst arm), while three conflict policies are indistinguishable, so the conflict log that motivated this work is not the On τ-bench retail, each compendium arm improves GPT-4o agents' per-step tool-call accuracy by at least 6.7 points, attributed to format rather than federated experience. Two cautionary findings conclude the paper: on a topic-labeled math proxy and StableToolBench, a TF-IDF classifier over the same labeled experience beats every LLM routing arm (by 48 and 26 points, mostly retrieval recall) because the benchmark's pool holds labeled queries for every supposedly unseen tool and every test query verbatim before our filter. It cannot measure routing to tools without labels, which routing exists for.

</details>


### [62] [XYBench: Can LLMs Respond Pragmatically to Queries with Misconceptions?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06842)
*Akhila Yerukola,Jena D. Hwang,Mingqian Zheng,Jenna Godsey,Hyunwoo Kim,Valentina Pyatkin,Jennifer Hu,Maarten Sap*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出XYBench基准测试，评估LLM处理XY问题（用户查询存在误解）的能力。实验表明即使最强LLM也倾向于字面回答（0.75-0.92），而非解决根本问题（0.33-0.71），且在识别误解上远落后于人类（63% vs 79-90%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非专家用户向LLM提问时常存在误解（即XY问题），LLM需识别误解并引导用户走向务实解决方案，而非直接回答字面请求。现有基准缺乏对此类协作式响应能力的系统评估。

Method: 构建包含8,115个查询的XYBench基准，来源包括技术领域和日常领域。设计基于合作响应理论的三维评估标准：(a)务实解决方案的存在性，(b)务实解决方案的强调程度，(c)误解识别能力。对比多个强LLM与人类表现，并进行Oracle消融实验。

Result: 最强LLM主要回答字面请求（0.75-0.92），较少解决真实意图（0.33-0.71）；识别误解最高仅63%，远低于人类（79-90%）。模型在多项选择中偏好务实响应，但生成时持续失败。提供显式用户意图虽有帮助，但巨大差距仍存。

Conclusion: 务实重定向能力是当前LLM根本性欠缺的能力。XYBench为这一关键协作能力提供了系统评估框架，揭示了LLM在处理用户隐性意图和误解方面的显著不足，指明了未来改进方向。

Abstract: When non-expert users ask LLMs for assistance, their queries can often have misconceptions (e.g., "How do I parse XML with regex?"). In such cases, often referred to as the XY-problem, LLMs must identify the misconception ("regex are fragile") and meaningfully direct the user toward a pragmatic solution that will address the root problem implicit in the request ("use an XML parser"). We introduce XYBench, a benchmark of 8,115 such queries, drawn from technical (StackOverflow/StackExchange) and everyday (WikiHow and a manually-curated subset) domains. We design an evaluation paradigm that assesses model responses along three criteria grounded in cooperative response theory: (a) presence and (b) emphasis on pragmatic solutions, and (c) identification of misconceptions. Our experiments show that even the strongest LLMs predominantly answer the literal request (0.75--0.92) and far less often the intended one (0.33--0.71), while substantially lagging behind humans at identifying misconceptions (at most 63% vs. 79--90%). Further, models overwhelmingly prefer pragmatic responses in a multiple choice setting yet consistently fail to generate them. Oracle ablation experiments show that providing explicit user intent at generation time helps; however a large gap remains, suggesting pragmatic redirection is a fundamentally underdeveloped capability in current LLMs.

</details>


### [63] [You Are What You Read: Misalignment via In-Context Persona Induction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06851)
*Kyuhee Kim,Benjamin Berczi,Cozmin Ududec*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文发现，仅在上下文中提供关于某个人物的良性传记事实（无需微调、无需展示有害行为），即可诱导模型采纳该人物的角色人设，并在无关问题上表现出该人物的观点——包括有害观点（高达80%）。这种“人设诱导”随事实数量呈S型增长，3-10个事实即超50%采纳率。且因单条事实均良性，内容过滤器仅标记3%的输入，远低于直接指令的24-33%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究上下文中的良性数据如何在无微调、无有害演示的情况下导致模型广泛错位（misalignment），即通过传记事实诱导模型采纳特定人设，进而在无关问题上表达该人设的典型观点（包括有害观点）。

Method: 在九个人物人设和十三个模型上实验：将汇聚于单一人物的传记事实作为普通对话轮次放入模型上下文，测量模型在事实未涉及的问题上采纳该人设身份的比例，并考察事实数量、人设性质（无害/有害）、格式化指令对激活的影响，同时对比内容过滤器的触发率。

Result: 身份采纳随事实数量呈S型上升，3-10个事实即跨越50%阈值。错位程度随所描述人物而变：无害人设达完全采纳且近零错位；有害人设在无关问题上表达特征性有害观点，比率高达80%。格式化指令可控制人设激活时机。累积传记上下文仅触发3%内容过滤标记，远低于等效直接指令的24-33%。

Conclusion: 良性上下文事实即可诱导强烈人设采纳与错位行为，且极难被内容过滤检测。这揭示了上下文学习中隐蔽、可扩展的安全风险：攻击者可通过堆砌无害事实植入有害人设，绕过现有防护。

Abstract: Broad misalignment has been produced by finetuning on narrow data, harmful or benign, and in context only by demonstrations of the undesirable behaviour itself. We show that benign data suffices in context, with no finetuning and no demonstration of harmful behaviour in the prompt. Biographical facts that converge on a single figure, placed in a model's context as ordinary conversational turns, lead it to answer as that figure on questions the facts never touch. We call this persona induction. Across nine personas and thirteen models, identity adoption rises sigmoidally with the number of facts and crosses 50% within 3 to 10 of them. Misalignment then tracks which figure is described. Harmless personas reach full adoption with near-zero misalignment, while harmful ones voice their characteristic views on unrelated questions, at rates up to 80%. A formatting instruction can gate when the persona activates. Because each fact is individually benign, accumulated biographical context is flagged by content filters on 3% of inputs against 24-33% for an equivalent direct instruction.

</details>


### [64] [AutoLexSteer: Automatic Contrast Construction for Lexical Activation Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06879)
*Shuhe Wang,Lachlan Cowley,Eduard Hovy,Jey Han Lau*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Hangman（一种基于词义的新型引导向量）和 AutoLexSteer（首个全自动构建引导向量的方法），利用 WordNet 中的词族自动指定需避免的引导源和期望的引导目标，实现精细的词级和词义级引导，并能引导如谄媚等 LLM 行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的引导向量构建是困难的手动过程，因为嵌入的不透明性；需要一种自动化、基于词义的方法来精确控制 LLM 输出。

Method: 提出 Hangman 引导向量，基于词义操作；开发 AutoLexSteer 自动化流程，从 WordNet 提取紧密相关的词族，同时指定需避免的引导源和期望的引导目标，从而构建引导向量。

Result: 引导向量精度高，可在词级和词义集级别进行引导，并能成功引导如谄媚等特定 LLM 行为。

Conclusion: AutoLexSteer 实现了首个全自动构建引导向量的方法，基于词义的 Hangman 向量提供了精细、可解释的控制，代码和数据集已开源。

Abstract: Steering vectors have rapidly emerged as a popular and effective method for guiding the output of LLMs in very specific ways. But constructing accurate steering vectors is a difficult manual process due to the opacity of embeddings. We introduce Hangman, a novel type of steering vector that operates using word senses, as well as AutoLexSteer, the first fully automated process for building steering vectors. AutoLexSteer employs families of closely-related words extracted from WordNet to specify both the steering source to be avoided and the desired steering target. The steering vectors are quite precise, can be used to steer at the level of words and sets of word senses (meanings), and are able to steer certain LLM behaviors like sycophancy. The dataset and code can be found at https://github.com/ShuheWang1998/autolexsteer.

</details>


### [65] [Towards Bridging the Gap Between Offline and Iterative Alignment via Preference Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06893)
*Wenbo Zhang,Wenzhuo Zhou,Hengrui Cai,Zhengling Qi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 DP3O（Distilled Preference Probability Policy Optimization），一种高效的离线偏好对齐算法。通过引入显式偏好模型并蒸馏其知识到策略优化中，DP3O 在理论上实现了更紧的泛化界，在实验上超越现有离线方法，性能媲美迭代 DPO，且训练时间减少约 42%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迭代 DPO 在学术基准上表现优于离线 DPO，但原因不明。作者通过受控实验发现，迭代过程中额外引入的显式偏好模型是其优势的关键因素。这启发作者将显式偏好建模的优势融入离线对齐，提出 DP3O。

Method: DP3O 分两阶段：第一阶段利用一组辅助 LLMs 学习显式偏好模型；第二阶段将该模型的知识蒸馏到策略优化中。理论上证明显式偏好建模比隐式建模具有更好的估计误差控制，且 DP3O 通过方差缩减实现比硬标签 DPO 更紧的泛化界。

Result: 在多种对话和下游任务上，DP3O 超越最先进的离线对齐方法，性能与迭代 DPO 相当，训练时间减少约 42%，展示了其有效性和效率。

Conclusion: 显式偏好建模是迭代 DPO 优于离线 DPO 的核心原因。DP3O 成功将这一优势迁移到离线设置中，在保持理论收敛保证的同时实现了计算效率的大幅提升，为大语言模型偏好对齐提供了新的实用范式。

Abstract: Direct preference optimization DPO is a promising offline approach for aligning large language models (LLMs) due to its simplicity, computational efficiency, and implicit modeling of human preferences. Interestingly, iterative extensions of DPO have achieved stronger performance on academic benchmarks, raising two key questions: (i) Why do iterative methods generally outperform offline ones? (ii) Can their advantages be incorporated into offline alignment? To answer the first question, our controlled experiments reveal that the explicit preference model, additionally introduced in the iterative procedure, is a key factor behind its superiority over offline methods. This insight leads us to answer the second question affirmatively and propose Distilled Preference Probability Policy Optimization (DP3O), an effective and efficient offline alignment algorithm. DP3O first learns an explicit preference model using a helper class of LLMs and then distills its knowledge into policy optimization. Theoretically, we show that explicit preference modeling admits better estimation error control than implicit formulations, and that DP3O achieves a tighter generalization bound than hard-label DPO through variance reduction. Empirically, we evaluate DP3O on a wide range of chat-based and downstream tasks and show that it outperforms state-of-the-art offline methods, achieves performance comparable to iterative DPO, and reduces training time by about $42\%$, demonstrating both its effectiveness and efficiency.

</details>


### [66] [Dynamic-Programming-Guided Hierarchical BPE and Empirical Analysis of Vocabulary Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06898)
*Kenny Shao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出DH-BPE，一种基于动态规划的层级BPE词汇构建方法，在固定模型可见词汇预算下优化词汇分配，提升压缩效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准BPE的贪婪合并顺序不一定能为固定模型可见词汇量分配最优词汇，导致压缩效率不足。

Method: 从适度超量的BPE候选词汇出发，利用动态规划度量候选效用，应用基于曝光引导的依赖感知剪枝，选择固定大小的模型可见词汇。

Result: 在12K和16K词汇量下，DH-BPE在共享精确最小token DP编码器下持续优于标准BPE、Pruned BPE和MinGram的聚合压缩；虽弱于MinGram-PP在主要对比中，但在跨语料库评估中，在超采因子f=2.0和f=3.0时优于MinGram-PP；定性分析显示DH-BPE平衡了后期更完整的BPE合并与可复用子词组件。

Conclusion: DH-BPE提供了一种实用方法，在固定模型可见词汇预算下改进词汇分配，兼顾完整合并与可复用子词，提升压缩性能。

Abstract: Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) constructs vocabularies through greedy pair merging, but the resulting merge order does not necessarily allocate a fixed model-visible vocabulary optimally for compression. We propose Dynamic-Programming-Guided Hierarchical BPE (DH-BPE), a vocabulary-construction method that combines token exposure under exact minimum-token segmentation with the hierarchical dependencies induced by BPE training. Starting from a modestly overshot BPE candidate vocabulary, DH-BPE uses dynamic programming to measure candidate utility and applies exposure-guided, dependency-aware pruning to select a fixed-size model-visible vocabulary. We compare DH-BPE against Standard BPE and recent vocabulary-optimization baselines, including Pruned BPE, MinGram, and MinGram-PP, in primary evaluations at 12K and 16K target vocabulary sizes, with an additional 18K evaluation against MinGram only. Across the primary 12K and 16K comparisons, DH-BPE consistently improves aggregate compression over Standard BPE, Pruned BPE, and MinGram under a shared exact minimum-token DP encoder. MinGram-PP achieves stronger aggregate compression in the primary comparisons, but DH-BPE outperforms it at overshoot factors f = 2.0 and f = 3.0 in cross-corpus evaluation; at 12K, MinGram-PP reverses this ordering only with the substantially larger candidate pools at f = 4.0 and f = 5.0. Qualitative analysis further shows that DH-BPE balances later, more complete BPE merges with reusable subword components, providing a practical approach to improving vocabulary allocation under a fixed model-visible vocabulary budget.

</details>


### [67] [TurEngMix: A Text Corpus and Benchmark for Turkish-English Code-Mixed Language Identification and Named Entity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06963)
*Ilayda Dogan,Phuong-Anh Nguyen-Le,Julia Mendelsohn*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文介绍TurEngMix语料库（5.5K社交媒体帖子，486,974词元），针对土耳其语-英语代码混合文本的语言识别（LID）和命名实体识别（NER）构建基准，发现单语词元标注可靠，但所有模型在混合语言词元（尤其是形态融合词元）上错误率显著更高，GPT-4o和Qwen的NER错误率分别为单语的5.2倍和6.3倍，凸显形态融合仍是主要挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自然语言处理系统在代码混合文本上表现不佳，特别是低资源语言对。土耳其语-英语代码混合更具挑战性，因英语词干可与土耳其语后缀结合形成单一混合语言词元，亟需专门语料库和基准推动研究。

Method: 构建TurEngMix语料库（5.5K自然噪声社交媒体帖子），从中抽取15K专家标注词元建立LID和NER基准。评估解码器LLM（GPT-4o、Qwen）与微调编码器基线，对比单语与混合语言词元（含形态融合词元）的标注性能。

Result: 单语土耳其语和英语词元标注可靠；所有模型在混合语言词元上LID和NER错误率均高。形态融合词元上，GPT-4o和Qwen的NER错误率分别为单语词元的5.2倍和6.3倍。

Conclusion: 形态融合是土耳其语-英语代码混合处理的核心难题。发布语料库、标注及代码，为未来计算与社会语言学研究提供资源支持。

Abstract: Natural language processing systems underperform on code-mixed text, particularly for low-resource language pairs. Turkish-English poses a further challenge: it lets English stems combine with Turkish suffixes to form single mixed-language tokens. We introduce TurEngMix, a corpus of 5.5K noisy, naturally occurring social media posts (486,974 tokens) rich in Turkish-English code-mixing. From this corpus, we construct a new Turkish-English benchmark for code-mixed language identification (LID) and named entity recognition (NER), comprising 15K expert-annotated tokens. Evaluating both decoder LLM and fine-tuned encoder baselines, we find that monolingual Turkish and English tokens are labeled reliably, but all models have high error rates on mixed-language tokens for both LID and NER. For morphologically integrated tokens, NER error rates were 5.2x and 6.3x higher for GPT-4o and Qwen, respectively. This highlights how morphological integration remains a challenge. We release the corpus, annotations, and code to support future computational and sociolinguistic research on Turkish-English code-mixing.

</details>


### [68] [CantoneseLLM v2: Reasoning in a Low-Resource Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06970)
*Tsz Chung Cheng,Chung Shing Cheng,Chaak Ming Lau,Cheuk Hei Chong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文开发并发布了 CantoneseLLM v2，包含基于 Qwen3 8B 和 30B-A3B 的模型。通过持续预训练（CPT）在 7.84 亿粤语和香港相关标记上训练，结合聊天向量合并、SFT、DPO 和 RLVR 等阶段。研究发现聊天向量合并迁移了指令跟随能力但保留了供体模型的推理语言；有限粤语推理数据的 SFT 缩短或移除了推理轨迹并降低性能；DPO 恢复了推理块格式但仅部分恢复性能；RLVR 以粤语语言和繁体中文脚本为乘法约束，实现了粤语语言对齐并完全恢复性能。30B-A3B 模型在 HKCanto-Eval 上达到 73.16，仅比合并检查点低 1.20 分，同时保留了合并检查点缺失的粤语推理行为。发布了模型检查点、训练环境和 13 年繁体中文 Common Crawl 数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 粤语虽广泛使用，但在书面数据上属于低资源语言，缺乏大规模原生粤语推理轨迹语料用于模型训练。现有方法难以在保持推理能力的同时实现粤语语言对齐。

Method: 基于 Qwen3 8B 和 30B-A3B 架构，采用多阶段训练流程：1) 持续预训练（CPT）在 7.84 亿粤语和香港相关标记上；2) 聊天向量合并迁移指令跟随能力；3) 监督微调（SFT）使用有限粤语推理数据；4) 直接偏好优化（DPO）恢复推理块格式；5) 基于强化学习的可验证奖励（RLVR）以粤语语言和繁体中文脚本为乘法约束进行语言对齐。

Result: 评估显示各训练阶段的效果差异：聊天向量合并保留供体模型推理语言；SFT 缩短/移除推理轨迹并降低基准性能；DPO 恢复推理块格式（8B 模型效果更明显）但仅部分恢复性能；RLVR 完全恢复性能并引入粤语推理行为。30B-A3B 模型在 HKCanto-Eval 达到 73.16，仅比合并检查点低 1.20 分，且保留粤语推理行为。

Conclusion: 通过多阶段训练策略，特别是 RLVR 结合语言和脚本约束，成功构建了具备强粤语推理能力的大语言模型，在保持推理性能的同时实现了原生粤语语言对齐。发布的模型、训练环境和数据集为粤语 NLP 研究提供了重要资源。

Abstract: Cantonese is widely spoken but remains low-resource in written data, with no large corpus of native Cantonese reasoning traces available for model training. We develop and release CantoneseLLM v2, comprising models based on Qwen3 8B and 30B-A3B. The models are trained through CPT on 784 million Cantonese and Hong Kong-related tokens, chat-vector merging, SFT, DPO, and RLVR. Evaluation across the training stages shows that chat-vector merging transfers instruction following but preserves the donor model's reasoning language, while SFT with limited Cantonese reasoning data substantially shortens or removes reasoning traces and reduces benchmark performance. DPO restores the reasoning-block format, particularly for the 8B model, but recovers only part of the lost performance. The RLVR training with Cantonese language and Traditional Chinese scripts as multiplicative constraints introduced Cantonese language alignment and restored the lost performance. The 30B-A3B model reaches 73.16 on HKCanto-Eval, within 1.20 points of its merged checkpoint, while retaining the Cantonese reasoning behaviour absent from that checkpoint. We release the model checkpoints, the training environments, and a thirteen-year Traditional Chinese Common Crawl dataset. The models can be accessed at https://huggingface.co/collections/hon9kon9ize/cantonesellm-v20

</details>


### [69] [Train Overcomplete, Deploy Compact: Scaling Recovery Capacity for Structured LLM Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06974)
*Seungmin Oh,Donggeon Lee,Jongbin Ryu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: OverRep 通过过完备重参数化解决结构化剪枝中的容量-知识不对称问题，在训练时过参数化恢复模块，推理时代数合并为紧凑模块，在三个主干模型家族上显著提升推理性能，同时保持推理开销不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化剪枝虽能降低部署成本，但恢复阶段受限于恢复模块表征能力与被移除知识复杂度的不匹配（容量-知识不对称），导致性能下降。

Method: 提出 OverRep 框架，遵循“训练过完备，部署紧凑”原则：训练时暂时过参数化恢复模块以吸收蒸馏知识，引入退火激活实现非线性训练动态并收敛到线性区间；恢复后通过代数合并将过完备重参数化等价转换为紧凑模块，保持推理架构和计算成本不变。

Result: 在三个主干模型家族上，OverRep 相比强基线在 25% 和 50% 剪枝率下分别提升推理性能 5.5 和 8.4 个点，内存占用和 TFLOPs 与现有恢复方法相当。

Conclusion: OverRep 有效解决了结构化剪枝中的容量-知识不对称瓶颈，实现了高性能恢复且无额外推理开销，为大模型高效部署提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Large language models achieve strong performance across diverse tasks, but deployment remains costly because of memory, latency, and energy demands. Structured pruning reduces these costs by removing architectural components, yet its recovery stage is often limited by a mismatch between the recovery module's representational capacity and the complexity of the removed knowledge. We call this bottleneck the capacity-knowledge asymmetry and propose OverRep, an Overcomplete Reparameterization framework for structured LLM pruning. Following the principle of "train overcomplete, deploy compact", OverRep temporarily overparameterizes the recovery module during training to absorb complex knowledge distilled from the original model. After recovery, the overcomplete re-parameterization is algebraically merged into a mathematically equivalent compact module, preserving the pruned model's inference-time architecture and computational cost. OverRep further introduces an annealed activation that enables nonlinear training dynamics while converging to a linear regime for exact algebraic merging. Across three backbone families, OverRep improves retained reasoning performance over strong recovery baselines by up to 5.5 and 8.4 points at 25% and 50% pruning, respectively, while keeping memory usage and TFLOPs comparable to existing recovery methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/mmai-laboratory/OverRep.

</details>


### [70] [Aha-Flow Distillation: Flow Markers Matter in LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07036)
*Xiaodong Wang,Peixi Peng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出了Aha-Flow Distillation (AFD)，一种双模式的在线策略自蒸馏方法，通过识别并利用推理过程中的“Flow Moment”（流畅时刻，表现为持续的过程确认性表达）与“Aha Moment”（顿悟时刻，表现为修正和回溯），构建Flow-CoT作为辅助监督，在Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-4B上显著提升数学推理基准AIME25和HMMT25的Avg@12性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自蒸馏方法主要依赖简洁的解决方案监督（Aha风格），忽略了推理过程中持续的、确认性的“Flow”模式。作者观察到这两种推理模式的语言标记（Flow Markers与Aha Markers）不同，且Flow风格的推理轨迹能提供更丰富的过程监督信号，但不应在推理时引入额外开销。

Method: 1. 识别Flow Moment与Aha Moment及其语言标记；2. 通过重写原始推理轨迹的语篇标记构建Flow-CoT，保留推理内容；3. 提出AFD双模式蒸馏：Aha分支保留简洁解决方案监督，Flow分支引入重写后的Flow-CoT并配以直接自信的推理指令；4. 推理时仅使用标准反思指令，Flow风格仅作为训练信号。

Result: 在AIME25和HMMT25上，AFD使Qwen3-8B的Avg@12从60.8提升至61.3，Qwen3-4B从57.5提升至58.6（均对比复现的OPSD基线）。消融实验显示，相同Flow-CoT/Aha-CoT组成下，双模式训练将Avg@12从59.5提升至60.1，证明收益不仅源于异构推理监督的引入，更源于其在自蒸馏中的组织方式。

Conclusion: AFD通过显式建模并分离Flow与Aha两种推理模式，并以双模式蒸馏方式组织训练，有效利用了过程确认性推理轨迹作为辅助监督，在不增加推理开销的前提下稳定提升了小规模模型在高难度数学任务上的表现。

Abstract: We identify the Flow Moment, a reasoning pattern characterized by sustained, process-confirming verbalizations such as I'm doing, in contrast to the revision- and backtracking-oriented Aha Moment. We refer to their corresponding linguistic expressions as Flow Markers and Aha Markers, respectively. Based on this observation, we construct Flow-CoT by rewriting the discourse markers of original reasoning traces while preserving their underlying reasoning content, and use it as auxiliary supervision for on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). We further propose \textbf{Aha-Flow Distillation (AFD)}, a dual-mode extension of OPSD that pairs different forms of privileged information with corresponding reasoning instructions. The Aha branch retains concise solution-based supervision, while the Flow branch introduces rewritten Flow-CoT under a direct and confident reasoning instruction. At inference time, the model uses only the standard reflective instruction, so Flow-style reasoning serves purely as a training signal. Experiments on AIME25 and HMMT25 show consistent improvements across Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-4B: AFD improves Avg@12 from 60.8 to 61.3 on Qwen3-8B and from 57.5 to 58.6 on Qwen3-4B over our reproduced OPSD baselines. Controlled ablations further show that, with the same Flow-CoT/Aha-CoT composition, dual-mode training improves Avg@12 from 59.5 to 60.1, indicating that the benefit comes not only from introducing heterogeneous reasoning supervision, but also from how it is organized during self-distillation. The code is available at https://github.com/Wang-Xiaodong1899/Aha-Flow-Distillation.

</details>


### [71] [A Hyperbolicity Atlas of Large Language Model Hidden States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07053)
*Zhichao Yang,Yuanze Hu,Gen Li,Qingchen Yu,Shiying Duan,Xinyu Wang,Ye Qiu,Zeming Liu,Guangxu Chen,Zhaoxin Fan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究当代大语言模型（LLM）提示词token隐藏状态中的Gromov双曲性（GH），基于十个开放权重模型、81.9万样本-层测量，跨四个维度（参数规模、层深、模型家族、输入领域）构建GH图谱。发现层深是最显著模式：中间层形成高相对双曲性平台，末层显著更树状；规模效应弱且非单调；同规模模型家族差异大；领域与模型专业化交互。GH可作为诊断工具，揭示层级距离结构出现位置、专业化如何改变结构，指导后续深入分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM隐藏状态虽为普通向量，但其距离关系可能呈现层级结构。以往缺乏系统研究提示词token隐藏状态是否表现出Gromov双曲性——一种基于距离的树状度量。本文旨在填补这一空白，量化不同模型、层、规模、领域下的双曲性，为理解LLM内部表示几何提供新视角。

Method: 选取十个开放权重模型，在MATH500、HumanEval、WinoGrande、TruthfulQA四个基准上收集818,904个样本-层测量。计算各层提示词token隐藏状态的Gromov双曲性，沿参数规模、层深、模型家族、输入领域四轴构建GH图谱，对比分析双曲性随层深、规模、家族、领域的变化模式。

Result: 1. 层深是最清晰模式：中间层形成高相对双曲性平台，末层显著更树状（双曲性更高）。2. 参数规模效应弱且非单调。3. 同规模（7/8B）模型家族间双曲性差异显著。4. 输入领域与模型专业化强交互，不同任务领域下的双曲性表现随模型专长不同。

Conclusion: Gromov双曲性可作为实用诊断工具：揭示层级距离结构在模型哪些层出现、模型专业化如何重塑几何结构、哪些模型-层-领域组合值得深入分析。研究为LLM表示几何的系统性理解提供了量化基础和新视角。

Abstract: LLM hidden states are ordinary vectors, but the distances among those vectors may still show hierarchical structure. To our knowledge, this paper is the first systematic study of whether prompt-token hidden states in contemporary LLMs exhibit Gromov Hyperbolicity (GH), a distance-based measure of tree-likeness. Using 818,904 sample-layer measurements from ten open-weight models across MATH500, HumanEval, WinoGrande, and TruthfulQA, we build a GH map over four axes: parameter scale, layer depth, model family, and input domain. The clearest pattern is depth, not scale: middle layers usually form a high-relative-hyperbolicity plateau, while final layers often become substantially more tree-like. Scale effects are weak and non-monotonic, matched 7/8B model families differ strongly, and domains interact with model specialization. These findings make GH useful as a practical diagnostic: it shows where hierarchical distance structure appears, how specialization changes it, and which model-layer-domain comparisons deserve closer analysis.

</details>


### [72] [Revisiting Complete Reasoning Traces for Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07103)
*Jaehui Hwang,Sangdoo Yun,Byeongho Heo,Dongyoon Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文发现完整推理轨迹在后训练中收益有限，部分轨迹即使重度截断仍有效；注意力分析和token移除实验显示中间token贡献极小，端点训练能改变推理行为并提升强化学习/在线蒸馏效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究LLMs在后训练（如SFT）中是否真正从完整推理轨迹中获益，因为轨迹往往冗长且包含绕路，但此前未充分研究。

Method: 通过飞行员实验对比完整/部分轨迹效果；基于注意力的分析和受控token移除研究量化中间token贡献；实验端点训练对推理行为的影响及在RL/在线蒸馏中的表现。

Result: 完整轨迹仅提供有限增益，部分轨迹即使重度截断下仍有效；中间token对最终推理质量贡献极小；端点训练能一致改变推理行为，且在基于强化学习或在线蒸馏的后训练方法中也获益。

Conclusion: 需重新审视完整推理轨迹在后训练中的必要性，避免冗余信息可让LLMs利用内部知识推断缺失步骤，端点训练是一种更高效的范式。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are often post-trained on pre-collected reasoning trajectories to improve their reasoning capability. Such trajectories tend to be long due to complex, interwoven paths, which often include detours on the path toward the answer. However, it has been underexplored whether LLMs indeed benefit from learning complete trajectories in post-training, such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Starting from our pilot study, we find that full trajectories provide only limited benefit, while partial trajectories are effective even under heavy truncation. We analyze redundancy in reasoning trajectories through attention-based analyses and controlled token-removal studies, both of which show that intermediate tokens contribute minimally to final reasoning quality. This suggests that avoiding redundant information may allow LLMs to internally infer coherent alternatives by inferring missing steps from their internal knowledge, given known trajectory endpoints. Furthermore, we show that training LLMs using endpoints leads to consistent changes in reasoning behavior, and that it also benefits post-training methods based on reinforcement learning or on-policy distillation, highlighting the need to revisit complete reasoning traces. Code is available at https://github.com/naver-ai/revisiting-trace.

</details>


### [73] [The Illusion of Debiasing: Persona Steering Redistributes Rather Than Reduces Bias in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07117)
*Ziyue Feng,Hongbo Fang,James A. Evans*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究提示词干预（如人设指令）是否重塑语言模型内部结构，还是仅调节输出通道。通过三种指令微调模型，沿深度轴（自我报告、开放生成、词级参数关联）测量人设效应，发现分级解离：人设可读但非结构性，模型遵循单一特质指令却无法复现人类特质间协方差；随深度加深解离加剧：人设保持或放大闭式问答偏差，改变绝对语调但组间差异不变，难以扰动已饱和的联想基线。结论：提示词引导仅作用于输出通道，存在结构触达上限，表层可操控性可能掩盖这一限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究提示词干预（系统提示、人设、角色指令）是否真正重构模型内部表征结构，还是仅在输出层面调节行为。以人设条件化为受控探针，量化其在不同表征深度上的影响，揭示提示词引导的结构触达边界。

Method: 选取三个指令微调模型，以人设条件化为实验操纵，沿深度轴测量三层效应：1) 自我报告（模型口述人设），2) 开放式生成（自由文本产出），3) 词级参数关联（探测内部联想空间）。对比单一特质遵循度与人类特质间协方差复现度，分析闭式问答偏差、语调绝对值与组间差异、联想基线饱和度的变化。

Result: 呈现分级解离模式：人设在表层可读（模型能陈述人设），但非结构性（无法复现人类特质协方差）；随深度加深，人设保持或放大闭式问答偏差，仅改变绝对语调而组间差异不变，且难以扰动已饱和的词级联想基线。提示词引导的结构触达存在上限，表层可操控性掩盖了深层结构的不变性。

Conclusion: 提示词干预主要作用于输出通道，而非重构内部表征结构。其结构触达深度有限，表层行为的可塑性可能掩盖深层表征的刚性，提示未来对齐与控制研究需关注深层结构干预而非仅依赖提示词工程。

Abstract: Prompt-based interventions: system prompts, personas, role instructions, reliably reshape what a language model says, but it is unclear which layer they reach. Do they reconfigure internal structure, or only modulate the output channel? We use persona conditioning as a controlled probe, measuring its effects along a depth axis from self-report, through open-ended generation, to word-level parametric association, across three instruction-tuned models. We find a graded dissociation. Personas are legible but not structural: models follow single-trait instructions yet fail to reproduce human inter-trait covariance. The dissociation deepens with depth: personas hold or amplify closed-form QA bias, shift absolute tone while leaving between-group disparity unchanged, and barely perturb an already saturated associative baseline. Prompt-based steering thus operates in the output channel and has a structural reach limit that surface manipulability can mask.

</details>


### [74] [PTCG: Persona-guided Tree-based Counterargument Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07120)
*Eunbeen Son,Yohan Jo,Joonsuk Park,JinYeong Bak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 一种结合思维树逐步生成与人格选择的框架，用于生成多样且有说服力的反驳论点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常只生成单一反驳论点，无法捕捉现实辩论所需的多样性和说服力。

Method: 提出PTCG框架，结合Tree-of-Thoughts启发的逐步生成与剪枝，以及说话人人格选择；从原始论点估计作者人格，并引入代表不同视角的说话人人格，实现视角采择。

Result: 通过LLM-as-a-Judge、分类器评估和人工评估，PTCG在反驳论点的多样性和说服力上均显著优于基线方法。

Conclusion: PTCG通过人格引导的思维树生成，有效提升了反驳论点的多样性和说服力，为批判性思维和平衡论述提供了更好的支持。

Abstract: The ability to generate counterarguments is important for critical thinking and balanced discourse, yet existing approaches typically produce only a single counterargument, failing to capture the diversity and persuasiveness required in real-world debates. To address this limitation, we propose Persona-guided Tree-based Counterargument Generation (PTCG), a framework that combines Tree-of-Thoughts-inspired step-wise generation and pruning with speaker persona selection. By estimating the author's persona from the original argument and incorporating speaker personas representing distinct perspectives, PTCG operationalizes perspective-taking and enables the generation of diverse counterarguments. Results from LLM-as-a-Judge, classifier-based assessment, and human evaluations indicate that PTCG shows consistent improvements in both the diversity and persuasiveness of counterarguments compared to baseline methods.

</details>


### [75] [Line-Coupled Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07129)
*Shiyuan Li,Shaorong Zhang,Zhaorui Yang,Qian Zhang,Greg Ver Steeg,Bingyao Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了行耦合语言模型（LCLM），这是一种自回归模型，通过同时预测多行文本的下一个token，实现了并行生成多个token，同时保持标准的下一token预测目标和因果注意力机制。实验表明，跨行targets的依赖性远低于同行连续targets，支持将行作为并行生成单元。在881M参数规模下，LCLM每前向传播平均生成2.94个content tokens，验证交叉熵损失为2.44，而标准自回归基线仅生成1.00 token且损失为2.39。即使生成16个tokens每前向传播，损失仅比基线高0.09（2.34 vs 2.25）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自回归语言模型每次解码步骤只能生成一个token，限制了每次前向传播的有效输出。虽然扩散模型、基于插入的解码和多token预测等方法支持并行生成，但它们要么在训练时产生额外的token流量，要么难以预测强依赖的未来token。需要一种方法在保持标准自回归训练目标的同时实现高效的并行生成。

Method: LCLM将多行文本的token交错成单一因果序列，使用行交错旋转位置编码，通过共享因果上下文耦合多行。模型为每个活跃行同时预测下一个token，保留标准的下一token预测目标和因果注意力机制。这种设计使得跨行targets之间的依赖性显著降低，从而支持将行作为并行生成的基本单元。

Result: 控制实验表明跨行targets的依赖性远低于同行连续targets。在881M参数下，LCLM每前向传播平均生成2.94个content tokens，验证交叉熵损失2.44；标准自回归基线生成1.00 token，损失2.39。当LCLM生成16个tokens每前向传播时，损失仅为2.34，比基线的2.25仅高0.09，展示了极佳的扩展性。

Conclusion: LCLM通过行级并行化和因果上下文共享，在保持标准自回归训练范式的同时，显著提高了每次前向传播的token生成效率。该方法证明了文本行可以作为有效的并行生成单元，为大规模语言模型的高效推理提供了新的研究方向，在生成吞吐量和模型质量之间实现了优异的权衡。

Abstract: Autoregressive language models generate one token per decoding step, limiting the useful output of each forward pass. Although diffusion models, insertion-based decoding, and multi-token prediction enable parallel generation, they either incur additional training-time token traffic or struggle to predict strongly dependent future tokens. We introduce the Line-Coupled Language Model (LCLM), an autoregressive model that advances multiple text lines together by predicting the next token for every active line while coupling the lines through shared causal context. LCLM interleaves line tokens into a single causal sequence and uses line-staggered rotary positions, retaining the standard next-token objective and causal attention. Controlled experiments show that cross-line targets are substantially less dependent than consecutive same-line targets, supporting lines as parallel generation units. With 881M parameters, LCLM produces an average of 2.94 content tokens per forward pass with a validation cross-entropy loss of 2.44, compared with 1.00 token per forward pass and a loss of 2.39 for the vanilla autoregressive baseline. Most notably, even when LCLM generates 16 tokens per forward pass, its loss is only 0.09 higher than that of the vanilla autoregressive baseline (2.34 vs. 2.25).

</details>


### [76] [Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Prompt Ensemble for Minor-Grain Breeding Information Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07134)
*Hang Zhao,Jiahao Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 RAME（检索增强多提示词集成），一种无需训练的框架，用于 CCL2026-Eval Task 5 小杂粮育种信息联合抽取任务（12 实体类型、6 关系类型）。RAME 结合混合 BM25-Embedding 检索器的少样本选择、三种提示词（严格/宽松/平衡）集成及大规模重复采样多数投票，基于 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 实现 Total Score 0.499（NER 0.730, RE 0.346），排名榜首，比官方 GPT-5.5 基线（0.448）相对提升 11.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对小杂粮育种文献中实体与关系联合抽取的挑战，现有方法依赖大量标注数据或大模型微调，成本高且泛化受限。需要一种免训练、可控多样性、高置信度的大语言模型推理框架，在低资源领域实现高性能抽取。

Method: RAME 包含三大组件：(1) 混合 BM25-Embedding 检索器进行检索增强少样本选择；(2) 三提示词集成（Strict、Relaxed、Balanced）覆盖精确率至召回率谱系；(3) 大规模重复采样配合多数投票聚合，过滤噪声预测。整体无需训练，直接基于 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 进行推理。

Result: 在官方排行榜上获得 Total Score 0.499（NER F1 0.730, RE F1 0.346），排名第 1，超越官方 Track-A 基线 GPT-5.5（0.448），相对提升 11.4%。

Conclusion: RAME 证明了免训练的检索增强多提示词集成配合多数投票，能在专业领域小样本条件下显著提升大模型的联合实体关系抽取性能，为低资源信息抽取提供了高效可复现的范式。

Abstract: This paper presents our system for CCL2026-Eval Task 5: Minor-Grain Breeding Information Extraction (MGBIE), which jointly extracts 12 entity types and 6 relation types from minor-grain breeding literature. We propose RAME (Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Prompt Ensemble), a training-free framework that elicits multiple LLM outputs under controlled diversity and aggregates them by majority voting to obtain high-confidence predictions. RAME combines (i) retrieval-augmented few-shot selection via a hybrid BM25-embedding retriever, (ii) a three-prompt ensemble (Strict, Relaxed, Balanced) spanning the precision to recall spectrum, and (iii) large-scale repeated sampling with majority voting to filter noisy predictions. Built on DeepSeek-V4-Flash, RAME achieves a Total Score of 0.499 (NER 0.730, RE 0.346) on the leaderboard, ranking 1st and surpassing the official Track-A baseline powered by GPT-5.5 (0.448), representing an 11.4% relative improvement. Code is available at https://github.com/king-wang123/CCL26-RAME.

</details>


### [77] [Vishing-Tactics-Bench: Forecasting Exploitation Trajectories in Voice Phishing Calls](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07151)
*Jeongmin Lee,Dongmyung Sul,Seung Yun,Jinxia Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Vishing-Tactics-Bench 基准，基于 Endsley 情境感知框架将语音钓鱼防御从事后分类转为实时危害预测，构建 6 战术分类法并标注 5,645 个合成中文通话的 35,340 条诈骗话术，定义利用轨迹预测任务及评估指标，实验表明战术轨迹可作为可解释的通话战术状态表示，支持针对特定危害的早期预警与干预选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音钓鱼实时发生，事后分类无法阻止损害；关键需求是在通话进行中预测其将走向信息收集还是金融诈骗两种终端危害，从而实现及时干预。

Method: 1. 依托 Endsley 情境感知框架，将防御重构为危害投影任务；2. 将 MITRE ATT&CK 改造为 6 战术分类法；3. 标注 5,645 个合成中文通话的 35,340 条诈骗话术；4. 定义利用轨迹预测这一生存分析式协议，采用 AP@k、C-index、divergence error 三指标评估；5. 从马尔可夫启发式到微调 LLM 等基线模型进行实验。

Result: 战术轨迹作为可解释的通话战术状态表示，能支持特定危害的预测，进而用于下游干预选择；在严格误报预算下的分层提前量分析揭示了轨迹信号在通话哪个阶段能提供早期预警。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了首个面向实时语音钓鱼危害预测的基准与评估体系，证明战术轨迹建模可实现可解释的早期预警，为主动干预提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Voice phishing (vishing) unfolds in real time; by the time a call has ended and post-hoc classification is possible, the harm has already been done. The more actionable question is which concrete harm (Information Gathering or Financial Exploitation) an ongoing call is tactically progressing toward. We present Vishing-Tactics-Bench, a benchmark grounded in Endsley's situation-awareness (SA) framework that recasts vishing defense from after-the-fact fraud classification to harm projection: predicting at each turn whether the call will reach either terminal harm. We adapt MITRE ATT&CK to vishing as a 6-tactic taxonomy (Vishing-Tactics) and label 35,340 scammer utterances across 5,645 synthetic Chinese calls. We define Exploitation Trajectory Forecasting, a survival-style protocol over the two terminal harms with three metrics: AP@k, C-index, and divergence error. Baselines ranging from a Markov heuristic to fine-tuned LLMs show that the tactical trajectory serves as an interpretable representation of the call's tactical state, supporting harm-specific forecasting, which can then be used for the downstream application of intervention selection; a stratified lead-time analysis at a tight false-alarm budget further identifies at what point in a call the trajectory signal yields early warning.

</details>


### [78] [FreqBLiMP: Frequency-Controlled Minimal Pairs Reveal Robustness and Fragility of LLMs Under Lexical Rarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07153)
*Tyrone White,Yuki Arase*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 FreqBLiMP，在控制词频条件下重新生成 BLiMP 的 67 个范式，评估多个开源 LLM 家族。实验发现：词频降低导致句子似然单调下降，但整体对比接受度准确率仅轻微下降；然而，这种整体稳定性掩盖了跨语言现象的巨大差异——模型在显性形句法泛化上保持稳健，但在需要词条特定信息的现象上显著退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的最小对基准（如 BLiMP）忽略了词频变化，而词频是自然语言中普遍且高度偏态的属性。因此，现有评估无法测试语法偏好在涉及低频词汇项时是否保持稳定。

Method: 构建 FreqBLiMP：在显式 Zipf 频率制度下重新生成 BLiMP 的全部 67 个范式，同时保持每个最小对的语法对比。在多个开源 LLM 家族及不同规模上进行评估，测量句子似然和对比接受度准确率。

Result: 词频降低导致句子似然持续单调下降，但整体对比接受度准确率仅适度下降。然而，聚合稳定性掩盖了跨语言现象的显著差异：模型在显性形句法泛化（如主谓一致）上表现稳健，而在需要词条特定信息的现象（如不规则动词形态、特定动词的论元结构）上性能明显退化。

Conclusion: 词频控制揭示了 LLM 语言知识的频率敏感性：模型对高频词汇项的语法知识更可靠，低频词汇项暴露出对词条特定信息的依赖而非抽象泛化。未来评估应纳入频率控制，以全面诊断模型的语言泛化能力。

Abstract: Minimal-pair benchmarks such as BLiMP evaluate linguistic knowledge by testing whether language models (LMs) prefer acceptable sentences over minimally different unacceptable ones. However, these benchmarks largely ignore lexical frequency variation, despite lexical frequency being a pervasive and highly skewed property of natural language use. Consequently, existing evaluations do not test whether grammatical preferences remain stable when contrasts involve rare lexical items. We introduce FreqBLiMP, a frequency-controlled extension of BLiMP that regenerates all 67 paradigms under explicit Zipf-frequency regimes while preserving each minimal-pair's grammatical contrast. Evaluating multiple open-weight LLM families across scales, we find that decreasing lexical frequency produces a consistent, monotonic decrease in sentence likelihood, but only a modest reduction in overall contrastive acceptability accuracy. However, this aggregate stability masks substantial variation across linguistic phenomena, with LLMs remaining robust on overt morphosyntactic generalization while degrading on phenomena that require lemma-specific information.

</details>


### [79] [In-Place Instruction Following in Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07160)
*Zheng Nie,Zherui Li,Jiaming Zhang,Kun Wang,Zhenhong Zhou,Yufei Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 In-place Instruction Following (IIF) 任务及 IIF-Bench 基准，发现扩散大语言模型在去噪时低估约束片段，进而设计 GRAFT 后训练框架（约束感知 SFT + 偏好优化），在四个 dLLM 上将平均 IIF 得分提升 15.35 分，同时保持通用生成能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型 (dLLM) 通过双向迭代去噪生成文本，天然支持在任意输出位置锚定用户指定约束（即 In-place Prompting, IPP）。然而，现有研究缺乏系统的任务定义、基准和评估协议，且 vanilla dLLM 在去噪过程中往往忽视约束片段，导致指令遵循效果不佳。

Method: 1. 形式化 IIF 任务，构建包含字面、风格、话语功能三层约束的 IIF-Bench，并设计基于评分细则的局部-全局评估协议。2. 通过推理时注意力偏移探针揭示 vanilla dLLM 低估约束片段。3. 提出 GRAFT 框架：结合约束感知的监督微调 (SFT) 与偏好优化，专门针对 IPP 场景进行后训练。

Result: 在四个代表性 dLLM 上，GRAFT 将平均 IIF 得分从 57.75 提升至 73.10（+15.35），字面约束与话语功能约束分别绝对提升 15.91 和 15.57 分，且未损害模型的通用生成能力。

Conclusion: GRAFT 通过约束感知的后训练有效解决了 dLLM 在 In-place Prompting 下约束遵循不足的问题，显著提升了多层级约束的满足率，为扩散语言模型的可控生成提供了实用范式。

Abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) generate text via bidirectional iterative denoising, naturally supporting user-specified constraints anchored at arbitrary output positions, a paradigm known as In-place Prompting (IPP). We formalize this as the In-place Instruction Following (IIF) task and construct IIF-Bench, a hierarchical benchmark spanning literal, style, and discourse-function constraints, paired with a rubric-based local-global evaluation protocol. An inference-time attention-bias probe suggests that vanilla dLLMs often under-prioritize constraint spans during denoising. We then propose GRAFT, an IPP-oriented post-training framework combining constraint-aware SFT and preference optimization. On four representative dLLMs, GRAFT raises the average IIF score from 57.75 to 73.10 (+15.35 points), with absolute gains of 15.91 and 15.57 points on literal and discourse-function constraints, while preserving general generation ability.

</details>


### [80] [CircuitLens: Reasoning Circuits as Data Selection Signals for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07183)
*Zhuofan Chen,Ziqian Jiao,Yikai Cui,Zhixin Cai,Jun Bai,Wenge Rong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出电路推理分数（CRS）用于RLVR数据选择，通过对比消融识别的46个推理敏感注意力头，在冻结基座模型上单次前向传播即可计算。实验显示最低参与度十分位数据优于随机选择，而最高参与度数据增益有限，揭示RLVR数据选择具有制度依赖性而非静态质量排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR数据选择标准（难度过滤、人工筛选、奖励轨迹评分）将数据价值视为问题的内在属性，忽略了学习模型的特性。需要一种无需奖励标签或rollout、能反映模型推理电路参与度的选择信号。

Method: 通过对比消融识别46个推理敏感注意力头，基于冻结基座模型的单次前向传播计算电路推理分数（CRS），无需奖励标签或rollout。以CRS为选择信号，按参与度十分位分组进行RLVR训练对比。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-Math-7B上，最低参与度十分位在GSM8K（+2.0 pp）、OlympiadBench（+1.6 pp）、Minerva（+2.9 pp）上优于随机选择；最高参与度十分位增益较小且与中间十分位无显著差异。边界条件：领域精选池中各选择方法无显著差异；1.5B规模下有效方向相反；最低奖励训练条件产生最强下游泛化。

Conclusion: 在测试的Qwen2.5-Math设置中，RLVR数据选择呈现制度依赖性，不能简化为问题质量的静态排名。选择效果随模型规模、数据池构成和训练奖励条件而变，需结合具体训练 regime 设计选择策略。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is sensitive to which problems a model trains on, yet existing selection criteria--difficulty filtering, hand-curation, reward-trajectory scoring--assess data value as an intrinsic property of problems, independent of the model that will learn from them. We introduce Circuit Reasoning Score (CRS), a selection signal derived from 46 reasoning-sensitive attention heads identified via contrastive ablation, computed in a single forward pass on the frozen base model without reward labels or rollouts. CRS runs against the intuitive hypothesis that stronger reasoning-circuit engagement produces better training data: on Qwen2.5-Math-7B, the lowest-engagement decile improves over random selection on three medium-difficulty benchmarks (GSM8K +2.0 pp, OlympiadBench +1.6 pp, Minerva +2.9 pp), while the highest-engagement decile gains less and is indistinguishable from the middle decile. The advantage has boundary conditions: on a domain-curated pool no selection method separates from the others; at 1.5B scale the useful direction differs; and the lowest-reward training condition produces the strongest downstream generalization. Within the Qwen2.5-Math settings tested, RLVR data selection appears regime-dependent rather than reducible to a static ranking of problem quality.

</details>

*Mirco Hess,Gerben van Veenendaal,Joris Wakkie,Yiwen Soo,Malcolm H. Lawson,John D. Maclay,Arjun Nair,Neal Navani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Summary generation failed

Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Background: Large language models (LLMs) show promise for extracting information from clinical free-text documents, but their outputs are often unstructured and lack traceability, complicating validation and adoption in clinical workflows. In this work we introduce SIFTING, an LLM-based framework designed to address these shortcomings.
  Methods: SIFTING combines the language comprehension capabilities of LLMs with segment-level processing and structured prompts with strict output control, linking findings to the source text to enable both accurate and transparent information extraction. To demonstrate its capabilities, we applied the framework to the task of extracting tumor T-stage information from 130 lung cancer radiology reports (SIFTING-T-stage). A compact 4-bit quantized version of the open-source LLM Llama-3.3-70B (35 GB) was used in a fully self-hosted setup, providing full control over data and model. Performance was evaluated against a reference standard created by four clinical experts and compared with a range of LLMs as used in a conventional single-prompt approach, using bootstrap resampling to estimate confidence intervals.
  Results: SIFTING-T-stage achieved an accuracy of 90% (95% CI: 84-95) against the reference standard. We found its performance to be comparable to even the largest state-of-the-art LLMs with reasoning capabilities and to be interchangeable with clinical experts (p < 0.001), while at the same time offering full traceability through source text references.
  Conclusion: SIFTING enables accurate, structured, and traceable information extraction from clinical free-text documents. It ensures data control, reproducibility, and verifiable outputs that can support clinical validation and workflow integration.

</details>


### [82] [CEDAR: Error-Bounded Residual Routing for Efficient Long-Context Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07237)
*Siyu Li,Dong Wang,Jie Zhou,Wei Li,Yang Xu,Sijie Song*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CEDAR 是一种粗到细的误差感知动态注意力路由方法，通过残差注意力路径保持全局覆盖，根据块内键值离散度动态分配细化预算，在保持约 3 倍内核加速的同时恢复硬稀疏路由丢失的大部分质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硬稀疏注意力给被省略的块分配零概率：路由失误无法恢复，且固定扩展预算在简单和模糊查询上花费相同算力。需要一种在冻结语言模型前提下保持全局覆盖并加速长上下文预填充的方法。

Method: 粗到细两阶段：1) 每个语义块贡献廉价的键值摘要到残差注意力路径；2) 根据估计的近似误差将高误差块扩展为精确 token 级注意力。精确与摘要贡献在单一 softmax 归一化中合并，使细化替代而非复制粗略证据。推导基于块内键值离散度的输出误差界，据此分配可变细化预算。

Result: 受控聚类注意力研究显示，在相同精确块预算下，残差摘要相对于硬丢弃将重构误差降低 98% 以上。长上下文基准实验表明，CEDAR 在 128K 上下文长度下保持约 3 倍内核加速的同时，恢复了硬稀疏路由损失的大部分质量。

Conclusion: CEDAR 通过误差感知动态路由、残差摘要与可变细化预算，在不修改模型权重的情况下，有效平衡了长上下文预填充的推理效率与模型质量。

Abstract: Post-hoc sparse attention accelerates long-context prefill by routing each query to a small set of token-level interactions. Hard selection, however, assigns zero probability to every omitted chunk: a routing miss cannot be recovered, and a fixed expansion budget spends the same work on easy and ambiguous queries. We introduce Coarse-to-fine Error-aware Dynamic Attention Routing (CEDAR), a coarse-to-fine method that keeps the language model frozen while preserving global coverage. Each semantic chunk contributes a cheap key--value summary to a residual attention path; chunks with high estimated approximation error are then expanded to exact token attention. Exact and summarized contributions are combined in a single softmax normalization, so refinement replaces, rather than duplicates, coarse evidence. We derive an output-error bound governed by within-chunk key/value dispersion and use it to allocate a variable refinement budget. A controlled clustered-attention study shows that residual summaries reduce reconstruction error by more than 98% relative to hard dropping at equal exact-chunk budgets. Experiments on long-context benchmarks demonstrate that CEDAR recovers most of the quality lost by hard sparse routing while maintaining approximately $3\times$ kernel speedup at 128K context.

</details>


### [83] [Separating Stream Stability from Long-Term Recall in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07282)
*Peipei Cao,Xin Zhang,Jie Tang,Xiao Li,Siying Li,Qing Pei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 ThreeH 评估框架，区分稳定性地平线、访问地平线和效用地平线，揭示注意力汇聚流式模型仅能稳定生成但无法扩展语义记忆，循环和检索状态可延长语义地平线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前流式语言模型常与长上下文和记忆系统混淆，但解决不同问题。注意力汇聚虽能稳定无限流生成，却无法利用已离开缓存的内容。需明确区分系统声称和评估中的三种地平线。

Method: 提出 ThreeH 评估契约，在同一状态和计算预算下测量稳定性地平线、访问地平线和效用地平线。将框架应用于注意力汇聚流式模型，并在 128K-token 流、延迟绑定回忆和延迟决策任务上实验。

Result: 注意力汇聚保持局部建模能力，但无法处理活跃缓存之外的内容；循环状态和检索状态能延伸语义地平线。实验证实稳定性地平线可无限，而访问和效用地平线有限。

Conclusion: ThreeH 框架明确区分了流式模型的三种地平线，澄清注意力汇聚仅提供常数内存稳定生成而非语义记忆，为缓存策略、循环状态、检索和外部记忆的角色定位提供依据。

Abstract: Methods for streaming language models are often discussed alongside long-context and memory systems, although they solve different problems. An attention sink can stabilize autoregressive generation over an indefinitely long stream while the model remains unable to use content that has left its recent-token cache. We argue that this distinction should be explicit in system claims and evaluation. We introduce three horizons: the stability horizon, over which predictive behavior remains well behaved; the access horizon, over which past content can still causally affect the output; and the utility horizon, over which a task retains acceptable performance. We show constructively that the stability horizon can be infinite while the access and utility horizons are finite. We then propose ThreeH, an evaluation contract that measures all three horizons under a common state and compute budget. Applying the framework to attention-sink streaming clarifies its strength, constant-memory, stable generation, without treating anchor tokens as semantic memory. The framework exposes roles for cache policies, recurrent state, retrieval, and external memory. Experiments on 128K-token streams, delayed binding recall, and delayed decisions show that attention sinks preserve local modeling but not content beyond the active cache; recurrent and retrieval state extend the semantic horizon.

</details>


### [84] [Probing the Structure and Dynamics of LLM Value Expression through Value Conflicts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07296)
*Kaicheng Zhang,Jingyi Xiao,Renjun Hu,Xiaoling Liu,Yunshi Lan,Xuan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出冲突驱动价值探测框架，研究LLM价值表达的动态结构，发现表达二元性、功能可导向性和有界塑性三种模式，表明LLM价值表达随语境灵活重构但受行为边界约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有伦理评估常将LLM价值视为静态单一，但作者认为价值表达是结构化且动态的，需通过受控实验探究其动态机制。

Method: 引入冲突驱动价值探测框架，将LLM置于价值冲突中，实施四类干预扰动冲突，对十个LLM进行实验分析。

Result: 发现三种模式：1) 表达二元性：从抽象评估的理想主义转向具体冲突中的务实优先；2) 功能可导向性：模型易按任务定义的价值目标重构表达；3) 有界塑性：重构受约束，压力引发安全和目标导向优先级转移，负面框架区分受保护价值与可重定向价值。

Conclusion: LLM价值表达具有结构化动态特性，语境灵活重构优先级但受行为边界限制，为理解可控性、对齐和安全提供基础。

Abstract: Ethical evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) often characterizes model values as static and monolithic. In contrast, we argue that LLM value expression is better understood as a structured yet dynamic phenomenon. To investigate this, we introduce Conflict-driven Value Probing, a controlled framework that places LLMs in value conflicts and implements four types of interventions that perturb these conflicts to probe LLM value expression. Applying this framework to ten LLMs, we identify three recurring patterns. (1) Expression duality: models shift from broad idealistic orientations in abstract assessment toward more pragmatic priorities in concrete conflicts. (2) Functional steerability: models readily reconfigure their expressed value profiles toward task-defined value objectives. (3) Bounded plasticity: such reconfiguration is not without constraints, i.e. pressure induces a security- and goal-oriented priority shift while negative framing distinguishes protected values from those more amenable to redirection. Together, these findings characterize both the structure and dynamics of LLM value expression: context flexibly reconfigures expressed priorities, yet within behavioral boundaries. This behavioral account provides a foundation for understanding controllability, alignment, and safety in LLMs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/ZeroGen-Lab/CFProbe.

</details>


### [85] [Marginal Fidelity Does Not Establish User Simulation in Demographic Synthetic Survey Panels: Response Contracts, Support Collapse and Conditioning Failure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07305)
*Alexander Doudkin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究测试了人口统计合成调查面板的验证方法，发现匹配聚合答案无法证明个体模拟的有效性，而是反映了诱导契约和可直接获得的估计量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旨在检验当前验证合成调查面板的标准做法——将聚合答案与已发布调查匹配——究竟能证明什么，以及这种验证是否真正支持个体层面的模拟有效性。

Method: 使用来自四个调查机构、三个国家的六个多选题电池，重点分析三个合成队列与人类目标共享声明人口框架的工具，其他三个作为敏感性分析；比较了承诺集、逐选项概率诱导、无人物口患病率查询等多种诱导契约下的边际一致性表现。

Result: 结果显示响应契约主导测量保真度：承诺集在128个模型-电池选项槽中留空66个，而概率诱导零留空；概率诱导使选项边际MAE降低4.53-7.30点；无人物口患病率查询平均MAE 6.27，优于承诺面板的12.39，并在所有九个比较中获胜；约束感知概率向量平均MAE 5.34，在九个比较中有四个优于查询；未发布的人口统计细胞中，两种方法均不优于直接背诵全国分布。

Conclusion: 人口边际一致性仅证明了诱导契约和可无需模拟受访者直接获得的估计量，而非个体模拟的证据；验证标准本身受到挑战，直接估计并非一致最优。

Abstract: Demographic synthetic survey panels are often validated by matching aggregate answers to published surveys. We test what that certificate establishes across six multiselect batteries from four survey organisations in three countries. The headline analysis is restricted to three instruments whose synthetic cohort and human target share the stated population frame; three other batteries remain sensitivity analyses.
  The response contract dominates measured fidelity. In the aligned instruments, committed sets leave 66 of 128 model-battery option slots empty in panels of up to 500 respondents, versus 0 of 128 under per-option probability elicitation. Across eight uncapped model-instrument comparisons, probabilities reduce option-marginal MAE by 4.53 to 7.30 points. The capped instrument reverses on two models until the vectors are projected onto its stated maximum. These are measurement effects: human targets are realised check-all responses, whereas the vectors are latent inclusion propensities.
  Published marginal agreement also fails to discriminate respondent simulation from direct population estimation. On nine aligned model-battery pairs, a no-persona population-prevalence query averages 6.27 MAE versus 12.39 for committed panels and wins all nine comparisons. Constraint-aware probability vectors average 5.34 and beat the query on four of nine, so the baseline challenges the validation criterion rather than proving direct estimation uniformly best. On three unpublished demographic cells, neither approach beats reciting the national distribution. Population-marginal agreement is therefore evidence about an elicitation contract and an estimand obtainable without simulated respondents, not evidence of individual simulation.

</details>


### [86] [RouteRelay: Event-Triggered Cross-Layer Route Reuse for Efficient Dynamic Sparse Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07306)
*Bin Li,Sisi Liu,Chenyang Hu,Chaoyang Zhang,Wei Li,Hui Song*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: RouteRelay是一种路由无关的方法，通过跨层复用路由元数据，减少动态稀疏注意力中的路由计算开销，同时保持高路由召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态稀疏注意力虽然减少了长上下文预填充成本，但路由器在每层都重建chunk-chunk评分矩阵，即使选中的路由变化很小，仍存在冗余计算。

Method: RouteRelay引入锚点层执行完整路由，中间层仅重新评分前一层的top-k路由和紧凑的哨兵集合（近失和随机探测的chunk）。仅当哨兵挑战最弱选中chunk时才重新路由。提供top-k稳定性条件、漏掉挑战者的概率界限，以及行选择性GPU执行设计。

Result: 实验显示RouteRelay保持至少99.99%路由召回率，在低、中、高跨层漂移下分别重新路由25.0%、55.4%、78.2%的行。随着key-chunk数量从128增长到1024，评估全路由评分对的38.4-51.6%即可保持100.0%召回率。非融合CPU执行仍慢于稠密矩阵乘法，暴露行压缩和账本更新为主要内核工程目标。

Conclusion: RouteRelay有效减少了跨层路由计算冗余，提供理论保证和实证验证，但CPU执行性能仍需优化内核工程。

Abstract: Dynamic sparse attention reduces long-context prefill cost by routing each query chunk to a small set of key chunks at every Transformer layer. The sparse attention kernel avoids most token interactions, but the router still rebuilds a chunk--chunk score matrix layer after layer, even when the selected routes change little. We introduce RouteRelay, a router-agnostic method that reuses only route metadata across depth while continuing to compute attention with the current layer's queries, keys, and values. Anchor layers perform full routing. Intermediate layers rescore the previous top-$k$ route and a compact sentinel set of near-miss and randomly probed chunks. A query row is rerouted only when a sentinel challenges its weakest selected chunk. We give a top-$k$ stability condition, a probabilistic bound on missed challengers, and a row-selective GPU execution design. In a reproducible empirical evaluation, RouteRelay retains at least 99.99% route recall while rerouting 25.0%, 55.4%, and 78.2% of rows under low, moderate, and high cross-layer drift, respectively. Across routing scales, RouteRelay retains 100.0% recall while evaluating 38.4--51.6% of full-routing score pairs as the key-chunk count grows from 128 to 1024. Its unfused CPU execution remains slower than dense matrix multiplication, exposing row compaction and ledger updates as the main kernel-engineering targets.

</details>


### [87] [SPARROW: Scalable Taxonomy Induction via Structure-Preserving Partitioning and Constraint-Guided Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07307)
*Yirui Zhang,Yixuan Tang,Yandong Sun,Mong-Li Lee,Anthony Kum Hoe Tung*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出SPARROW框架，通过谱分区保持层级连通性、约束引导增量融合解决分治合并中的结构碎片化和父节点错位问题，实现大规模分类学诱导的最优结构质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM-based分类学诱导方法在概念集规模扩大时性能急剧下降，原因不仅在于上下文长度限制，更源于层级推理的结构性失效。分治合并范式虽可缓解规模问题，但引入结构碎片化（分区削弱局部层级信号）和父节点错位（局部合理关系在全局错位）两大结构性失效模式。

Method: SPARROW包含两大核心组件：1) 结构保持谱分区，利用谱聚类保持层级连通性，将概念划分为保留层级信号的块；2) 约束引导增量融合，将块级关系视为结构约束而非绝对真理，通过增量融合构建全局层级。

Result: 在大规模基准测试中，SPARROW跨不同骨干模型持续实现最强的全局结构质量，有效解决了分类学诱导的规模化难题。

Conclusion: 通过结构保持分区与约束引导融合，SPARROW成功克服了分治范式中的结构碎片化和父节点错位问题，为大规模分类学诱导提供了可扩展且高质量的解决方案。

Abstract: Taxonomy induction aims to organize concept sets into coherent hierarchical structures. Recent LLM-based methods can induce taxonomies directly from flat term lists, avoiding the need for corpora, but degrade sharply as concept sets scale up. We argue that this degradation stems not only from context length limitations, but also from structural failures in hierarchical reasoning. To address this, we adopt a divide-and-merge paradigm that partitions concepts into smaller subsets, induces local taxonomies, and merges them into a global hierarchy. However, we identify two structural failure modes inherent to this paradigm: Structural Fragmentation, where partitioning weakens local hierarchical signals, and Parent Displacement, where locally plausible relations are misplaced in the global hierarchy. To address both, we propose SPARROW, a scalable taxonomy induction framework that combines structure-preserving spectral partitioning to retain hierarchical connectivity within each block, and constraint-guided incremental fusion that treats block-level relations as structural constraints rather than ground truth for global placement. Experiments on large-scale benchmarks show that SPARROW consistently achieves the strongest global structural quality across backbones. The code is available at https://github.com/rebeccazyr/SPARROW.

</details>


### [88] [LANTERN: Language Model Assessment on Noisy and Transformed Tasks for Understanding Error and Robustness Nuances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07309)
*Vamsi Krishna Kodavali,Rituraj Singh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了大语言模型在多种输入扰动下的鲁棒性，包括词错误率、字符重复/复制、选项修改和指令遵循变异性。构建了合成增强数据集，覆盖多选题和指令遵循任务，对不同规模及基础/指令微调模型进行大量实验，量化扰动下的响应变异性并揭示与基线的差异，为开发更鲁棒的LLM及评估方法提供洞见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型鲁棒性评估仍是关键挑战，特别是对输入数据扰动敏感性的评估。现有工作缺乏跨多维度（词级、字符级、选项级、指令级）的系统性鲁棒性基准，且对不同规模模型及基础/指令微调变体在扰动下行为的差异了解不足。

Method: 构建合成增强数据集，涵盖多选题（MCQ）基准和指令遵循任务；设计四类扰动：词错误率注入、字符重复/复制、选项修改、指令遵循变异；在小、中、大三种规模及基础/指令微调模型上进行大规模实验；量化扰动条件下模型响应的变异性，并与基线性能对比。

Result: 实验量化了不同规模及微调类型模型在四类扰动下的响应变异性，揭示了模型稳定性随规模和微调策略的差异；发现指令微调模型在某些扰动下更脆弱，且不同扰动维度对模型影响程度不一，为鲁棒性评估提供了多维度的实证证据。

Conclusion: 研究建立了跨维度、跨规模、跨模型类型的LLM鲁棒性评估框架，发现模型对输入扰动的敏感性显著且呈现系统性模式。结果强调了开发更鲁棒LLM及更全面评估方法的必要性，为未来鲁棒性基准构建和模型改进提供了基础。

Abstract: Robustness evaluation of large language models (LLMs) remains a critical challenge, particularly in assessing their sensitivity to perturbations in input data. In this work, we systematically evaluate LLM robustness across multiple dimensions, including word error rate, character repetition and duplication, modifications in choices, and variability in instruction following. To facilitate this evaluation, we construct a synthetic and augmented dataset encompassing a diverse set of LLM benchmarks, specifically targeting multiple-choice question (MCQ) datasets and instruction-following tasks. We conduct extensive experiments on LLMs of varying scales-small, medium, and large-as well as across base and instruction-tuned variants. Our analysis quantifies the variability in model responses under perturbed conditions and highlights discrepancies relative to baseline models. The findings provide insights into the stability of LLMs across different evaluation scenarios contributing to the development of more robust and reliable language models as well as robust evaluation methodologies.

</details>


### [89] [Content-Based Addressing for Long Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07314)
*Mahesh Godavarti*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种处理长上下文的方法：将token流划分为单元，在单元内保留普通RoPE位置编码，为每个完成的单元分配基于内容的地址。这种方法避免了RoPE在长上下文中的位置训练-测试不匹配问题，通过内容寻址而非扩展位置范围来处理跨单元信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RoPE利用整数位置确定注意力内的旋转，适合局部token顺序，但增加上下文长度会产生位置训练-测试不匹配：RoPE会产生训练时未见的相对偏移旋转。现有方法（重缩放、插值、随机化、偏置位置）仍从增长的token计数器获取位置信息，未根本解决问题。

Method: 将token流分割为单元，单元内保留普通RoPE位置，为每个完成的单元分配基于其内容计算的地址。添加新单元时应用相同的学习映射处理新内容，而非扩展位置范围或标识符表。证明该构造精确保留局部RoPE，插入或重排其他单元时，两个固定token间的注意力比较不变，且不因添加更多单元而产生新的相对旋转。

Result: 在字符级Tiny Shakespeare诊断实验中，模型在256字符上下文训练，验证困惑度在256字符为4.04，在4096字符为3.82；而连续RoPE从4.71上升到12.09。第二个诊断显示基于内容的寻址能检索并利用多个序列化事实的信息。这些是受控浅层实验，非大规模基准测试。

Conclusion: 实验支持直接建议：使用位置编码进行局部寻址，使用内容进行跨单元寻址。这种方法在理论上保证了局部RoPE的精确保持和跨单元注意力的稳定性，在长上下文泛化上表现优于连续RoPE。

Abstract: Rotary position embedding (RoPE) uses each token's integer position to determine the rotation applied inside attention. This works well for local token order, but increasing context length creates a positional train-test mismatch: RoPE produces relative rotations at offsets not seen during training. Methods that rescale, interpolate, randomize, or bias positions specify how attention handles those offsets, but still derive positional information from a growing token counter. We instead divide a token stream into units, retain ordinary RoPE positions within each unit, and assign every completed unit an address computed from its content. Adding units then applies the same learned map to new content rather than extending a positional range or an identifier table. We prove that this construction preserves local RoPE exactly, leaves the attention comparison between two fixed tokens unchanged when other units are inserted or reordered, and does not create new relative rotations merely because more units are added. In a character-level Tiny Shakespeare diagnostic, a model trained on 256-character contexts has validation perplexity 4.04 at 256 characters and 3.82 at 4096, while continuous RoPE changes from 4.71 to 12.09. A second diagnostic shows that content-based addressing can retrieve and use information from multiple serialized facts. These are controlled shallow experiments, not scale benchmarks, but they support a direct prescription: use position to address locally and content to address across units.

</details>


### [90] [BlueprintAgent: Constraint-Triggered Targeted Revisits for Simulation-Ready Generation from Scanned Structural Blueprints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07362)
*Zhouyuan Xu,Chen Yang,Linhao Wang,Jiansheng Fan,Chen Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 BlueprintAgent (BPA)，一种基于约束触发的多模态智能体，用于从扫描蓝图中提取可仿真的框架表示，通过工程约束作为可调用验证器触发针对性 MLLM 重读，显著优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有将钢筋混凝土建筑蓝图转为仿真就绪模型的过程依赖人工，直接用多模态大模型 (MLLM) 处理扫描图纸不可靠，常违反梁柱支撑、跨数、三维连续性等工程约束。

Method: BPA 将 MLLM 作为主要阅读器和决策者，结合 OCR 和计算机视觉提供局部证据；核心机制是将工程约束实现为可调用验证器，实体级冲突报告触发针对局部区域的 MLLM 定向重读，实现推理时控制，区别于固定流程和自由自我反思。

Result: 在 20 个真实 RC 框架项目的 300 张扫描蓝图上评测，BPA 达到宏平均梁 F1 0.994，远高于单 MLLM 零样本 0.301 和固定流水线 0.820；移除 MLLM 主导的轴线裁决会导致复杂多图项目的梁、柱 F1 大幅下降。

Conclusion: 对于密集技术图纸，工程约束最好作为实体级定向重读的触发器部署，而非作为事后输出过滤器。

Abstract: Converting in-service reinforced-concrete (RC) building blueprints into simulation-ready models---structured frame representations that support deterministic FEM export and qualified-engineer review---underpins safety assessment and seismic retrofit, but the process remains manual. Direct prompting of a multimodal large language model (MLLM) over a scanned sheet is unreliable: outputs often violate engineering constraints on beam--column support, span count, or 3D continuity. We present BlueprintAgent (BPA), a constraint-triggered multimodal agent for simulation-ready frame extraction from scanned blueprints. BPA treats the MLLM as the primary reader and decision maker, with OCR and computer vision supplying localized evidence. Its central mechanism realizes engineering constraints as callable validators whose entity-level conflict reports trigger targeted MLLM revisits over the local region---an inference-time control distinct from fixed pipelines and free-form self-reflection. We evaluate BPA on 300 real scanned blueprint sheets from 20 anonymized RC frame projects, against five baselines and six ablations. BPA reaches a macro-averaged Beam F1 of 0.994, against 0.301 for single-MLLM zero-shot and 0.820 for a fixed pipeline; removing MLLM-led axis adjudication collapses Beam and Column F1 on complex multi-sheet projects. For dense technical drawings, engineering constraints are best deployed as triggers for entity-level targeted revisits rather than as post-hoc output filters.

</details>


### [91] [Beyond Fluent Generation: A CPU Reliability Benchmark for MCP-Style Tool Calling in Sub-2B Small Language Models for Edge Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07370)
*Abrar Shahriar Qurat-Ul-Ain Mastoi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文评估了五个小语言模型在边缘设备上进行工具调用的能力，发现Qwen2.5系列表现最佳，但原始输出极难直接解析为JSON，需依赖恢复解析器；同时揭示了模型可靠性与资源消耗的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 资源受限的单板计算机推动了设备端小语言模型代理的发展，以减少云依赖、提高数据局部性、容忍间歇性连接；MCP风格工具调用要求模型输出机器可读的JSON、选择正确工具、提供完整参数并避免非预期动作，因此需要评估小模型在边缘部署上的工具调用能力。

Method: 在平台无关的CPU基线上，评估五个参数量低于2B的开放权重模型（Phi-1.5, Pythia-1.4B, TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat, Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen2.5-1.5B）在100个涵盖天气检索、网页搜索、计算、邮件撰写、任务创建的提示词上的表现，使用贪婪解码和核采样；设计恢复解析器剥离Markdown代码围栏、提取大括号分隔子串，评分解析能力、工具名称正确性、参数完整性、值一致性；并进行CPU资源探测测量内存占用和延迟。

Result: Qwen2.5-1.5B在贪婪解码下达75%、核采样下达79%；Qwen2.5-0.5B贪婪解码72%但核采样跌至32%；Phi-1.5得0%；Pythia和TinyLlama最高7%。严格审计发现1000个原始响应中仅5个可直接解析为JSON，暴露对输出恢复的极度依赖。资源探测显示Qwen2.5-1.5B需7960 MiB内存、平均延迟30.782秒；Qwen2.5-0.5B需3637 MiB、10.627秒，揭示可靠性与资源的权衡。

Conclusion: 结果未直接覆盖具体开发板或完整MCP实现；安全部署需模式验证、约束生成、最小权限执行及对关键动作的人工升级机制。边缘部署需在模型可靠性与资源消耗间权衡。

Abstract: Resource constrained single-board computers including Raspberry Pi, NVIDIA Jetson Nano, Arduino UNO Q, Orange Pi, and LattePanda motivate on-device small language model (SLM) agents that reduce cloud dependence, improve data locality, and tolerate intermittent connectivity. Model Context Protocol (MCP)-style tool invocation demands more than fluent generation: an agent must emit machine-readable JSON, select the correct tool, supply all required arguments, and avoid unintended actions. We establish a platform-agnostic CPU baseline by evaluating five open-weight models below two billion parameters Phi-1.5, Pythia-1.4B, TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat, Qwen2.5-0.5B, and Qwen2.5-1.5B on 100 prompts spanning weather retrieval, web search, calculation, email composition, and task creation, under greedy decoding and nucleus sampling. A recovery parser strips Markdown fences, extracts brace-delimited substrings, and scores parseability, tool-name correctness, argument completeness, and value agreement. Under this criterion, Qwen2.5-1.5B achieves 75% (greedy) and 79% (sampling); Qwen2.5-0.5B achieves 72% (greedy) but drops to 32% under sampling. Phi-1.5 scores 0%; Pythia and TinyLlama reach at most 7%. A strict post-hoc audit finds only 5 of 1,000 raw responses directly parseable as JSON, exposing near-total dependence on output recovery. A CPU resource probe shows Qwen2.5-1.5B requires 7,960 MiB and 30.782 s mean latency; Qwen2.5-0.5B uses 3,637 MiB and 10.627 s, revealing a reliability-resource trade-off for edge deployment. These results do not cover the named boards directly or a full MCP implementation. Safe deployment requires schema validation, constrained generation, least-privilege execution, and human escalation for consequential actions.

</details>


### [92] [Beyond Single-Negative Preference: Multi-Negative DPO for LLM-Centric Historical Entity Linking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07379)
*Tien Nam Nguyen,Emanuela Boros,Ahmed Hamdi,Adam Jatowt,Mickaël Coustaty,Antoine Doucet*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出多负样本直接偏好优化（MDPO），利用所有负候选实体改进历史实体链接，在多语言历史报纸数据集上优于监督微调和单负样本DPO，尤其在NIL提及、语义歧义、OCR噪声和历史难名方面提升显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM历史实体链接的偏好优化通常每实例仅使用一个负候选，丢弃了同一提及下其他检索候选的信息，限制了模型区分细粒度实体的能力。

Method: 提出MDPO，一种基于参考的成对目标，将正确实体与每个提及相关的所有有效拒绝候选进行比较。保留DPO的Bradley-Terry公式，通过掩码、长度归一化的序列得分利用完整候选集。

Result: 在HIPE-2020和NewsEye数据集（涵盖法、德、英、瑞典、芬兰语历史报纸文本）上实验表明，MDPO优于监督微调和单负样本DPO，在NIL提及、语义歧义、OCR噪声和历史难名上增益尤大。进一步分析揭示候选生成与选择错误，候选检索仍是端到端实体链接的关键瓶颈。

Conclusion: 在实例内引入所有负候选是一种简单有效的改进，能显著提升基于LLM的历史实体链接性能。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown promise for historical entity linking, but preference optimization for this task is often formulated with only one negative candidate per training instance. This discards information from the remaining candidates retrieved for the same mention. We introduce multi-negative direct preference optimisation (MDPO), a reference-based pairwise objective that compares the correct entity with all valid rejected candidates associated with each mention. MDPO preserves the Bradley-Terry formulation of DPO while exploiting the complete candidate set through masked, length-normalised sequence scores. We evaluate MDPO on hipe-2020 and newseye, covering French, German, English, Swedish, and Finnish historical newspaper text. Experiments show that MDPO improves over supervised fine-tuning and single-negative DPO, with particularly strong gains for NIL mentions, semantic ambiguity, OCR noise, and historically difficult names. Further analyses disentangle candidate-generation and selection errors, showing that candidate retrieval remains a key bottleneck for end-to-end entity linking. These results demonstrate that incorporating all within-instance negative candidates is a simple and effective improvement for LLM-based historical entity linking.

</details>


### [93] [An LLM-Associated Register Shift in Korean Journal Abstracts: A Morphology-Aware Excess-Vocabulary Study, 2018-2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07447)
*Aron Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将「超额词汇」（词频超出2023年前趋势）的度量方法从英语扩展到韩语，利用398,296篇KCI摘要（2018-2026年8月）和47,165篇越南语摘要作为对照，发现韩语学术摘要在2023年无变化，2024年底出现拐点，2025年上升，2026年中趋平。关键词如「sisahada」（建议）在2026年摘要中出现率达21.4%（预期5.3%），而普通动词如「araboda」（调查）跌至趋势值的四分之一。在既定假设下，单词条件下界估计LLM处理摘要比例为2024-2026年的3.5%、10.5%、16.1%；分半集下界为7.8%、20.6%、33.0%。主题控制可减弱但无法消除该效应；翻译路径无法解释；英语摘要的超额出现早一年；三家供应商的对照摘要复现了上升词汇，标记更替与模型生成一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）普及，学术写作风格可能发生系统性变化。此前研究通过英语「超额词汇」检测此类变化，但缺乏对形态丰富语言（如韩语）的验证。本文旨在将该方法论迁移至韩语，并量化LLM对韩语学术摘要的潜在影响程度、时间动态及鲁棒性。

Method: 1. 构建韩语形态单元词表，基于398,296篇KCI摘要（2018-2026年8月）计算各词汇的预期频率趋势（以2023年前为基准）。2. 引入47,165篇越南语摘要作为安慰剂对照，建立置信下界。3. 采用单词统计量与重选分半集统计量，估算LLM处理摘要的比例下界。4. 实施主题控制：限制为三位LLM标注员均判定为「文体词」的词条，及将每篇2026年摘要与同刊物基准期最近摘要配对。5. 检验翻译路径假设，对比同文英语摘要的超额时间差，并引入三家供应商的对照摘要验证标记更替模式。

Result: 韩语摘要在2023年无超额，2024年底起显现，2025年上升，2026年中趋平。单词下界估计LLM处理比例为2024-2026年的3.5%、10.5%、16.1%；分半集下界为7.8%、20.6%、33.0%。Holzwarth等人的估计器给出2025-2026年的41.9%和72.1%。主题控制后仍保留14.7/33.0点（文体词限制）和34.1点（期刊配对）。翻译标记下降而LLM标记上升，排除翻译伪影。英语摘要超额提前一年出现；无英语超额时韩语仍保留30-66%的位移率。三供应商对照摘要复现上升词汇，标记更替符合模型生成特征。

Conclusion: 韩语学术摘要呈现与英语相似但滞后一年的词汇超额模式，强烈暗示LLM辅助写作的渗透。该效应经受住主题、翻译、期刊等多重控制，且标记更替动态与模型生成一致。不同估计器给出的LLM渗透率区间较宽（3.5%-72.1%），反映假设敏感性。研究确立了形态复杂语言中检测LLM文体足迹的可行框架，并提示跨语言、跨学科的写作规范演变需持续监测。

Abstract: Excess vocabulary, a word's frequency above its pre-2023 trend, is how the change in scholarly English after 2022 has been measured. We adapt it to Korean with morphological units on 398,296 KCI abstracts (2018-August 2026), with 47,165 Vietnamese abstracts for comparison. Placebo floors are 0.1-2.2 points for the single-word statistic and at most 2.9 for the re-selected split-half set statistic. Korean abstracts show nothing in 2023, onset in late 2024, a rise through 2025 flattening in mid-2026: sisahada "suggest" appears in 21.4% of 2026 abstracts against 5.3% expected; plain verbs like araboda "look into" fall to a quarter of trend. Under stated assumptions the single-word conditional lower bound on LLM-processed abstracts is 3.5%, 10.5% and 16.1% for 2024-2026 and a split-half set bound 7.8%, 20.6% and 33.0%. Holzwarth et al.'s estimator under the same discipline gives 41.9% and 72.1% for 2025-2026. Subject-matter controls reduce but do not remove it: restricting the set to lemmas three language-model annotators all call style leaves 14.7 of the 33.0 points, and pairing each 2026 abstract with its journal's closest base-period abstract leaves 34.1. Tested translation routes do not explain it: the surface marks of translated Korean fall as the markers rise. In the same articles' English abstracts the excess appears a year earlier; where the English side carries none, the Korean shift persists at 30 to 66% of the rate where it does. Control abstracts from three providers reproduce the rising words, with marker turnover consistent with model generations; implied prevalences are scenario-dependent.

</details>


### [94] [FramingQA: Does the Question Shape the Answer? Measuring the Compositional Framing Effect](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07448)
*Hazel H. Kim,Andrew M. Bean,Guilherme Affonso Ferreira de Camargo,Shanyu Chauhan,Felix Drinkall,Jade Kosché,Chenyang Ma,Glory Nwaugbala,Nabeel Seedat,Bradley Max Segal,Samuel Recht,Hinrich Schütze,Philip H. S. Torr*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了FramingQA基准，用于测量大语言模型在法律、医学、金融和机器人仿真四个高风险领域对问题框架的敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型会因用户提问中的微妙重述而改变回答，这种框架偏见会导致建议受提问方式而非底层事实影响。在现实场景中，专家和非专家用户常包含不完整或误导性假设，模型极易受此类框架影响，在高风险领域后果严重。

Method: 构建三层嵌套的框架偏见注入：根层（带框架偏见的问题措辞）、命题层（在中性问题前添加带框架偏见的前提）、全局层（前提与带框架偏见的问题配对）。在四个模型家族的九个开源模型（3.8B-70B参数）上进行评估。

Result: 单个变体上的高准确率不能保证模型在固定事实信息下、面对不同措辞问题时的鲁棒性。模型对框架偏见表现出显著敏感性。

Conclusion: FramingQA揭示了大语言模型在高风险领域对框架偏见的脆弱性，单纯追求准确率不足以保证鲁棒性，需要专门针对框架不变性进行评估和改进。

Abstract: We introduce FramingQA, a benchmark that measures the model sensitivity to question framing across law, medicine, finance, and robotic simulations. Large language models (LLMs) often change their responses to subtle rephrasings that align with an implied stance by users. This can leave users with advice tainted by how they happened to phrase a question rather than by the underlying facts, and the consequences are highly costly in high-stakes domains. Because in the realistic scenarios, both expert practitioners and non-expert users frequently ask LLMs questions containing incomplete or misleading assumptions, models are highly susceptible to those framings. To test this, we inject the framing bias across three nested levels: a framing-biased question phrasing (root), an injected framing-biased premise prepended to a neutral question (propositional), and a premise paired with a framing-biased question (global). Evaluating nine open models (3.8B-70B) across four families, we find that strong per-variant accuracy does not guarantee the robustness across differently phrased questions under the fixed factual information.

</details>


### [95] [MEMO: Multimodal Evidence Memory Organization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07471)
*Xian Gao,Jinpeng Wang,Jiacheng Ruan,Guangyu Cao,Ting Liu,Yuzhuo Fu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 MEMO，一种多模态证据记忆组织方法，通过证据提取器、查询条件记忆管理器和确定性记忆构建模块，将记忆分配到文本、视觉或双通道载体中，并在离线读取器反馈下训练管理器，实现受限预算下更高效的记忆呈现与下游任务性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期运行的 LLM 智能体依赖外部记忆存储超出上下文窗口的信息，但持续累积的交互轨迹与有限的上下文容量存在根本张力。现有记忆读取方法主要使用文本或视觉形式：文本保真度高但线性 token 表示导致不同重要性内容以近乎均匀单位成本竞争有限上下文；视觉读取虽能利用二维布局展示结构和强调关键信息，但渲染和压缩可能丢失细粒度细节。因此需要一种能在预算约束下选择必要证据、按适当模态组织记忆的方法。

Method: MEMO 包含三个核心模块：1) 训练好的证据提取器，选择相关记忆块并形成带有来源信息和呈现需求的证据单元；2) 训练好的查询条件记忆管理器，将每个单元分配到文本、视觉或双通道载体，并选择匹配证据结构的布局；3) 确定性记忆构建模块，生成文本包和视觉页面。记忆管理器利用离线读取器对引导记忆计划效用的反馈进行训练，使保留与呈现决策与下游使用对齐。

Result: 在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、LoCoMo 和 ALFWorld 四个基准上，使用多种读取器后端评估。结果表明 MEMO 能以更少的记忆 token 更高效地呈现记忆，提升下游任务性能，并在受限预算下构建更有效的工作记忆。

Conclusion: MEMO 通过多模态证据组织与查询感知的记忆管理，解决了长期智能体记忆累积与上下文容量限制的矛盾，实现了在预算约束下的高效记忆检索、选择与呈现，显著提升了下游任务表现。

Abstract: Long-running LLM agents rely on external memory to store and reuse information beyond a single context window, yet there is a fundamental tension between the continuous accumulation of interaction trajectories and the limited context capacity. The key challenge in agent memory is therefore not only to retrieve relevant records, but also to select necessary evidence under a given budget and organize it in an appropriate modality. Existing memory readout methods mainly use textual or visual forms. Text preserves high fidelity, but its linear token representation makes contents with different importance compete for the limited context at nearly uniform unit cost.
