The results show that while larger datasets lead to increased model memory footprints and prediction latencies, the Canny edge detection preprocessing supplemented by Hessian filtering (used in DS_1 and DS_3) degrades the performance of most models. In our experiment, we observe that Random Forest (RF) maintains a stable memory footprint of 61 KB across all datasets, while models like KNN and SVM show significant increases in memory usage, from 5.7-7 KB on DS_0 to 102-220 KB on DS_2, and similar increases in prediction time. Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, and Naive Bayes show stable memory footprints and fast prediction times across all datasets. XGBoost's prediction time increases from 180-200 ms on DS_0 to 700-3000 ms on DS_2 (truncated)

</details>


### [335] [Revisiting Thinning Methods for Kernel Learning Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07432)
*Blanca Cano-Camarero,Yago R. Aguado-Carrillo-de-Albornoz,Ángela Fernández-Pascual,José R. Dorronsoro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了后向核驱赶算法，通过迭代移除数据点实现高效的数据子集选择，并在核变薄基础上提出灵活核变薄以支持任意大小的子集构建。实验表明，后向核驱赶在训练时间效率上最优，灵活核变薄在预测性能上常表现最佳，两者在不同场景下各有优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核方法因强理论保证和经验性能被广泛使用，但高计算成本限制其在大规模数据集上的应用。现有方法利用最大均值差异构建代表性子集，但存在计算效率低或仅支持特定压缩比（如逐次减半）的局限。

Method: 1. 后向核驱赶：从完整数据集出发，迭代移除点以保持再生核希尔伯特空间中的分布特性，适用于压缩比小于一半的场景。2. 灵活核变薄：扩展核变薄算法，突破仅支持逐次减半的限制，实现任意大小子集的构建，并引入监督信息指导稀疏化过程。

Result: 在高斯过程和核支持向量机实验中：后向核驱赶始终保持有竞争力的预测性能，且训练时间效率最优；灵活核变薄在中等压缩比下预测性能常表现最佳，内存消耗也具竞争力。两种方法在不同权衡需求下互补。

Conclusion: 没有单一方法在所有场景下占优，需根据预测性能、训练成本和内存需求的具体权衡选择降维策略。后向核驱赶适合计算效率优先场景，灵活核变薄适合追求最佳预测性能的中等压缩比场景。

Abstract: Kernel methods are widely used because of their strong theoretical guarantees and empirical performance. However, their high computational cost limits their applicability to large-scale datasets. To address this shortcoming, several approaches use Maximum Mean Discrepancy to construct representative subsets that preserve the properties of the full dataset in a Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space. We introduce Backward Kernel Herding, an algorithm that addresses this problem by iteratively removing points from the dataset, achieving results comparable to current state-of-the-art approaches while accelerating the subsampling process in realistic scenarios where the reduced size is less than half of the dataset. Moreover, we overcome a limitation of Kernel Thinning by proposing an extension that enables the construction of subsets of arbitrary size rather that restricting to successive halvings. Finally, we conduct an extensive experimental comparison focusing on the most relevant kernel learning procedures: Gaussian Processes and Kernel Support Vector Machines. The results show that Backward Kernel Herding consistently achieves competitive performance with the most favorable training-time efficiency, while the proposed Flexible Kernel Thinning frequently achieves the best predictive performance. These gains become especially pronounced for moderate compression ratios, highlighting the benefits of incorporating supervised information into the thinning process. In terms of memory consumption, Flexible Kernel Thinning is also competitive, whereas Backward Kernel Herding remains an alternative when computational efficiency is the primary objective. Overall, no single method dominates across all scenarios, underscoring the importance of selecting the reduction strategy according to the desired trade-off between predictive performance, training cost, and memory requirements.

</details>


### [336] [TabBench-Bio: A Living Benchmark for Machine Learning on High-Dimensional Biomedical Tables](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07441)
*Jules Kreuer,Sofiane Ouaari,Julia Hellmig,Julius Braitinger,Nico Pfeifer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文推出TabBench-Bio，一个包含43个生物医学数据集的活跃交互式基准，系统对比了经典估计器、神经网络和表格基础模型在28个特征-样本操作点上的表现，发现RealTabPFN v2.5在参考点（10k特征，100样本）上表现最佳，表格基础模型总体领先，但最优配置取决于操作点和生物医学模态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物医学表格数据常包含数千测量变量但仅有数十到数百标注样本，这一模式在通用表格基准中代表性不足，亟需针对性的基准来评估各类方法在这种高维小样本设定下的性能。

Method: 构建包含43个跨领域生物医学数据集的TabBench-Bio基准，采用统一交叉验证协议，在28个特征-样本操作点上对比经典估计器、神经网络和表格基础模型；使用配对bootstrap计算Elo评分区分模型；AutoGluon一小时极端预设作为资源密集型参考。

Result: 在参考点（10k特征，100训练样本），RealTabPFN v2.5点估计最高，Logistic Regression和TabDPT紧随其后且点估计几乎相同；配对bootstrap显示RealTabPFN v2.5领先Logistic Regression 145 Elo（95%区间[59,232]）；表格基础模型总体占据领先排名，但最强配置随操作点和生物医学模态而异。

Conclusion: TabBench-Bio为生物医学表格学习提供了可复现、可扩展的基准，揭示了表格基础模型在高维小样本设定下的优势，同时强调最优模型选择需考虑具体操作点和数据模态；基准设计为持续增长，欢迎社区贡献新数据集。

Abstract: Biomedical tables often combine thousands of measured variables with only tens or hundreds of labelled samples, a regime that is poorly represented in general-purpose tabular benchmarks. We introduce TabBench-Bio, a living and interactive benchmark of 43 biomedical datasets spanning multiple domains. Under a shared cross-validation protocol, we compare classical estimators, neural networks, and tabular foundation models across 28 feature-by-sample operating points. At the reference cell of 10,000 features and 100 training samples, RealTabPFN v2.5 has the highest point estimate, followed by Logistic Regression and TabDPT, whose point estimates are nearly identical. A paired bootstrap over the target pool separates RealTabPFN v2.5 from Logistic Regression by 145 Elo (95% interval [59, 232]). Tabular foundation models generally occupy the leading ranks, while the strongest configuration depends on the operating point and biomedical modality. The AutoML framework AutoGluon, using its one-hour "extreme" preset, is configured as a separate resource-intensive reference and is reported here at the reference cell. Fold-level predictions, run status, and deterministic aggregations make every reported result reproducible and reusable.
  We invite the community to contribute: TabBench-Bio is designed to grow, and we welcome submissions of new biomedical tabular datasets, particularly from underrepresented assays and clinical endpoints, for inclusion in future releases.
  The interactive leaderboard is available at: https://tabbench-bio.eu

</details>


### [337] [TASTE: Throughput-Aware Batch Size Tuning for On-Device Edge Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07444)
*Avik Bhatnagar,Federico Nicolas Peccia,Oliver Bringmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于贝叶斯优化的批量大小调优方法，用于边缘设备上的深度学习模型训练，结合梯度累积和线性学习率缩放，在树莓派4等平台上实现高达2倍的训练吞吐量提升，同时保持模型精度；在持续学习范式下，最优批量大小有效平衡了稳定性与可塑性，缓解灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着隐私保护AI的兴起，模型适应与个性化转向设备端学习，但资源受限硬件上需优化训练吞吐量并保持预测精度，现有方法缺乏针对批量大小的系统性调优策略。

Method: 引入基于贝叶斯优化的批量大小自动调优方法，结合梯度累积与线性学习率缩放，在标准监督学习（SL）和在线持续学习（CL）两种范式下评估其对学习动态的影响。

Result: 实验发现存在吞吐量上限，超过该阈值增大批量大小不再带来增益；提出的调优方法识别出最优批量大小，在树莓派4上相比最大批量大小实现高达2倍吞吐量提升，精度无损；在CL中，最优批量大小维持稳定性-可塑性平衡，有效缓解灾难性遗忘并最大化计算效率。

Conclusion: 基于贝叶斯优化的批量大小调优结合梯度累积和学习率缩放，能显著提升边缘设备训练吞吐量且不牺牲精度，且在持续学习场景下能有效平衡稳定性与可塑性，为设备端高效私有化训练提供实用方案。

Abstract: The rise of privacy-preserving artificial intelligence (AI) has shifted the focus of model adaptation and personalization towards on-device learning, where deep learning models are finetuned directly on edge hardware using local user data. However, this shift requires optimization of deep learning training on resource-constrained hardware to maximize throughput while maintaining predictive accuracy. This paper introduces a novel technique for on-device model training that incorporates an efficient Bayesian optimization-based batch size tuning approach to maximize hardware throughput. To evaluate the impact of this hyperparameter on the learning dynamics, we investigated two distinct paradigms: standard supervised learning (SL) and online continual learning (CL). Experimental results across various edge devices demonstrate a throughput ceiling, beyond which increasing the batch size yields no additional throughput gains. The proposed tuning approach identifies the optimal batch size, which, when combined with gradient accumulation and linear learning rate scaling, achieves up to a 2X increase in training throughput on platforms such as Raspberry Pi 4 compared to maximum batch sizes, without compromising model accuracy. Furthermore, in the CL paradigm, we demonstrate that optimal batch sizes maintain the stability-plasticity balance required for incremental learning, effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting while maximizing computational efficiency on edge-hardware.

</details>


### [338] [Temporal-Causal Inference for Reinforcement Learning via Automata Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07461)
*Jan Corazza,Daniil Kaminskyi,Simon Lutz,Patrick Nossol,Hadi Partovi Aria,Zhe Xu,Daniel Neider*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TCIRL 框架通过假设 DFA 和反例驱动 SAT 合成，在不可观测相位转换的非马尔可夫决策过程中联合学习策略并推断隐藏时间因果，理论证明收敛到真实因果 DFA 并获得最优策略，实验验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决强化学习中环境动态经历不可逆相位转换且相位由隐藏时间模式控制、智能体无法直接观测相位的问题，将其形式化为两阶段非马尔可夫决策过程。

Method: 提出 TCIRL 框架，维护假设确定性有限自动机 (DFA) 跟踪活跃相位，通过反例驱动的 SAT 求解器合成细化 DFA，联合学习控制策略并推断隐藏时间因果。

Result: 理论证明假设 DFA 几乎必然收敛到识别真实因果语言的 DFA，从而得到原非马尔可夫决策过程的最优策略；实验在基因治疗网格世界和交通信号环境中恢复正确因果 DFA 并达到全信息基线性能。

Conclusion: TCIRL 能在隐藏相位转换的非马尔可夫环境中有效推断时间因果并学习最优策略，具有理论收敛保证和实验验证。

Abstract: We consider reinforcement learning in environments with dynamics that undergo an irreversible phase transition governed by a hidden temporal pattern. The agent observes the base state but cannot observe the phase directly. We formalize this problem as a two-phase non-Markovian decision process and introduce Temporal-Causal Inference for Reinforcement Learning (TCIRL), a framework that jointly learns a control policy and infers the hidden temporal cause of the phase transition. TCIRL maintains a hypothesis deterministic finite automaton (DFA) to track what phase is active and refines it via counterexample-driven SAT-based synthesis. We prove that the hypothesis converges almost surely to a DFA recognizing the true cause language on all attainable label sequences, yielding an optimal policy for the original non-Markovian decision process. Experiments on a genetic therapy gridworld and a traffic signal environment show that TCIRL recovers the correct cause DFA and matches the full-information baseline in both domains.

</details>


### [339] [Improving Multivariate Time Series Classification with Class-Wise Training and Model Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07493)
*Mouhamadou Mansour Lo,Gildas Morvan,Mathieu Rossi,Fabrice Morganti,David Mercier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对多变量时间序列分类（MTSC）的类别级维度（通道）选择框架，为每个类别独立识别信息维度，随后进行专门学习并融合预测，以提升判别特征表示质量并降低噪声维度影响。基于 MiniRocket 基线实验表明，该方法在高维设置下显著改善表示质量并提升分类性能，同时增强鲁棒性和可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MTSC 方法通常采用全局维度选择，忽略了不同类别可能依赖不同信息通道的事实，导致噪声或非信息维度干扰判别特征学习。作者旨在引入类别特异性信息，显式识别各类别相关维度，从而生成更具判别力的特征表示，提升分类鲁棒性与可解释性。

Method: 提出类别级维度选择框架：1) 对每个类别独立进行维度选择，识别该类别最信息量的通道；2) 针对选定维度执行专门的学习过程（以 MiniRocket 为基线提取随机核特征）；3) 融合各类别的学习结果进行最终预测。该流程将类别先验融入训练，显式建模类别-维度相关性。

Result: 在异构数据集上的实验显示：类别级维度选择能持续提升 MiniRocket 的分类准确率，尤其在高维数据集上增益显著；提取的特征表示质量明显改善；方法在不同数据集上表现出一致的性能增益，验证了其鲁棒性；同时显式输出的类别相关维度提供了可解释性。

Conclusion: 将类别特异性信息纳入 MTSC 训练过程是一个有前景的方向。类别级维度选择通过减少噪声维度干扰、增强判别特征学习，实现了分类性能的稳健提升与可解释性的同时改善，为高维多变量时间序列分类提供了有效的新范式。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose a class-wise dimension (channel) selection framework for Multivariate Time Series Classification (MTSC). Rather than applying a single global dimension selection process, the proposed approach independently identifies informative dimensions for each class. A dedicated learning process is subsequently performed for each class, followed by a fusion stage for final prediction. The objective is to improve the generation of discriminative feature representations while reducing the influence of noisy or non-informative dimensions. The proposed framework is evaluated using MiniRocket, a random kernel-based baseline method. Experimental results indicate that class-wise dimension selection improves the quality of extracted representations and can enhance classification performance, particularly in high-dimensional settings. These findings suggest that incorporating class-specific information into the training process represents a promising direction for MTSC, improving robustness through consistent gains across heterogeneous datasets, and interpretability through the explicit identification of class-relevant dimensions.

</details>


### [340] [Statistical versus machine learning-based spatial interpolation of post-processed ensemble weather forecasts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07512)
*Mária Lakatos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究比较了多种统计和机器学习后处理方法在有观测和无观测站点上对ECMWF集合预报的2米气温和10米风速进行校正，提出了一种考虑海拔的线性池（ALP）用于气温，结果显示后处理普遍优于原始集合，但无单一方法全面最优，ALP在无观测站点上显著优于标准线性池。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统计后处理能改进集合天气预报，但在无观测站点生成校正预测仍具挑战性，因此需要比较不同方法在有观测和无观测站点上的表现。

Method: 采用基于EMOS的方法、分布回归网络、Transformer、图神经网络，在有限和扩展预测因子设置下进行对比；针对气温，还研究了线性预报组合并提出海拔感知线性池（ALP）。

Result: 后处理在大多数设置下均优于原始集合，但无单一方法在所有变量、站点组和评价指标上均最优；提出的ALP在无观测站点上比标准线性池有小幅但显著的提升。

Conclusion: 后处理普遍有效，但方法选择需视具体变量、站点和指标而定；ALP为无观测站点的气温预报校正提供了改进。

Abstract: Statistical post-processing improves ensemble weather forecasts, but generating calibrated predictions at locations without observations remains challenging. This study compares statistical and machine-learning-based methods for post-processing ECMWF 2-m temperature and 10-m wind speed forecasts at observed and unobserved stations in Germany. We consider EMOS-based approaches, distributional regression networks, Transformers, and graph neural networks under both limited and extended predictor settings. For temperature, we also investigate linear forecast combinations and propose an altitude-aware linear pool (ALP). The results show that post-processing improves upon the raw ensemble in most settings, but no single method performs best across all variables, station groups, and evaluation metrics. The proposed ALP provides a small but significant improvement over the standard linear pool at unobserved locations.

</details>


### [341] [CoRL: Co-Evolutionary Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Indirect Prompt-Injection Attacks and Defenses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07529)
*Boyang Zhang,Qingxin Xiao,Lingwei Dang,Qingyao Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CoRL框架，通过协同进化和修复防御工具增强语言代理中的间接提示注入（IPI），将自适应IPI建模为非对称部分可观察一般和马尔可夫博弈，三阶段训练攻击者与防御者，显著降低攻击成功率至0%并提升任务效用至76.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具增强语言代理易受间接提示注入攻击，攻击者将恶意指令隐藏于不可信工具输出中隐蔽篡改任务执行。现有基于固定攻击的防御在攻击者改变策略、注入位置和载荷时失效，亟需自适应防御机制。

Method: 将自适应IPI建模为非对称、部分可观察、一般和马尔可夫博弈。提出CoRL三阶段框架：1) Attacker SFT：从成功轨迹初始化多轮攻击；2) 双边Co-PPO：联合训练攻击者与防御者，采用角色特定奖励和历史对手种群；3) Defender SFT：巩固验证器接受的教师修复，针对种群发现的失败案例。

Result: 每个防御者1,514次干净、固定模板和自适应执行中，CoRL将总体ASR降低38.5个百分点至0.0%，将效用提升13.1个百分点至76.3%。消融实验证实在线Co-PPO和种群挖掘修复贡献显著。外部基准评估显示攻击抵抗力可迁移。防御者在评估攻击下平衡安全性与任务效用，保留的攻击者可作为自适应红队评估候选。

Conclusion: CoRL通过协同进化与修复有效防御自适应IPI，实现零攻击成功率同时保持高任务效用，为工具增强代理提供鲁棒安全保障，并生成攻击者用于持续红队测试，推动自适应安全评估体系建设。

Abstract: Tool-augmented language agents are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection (IPI). Unlike direct prompt injection, IPI hides adversarial instructions in untrusted tool outputs and can covertly alter the execution of a legitimate task. Defenses trained on fixed attacks may fail as an attacker changes its strategy, injection site, and payload. To address this problem, we formulate adaptive IPI as an asymmetric, partially observable, general-sum Markov game: a multi-turn attacker adapts payloads at reached tool-return sites from the public trajectory, while a tool-using defender must block the injected objective and complete the user task. We propose CoRL, a verifier-grounded co-evolution and repair framework with three stages: Attacker SFT initializes multi-turn attacks from successful trajectories; bilateral Co-PPO jointly trains both agents with role-specific rewards and historical opponent populations; and Defender SFT consolidates verifier-accepted teacher repairs for population-discovered failures. Across 1,514 clean, fixed-template, and adaptive executions per defender, CoRL reduces overall ASR by 38.5 points to 0.0% and raises utility by 13.1 points to 76.3%. Stage-wise and controlled ablations show positive contributions from online Co-PPO and population-mined repair, while external-benchmark evaluation indicates transfer in attack resistance. The defender balances safety and task utility under the evaluated attacks, while the retained attackers provide candidates for adaptive red-team evaluation.

</details>


### [342] [No-Regret Mixing of LRU and LFU with Optimal Switching Cost](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07566)
*Younes Ben Mazziane,Xinying Zou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文分析了缓存驱逐策略中LRU和LFU的组合方法，证明了LeCar策略面对非自适应对手时存在线性遗憾，并提出了基于Hedge算法的H-MC策略，该策略在保持遗憾界的同时最小化了切换成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的缓存驱逐策略如LeCar和Cacheus结合LRU和LFU并利用在线学习思想，虽经验表现良好，但缺乏理论保证：是否在所有请求序列上均能渐近达到LRU和LFU中较优者的性能（即是否实现次线性遗憾）仍不明确。

Method: 首先构造对抗性请求序列，证明LeCar即使拥有无限历史也会遭受线性遗憾。随后提出H-MC（Hedge-based Mixture of Caches），维护虚拟LRU和LFU缓存，利用Hedge算法计算选择概率，并设计联合选择规则以保持边际分布同时最小化切换成本。

Result: 理论证明了LeCar对非自适应对手存在线性遗憾；H-MC策略继承了Hedge的次线性遗憾保证（对最优固定专家），且在所有具有相同边际选择概率的联合规则中实现了最小的切换成本。

Conclusion: H-MC为缓存驱逐提供了首个同时具有理论遗憾保证和最小切换开销的LRU/LFU混合策略，解决了该领域长期存在的理论空白，为实际缓存系统设计提供了有原则的指导。

Abstract: Caching systems often rely on simple eviction policies such as Least Recently Used (LRU) and Least Frequently Used (LFU), which perform well in complementary request regimes. Recent policies such as LeCar and Cacheus combine LRU and LFU using ideas from the experts problem in online learning. Specifically, upon a miss, they randomize between the two eviction rules using probabilities derived from scores updated by tracking the history of past evictions. While these policies exhibit strong empirical performance, it remains unclear whether they are guaranteed, on every request sequence, to perform asymptotically as well as the better of LRU and LFU, i.e., whether they achieve sublinear regret with respect to this benchmark. We first show that LeCar suffers linear regret against an oblivious adversary, even with unbounded history. We then propose H-MC, a Hedge-based mixture of virtual LRU and LFU caches that preserves Hedge's selection probabilities, and hence its regret guarantees, while minimizing the switching cost among all joint selection rules with these marginals.

</details>


### [343] [Efficient Exploration Is Enough](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07575)
*Mikel Malagón,Jon Vadillo,Josu Ceberio,Michael Bowling,Jose A. Lozano*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种高效探索的新视角：将探索者定义为优先生成可泛化经验的智能体，即支持跨环境预测和适应的模型学习数据。通过预测和泛化的视角分析探索，理论证明最优高效探索者会自然安排轨迹优先访问最信息量大且可学习的区域，实验表明优化此内在目标能在简单环境中自动产生渐进式复杂行为课程，纯内在目标即可驱动高度复杂行为涌现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有探索方法通常依赖外部奖励、任务或目标，缺乏无需外部指导的持续复杂行为涌现机制。论文旨在建立一个基于预测和泛化的 principled 框架，使智能体-环境系统能在无外部奖励、任务或目标的情况下，维持开放式的日益复杂行为生成过程。

Method: 1. 重新定义高效探索者：优先生成可泛化经验（支持学习跨环境预测和适应模型的数据）。2. 通过预测和泛化视角分析探索。3. 理论分析：证明最优高效探索者自然调度轨迹，优先访问最信息量大且可学习区域。4. 实验验证：优化此内在目标，观察在相对简单环境中是否涌现渐进式复杂行为课程。

Result: 实验表明，仅优化该纯内在目标（生成可泛化经验）即可驱动高度复杂行为的涌现，并在相对简单环境中自动形成渐进式更复杂行为的课程。理论结果与实证结果一致，验证了框架的有效性。

Conclusion: 该框架为智能体-环境系统提供了一个 principled 机制，能在无外部奖励、任务或目标的情况下，维持开放式的日益复杂行为生成过程。这表明追求纯内在目标（可泛化经验生成）足以驱动复杂行为涌现，为开放式学习和自主技能获取提供了新的理论基础。

Abstract: This work introduces an alternative view of efficient exploration and studies its theoretical and empirical implications in the absence of extrinsic rewards. Specifically, we define efficient explorers as agents that prioritize generating generalizable experience, i.e., data that supports learning models capable of predicting and adapting across the environment. This allows us to analyze efficient exploration through the lens of prediction and generalization. Theoretically, we demonstrate that optimally efficient explorers naturally schedule their trajectories to visit the most informative and learnable regions first. Empirically, we show that optimizing for these agents gives rise to an automatic curriculum of progressively more complex behaviors, even in relatively simple environments. These results indicate that pursuing this purely intrinsic objective alone is enough to drive the emergence of highly sophisticated behaviors. We believe that this new framework provides a principled mechanism by which agent-environment systems may sustain an open-ended process of increasingly complex behavior without external rewards, tasks, or objectives.

</details>


### [344] [I Don't Miss You, but I Do: Self-Explanation Faithfulness of Modality Missingness in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07596)
*Aydin Javadov,Daniel Schoess,Florian von Wangenheim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种干预式协议，用于评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）对自身模态依赖性的自我解释能力。实验发现，VLMs 系统性地高估可用模态证据的充分性，大幅低估缺失模态恢复对预测的影响（预测变化率中位数 ≤8.8%，实际执行变化率高达 72.1%），且在 64 个模型-任务-条件设置中有 62 个出现低估。模型对证据不足的声称虽少见但精准（被标记案例中 78-100% 实际会改变答案）。事后自我解释呈现相同偏差：互补数据上过度归因单模态充分性，同构数据上过度归因单一表征充分性。结论指出 VLMs 系统性地错误刻画其预测对可用与缺失模态证据的依赖，主张以可执行干预作为评估多模态自我解释的行为真值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型越来越多地部署于部分输入模态可能不可用的场景，但目前鲜有研究探究它们是否能忠实解释缺失信息如何影响自身预测。理解模型对模态动态的自我认知偏差，对于构建可靠的多模态系统至关重要。

Method: 引入干预式评估协议：让模型陈述各模态单独支持的预测、恢复缺失模态是否会改变答案、以及现有证据是否充分；随后实际执行模态干预（如遮蔽或恢复模态），并将模型的自我解释声称与其真实行为变化进行对比。在两个模型家族的八个开放权重 VLMs 上，跨越互补型、同构型文本-图像任务及多视角驾驶任务共四个任务进行评估。

Result: 1. 系统性高估可用模态证据的充分性。2. 大幅低估恢复缺失模态的效果：任务级预测变化率中位数 ≤8.8%，实际执行变化率达 72.1%，64 个设置中 62 个出现低估。3. 不充分性声称罕见但精准：被标记案例中中位数 78-100% 实际会改变答案。4. 事后自我解释同向偏差：互补数据上过度归因单模态充分性；同构数据上过度归因单一表征充分性。

Conclusion: 视觉语言模型系统性地错误刻画其预测对可用与缺失模态证据的依赖关系。这种自我解释的不可靠性表明，必须采用可执行的模态干预作为评估多模态自我解释的行为层面真值，而非仅依赖模型自身的言语化解释。

Abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly used in settings where some input modalities may be unavailable, yet we know little about whether they can faithfully explain how such missing information affects their own predictions. We introduce an interventional protocol for evaluating self-explanations of modality dynamics: models state what each modality alone would support, whether restoring a missing modality would change their answer, and whether the available evidence is sufficient; we then execute the corresponding modality intervention and compare these claims with the model's realized behavior. We evaluate eight open-weight VLMs from two model families across four tasks spanning complementary and isomorphic text-image settings and a multi-view driving setting. We find a systematic tendency to overstate the sufficiency of available modality evidence. Models substantially underestimate the effect of restoring missing modalities: task-level median predicted change rates are at most 8.8%, while the corresponding executed change rates reach 72.1%, with underprediction in 62 of 64 model-task-condition settings. Insufficiency claims are rare, but precise when produced: restoring the modality changes the answer in a median of 78-100% of flagged cases. Retrospective self-explanations show the same tendency: on complementary data, models over-credit single-modality sufficiency; on isomorphic data, they over-credit single representation sufficiency relative to their executed behavior. Together, these results show that VLMs systematically mischaracterize how their predictions depend on available and missing modality evidence, motivating executable interventions as a behavioral ground truth for evaluating multimodal self-explanations.

</details>


### [345] [Beyond the Matrix Sign: Quadratic Spectral Descent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07597)
*Qiaozhe Zhang,Jun Sun,Yingzhuang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Quadratic Spectral Descent (QSD)，在Muon的谱范数约束下引入二次局部模型，考虑曲率信息，通过Kronecker分解近似曲率并用Frank-Wolfe求解，实验显示QSD在GPT预训练中优于Muon及其变体，验证损失更低且训练时间减少高达8.49%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon作为线性局部目标在谱范数球上的优化，保留梯度奇异方向并赋予所有活跃奇异模相同幅度。但忽略局部曲率可能导致次优。本文探究引入曲率后奇异值和奇异方向是否仍最优。

Method: 保持Muon的谱范数约束，将线性局部模型替换为二次模型，得到QSD。用Kronecker分解统计量近似曲率，利用Frank-Wolfe算法求解约束二次问题，每步包含闭式矩阵符号子问题。提供最优性证书、与Muon在相同二次代理下的比较，以及内层求解器O(1/K)收敛率。

Result: 在GPT预训练实验中，QSD持续改进验证损失，优于Muon及近期Muon变体，并在匹配验证损失下将墙钟训练时间减少高达8.49%。

Conclusion: 引入曲率信息能显著改善优化方向和步长，QSD作为一种实用的二阶谱优化方法，在大规模语言模型预训练中展现出优于一阶谱方法的性能和效率。

Abstract: Muon can be interpreted as optimizing a linear local objective over a spectral-norm ball. This gives a matrix-sign update that preserves the singular directions of the gradient and assigns the same magnitude to all active singular modes. We ask whether these two properties remain optimal when local curvature is taken into account. To answer this question, we keep Muon's spectral-norm constraint unchanged and replace the linear local model with a quadratic one. We call the resulting method \emph{Quadratic Spectral Descent} (QSD). We show that curvature can change both the singular values and the singular directions of the optimal update. To make QSD practical, we approximate curvature with Kronecker-factored statistics and solve the constrained quadratic with a small number of Frank--Wolfe steps, each of which has a closed-form matrix-sign subproblem. We further provide an optimality certificate, a comparison with Muon under the same quadratic surrogate, and an $O(1/K)$ convergence rate for the inner solver. Experiments on GPT pre-training show that QSD consistently improves validation loss over Muon and recent Muon variants, and reduces wall-clock training time by up to $8.49\%$ at matched validation loss.

</details>


### [346] [CLUES-WEASEL: No additional clues required to choose your time series clustering algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07606)
*Johann Faouzi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新颖的时间序列聚类算法 CLUES-WEASEL，该算法利用 WEASEL 2.0 的无监督变换步骤提取特征，再通过主成分分析降维，最后用 k-means 聚类。实验表明，CLUES-WEASEL 在聚类性能上显著优于现有方法，同时运行速度更快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列聚类在许多实际应用中至关重要，但现有算法普遍面临性能与运行时间的权衡难题：要么聚类效果好但速度慢，要么速度快但精度低。因此，迫切需要一种既能保持高聚类质量又能大幅提升计算效率的算法。

Method: CLUES-WEASEL 采用三阶段流程：首先使用 WEASEL 2.0 的无监督变换步骤从时间序列中提取词袋特征；其次应用主成分分析（PCA）对高维特征进行降维；最后在降维后的特征空间上运行 k-means 算法完成聚类。该架构还具有通用性，可兼容其他时间序列特征提取方法。

Result: 在大量基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，CLUES-WEASEL 的聚类准确性显著优于所有现有的时间序列聚类算法，同时其运行速度比最先进方法快得多（数量级加速）。此外，实验还验证了该框架与其他特征提取算法结合时的有效性。

Conclusion: CLUES-WEASEL 通过结合无监督词袋特征提取、降维与高效聚类，成功打破了时间序列聚类中性能与速度的权衡，为大规模、高精度的时间序列聚类任务提供了极具竞争力的解决方案，具有重要的应用价值和推广潜力。

Abstract: Time series data is very common in many real-world applications and in numerous domains, with increasing interest for automated information extraction using machine learning. One of these subfields is time series clustering, which consists in identifying clusters among a set of time series in an unsupervised fashion. Most time series clustering algorithms suffer from the same balancing act: they trade clustering performance for faster runtimes or vice versa. We present a novel time series clustering algorithm that we call CLUES-WEASEL, which stands for CLustering with the UnsupervisEd Second version of Word ExtrAction for time SEries cLassification. CLUES-WEASEL extracts features using the unsupervised version of the transformation step of WEASEL 2.0, which is a time series classification algorithm, then reduces these features using principal component analysis, and finally performs clustering with the $k$-means algorithm using these reduced extracted features. Through extensive experiments, we prove that CLUES-WEASEL is significantly better than any other existing time series clustering algorithm while being (much) faster than any state-of-the-art one. We also show that the architecture of CLUES-WEASEL can work well with other time series feature extraction algorithms. Our findings highlight the relevance of CLUES-WEASEL for time series clustering.

</details>


### [347] [Translation of Black-Box Clinical Prediction Models into Standalone Transparent Nomograms: Temporal External Validation in Heart Transplantation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07610)
*Henry Pigot,Paulo J. G. Lisboa,Sandra Ortega-Martorell,Ivan Olier,Joseph Mahon,Johan Nilsson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 PRiSM 方法，将黑盒临床预测模型转化为可逐项审计的独立列线图，在心脏移植受者数据上验证，所有来源模型生成的列线图均满足非劣效判别标准，并保留校准度和临床净获益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床预测模型常为黑盒，难以审计和解释，需要将复杂模型转化为可解释的列线图，同时保持预测性能。

Method: PRiSM 从源模型中提取每个效应和交互的形状，让结果变量选择并加权这些项，生成可独立使用的列线图。在 50,356 例心脏移植受者数据上测试，采用时间分割验证（训练早期，验证后期）。

Result: 所有 5 种源模型生成的列线图均达到预设的非劣效判别标准，校准度和临床净获益基本保留；机器学习模型衍生的列线图判别力与从头训练的广义加性模型和可解释提升模型无显著差异，优于神经加性模型，且项数少于可解释提升模型。

Conclusion: PRiSM 能有效将黑盒模型转化为可审计的列线图而不损失性能，已作为开源 Python 包发布，促进临床模型透明化和可信度。

Abstract: We convert black-box clinical prediction models for tabular data into standalone nomograms that can be audited term by term. PRiSM (Partial Responses in Structured Models) takes the shape of each effect and interaction from the source model, not merely which variables mattered, and lets the outcome select and weight them. We tested this in 50,356 heart transplant recipients, with validation in a later era than training. Nomograms from all 5 source models - a public clinical risk score, logistic regression, neural networks, random forests and extreme gradient boosting - met a prespecified noninferiority criterion for discrimination before any further simplification, and generally preserved calibration and clinical net benefit. Those from the 3 machine-learning models showed no detectable difference in discrimination from de novo generalized additive and explainable boosting models, exceeded neural additive models, and carried fewer terms than the explainable boosting model. PRiSM is released as an open-source Python package.

</details>


### [348] [Forecasting the Winner of a Live Tennis Match](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07617)
*Charles Xie,Aneesh Muppidi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为Trace的混合模型，用于网球比赛实时胜率预测，在大满贯赛事数据上验证，随着比赛进程推进准确率显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着实时体育博彩兴起，网球预测需从赛前扩展到比赛过程中的动态胜率更新。核心挑战在于模型需持续适应比分和表现变化，如何有效融合赛前信息与实时信息以生成准确胜率估计是关键问题。

Method: 使用8,222场大满贯比赛（共1,505,355个得分点）数据，采用时间序列划分：2011-2021年训练，2022年验证，2023-2024年测试。评估五种模型，最终选择混合模型Trace。

Result: Trace模型在比赛进度25%、50%、75%时分别达到76.06%、82.15%、88.34%的准确率，表明随比赛进行预测精度显著提高。

Conclusion: 混合建模方法是实时网球胜率预测的实用有效途径，能够较好地整合赛前与实时信息，适应比赛动态变化。

Abstract: With the rise of live sports betting in recent years, tennis forecasting has expanded from pre-match prediction to models that update win probabilities as a match unfolds. A central challenge in creating such a model is the constant need for models to adapt to score and performance changes. This study examines how pre-match and live information can be most effectively integrated into a model to produce accurate win-probability estimates. The analysis uses 8,222 Grand Slam matches containing a total of 1,505,355 points. Five models were evaluated using a chronological split, with matches from 2011-2021 used for training, 2022 for validation, and 2023-2024 for testing. Trace, a hybrid model, achieved accuracies of 76.06%, 82.15%, and 88.34% at 25%, 50%, and 75% match progress, suggesting that hybrid modeling is a practical approach to live tennis forecasting.

</details>


### [349] [Online Surrogate Repair: Decoupling High-Fidelity Feedback from Search Length in Closed-Loop Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07655)
*Xiaotang Feng,Philip Torr,Bruno Andreis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出在线替代模型修复（OSR），一种闭环算法，通过稀疏的高保真评估在代理搜索过程中持续更新替代模型，解决廉价替代模型反馈与昂贵高保真实验之间的不平衡问题。实验表明，全局替代模型拟合度提升不一定降低最大遗憾值，而Q90-UCB和期望改进（EI）采集规则能显著降低遗憾值。在MADE基准上，OSR比每轮都进行高保真反馈的基线节省6.36-10.27倍的预言机查询。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 闭环AI科学家能以低边际计算成本生成候选设计，但可靠反馈需要湿实验合成、表征或高保真计算。定制实验室自动化基础设施密集且昂贵，而使用固定替代模型会留下持续的模型误差，这些误差会被优化过程放大。需要一种介于固定替代模型和每轮高保真反馈之间的新反馈机制。

Method: 在线替代模型修复（OSR）：闭环算法，在主要使用廉价替代模型反馈的较长代理搜索过程中，利用稀疏的高保真评估更新替代模型。采集规则从代理累积的提案中选择哪些设计接受高保真评估，所得标签用于更新后续回合使用的替代模型。采集策略包括Q90-UCB和期望改进（EI）。

Result: 在受控合成环境中：提升全局替代模型拟合度不一定减少最大遗憾值；Q90-UCB和EI通过将评估导向决定优化器决策的区域，大幅降低遗憾值。在MADE基准上：每回合接受高保真反馈的对照组需要6.36-7.23倍（两个LLM编排器）和10.27倍（非LLM Chemeleon+MLIP工作流）更多预言机查询才能匹配Online EI的性能。

Conclusion: OSR引入了一个新颖的第三反馈机制，介于固定替代模型操作和每回合高保真反馈之间，将高保真评估频率与代理搜索时长解耦。这种方法显著降低了高保真评估成本，同时保持了优化性能，为闭环AI科学家提供了可扩展的实验反馈策略。

Abstract: Closed-loop AI scientists can generate candidate designs at low marginal computational cost, whereas reliable feedback may require wet-lab synthesis, characterization, or high-fidelity computation. Addressing this imbalance through custom laboratory automation remains infrastructure-intensive and costly, while replacing new experiments with a fixed surrogate leaves persistent model errors that can be amplified by optimization. We propose \emph{online surrogate repair} (OSR), a closed-loop algorithm that uses sparse high-fidelity evaluations to update the surrogate throughout a longer agent search conducted primarily with inexpensive surrogate feedback. An acquisition rule selects which designs from the agent's accumulated proposals receive high-fidelity evaluation, and the resulting labels update the surrogate used in subsequent episodes. Across controlled synthetic environments, we demonstrate that improving global surrogate fit does not necessarily reduce maximum regret, whereas Q90-UCB and expected improvement (EI) substantially reduce regret by directing evaluations toward regions that determine the optimizer's decisions. On MADE, controls receiving high-fidelity feedback after every episode require $6.36$--$7.23\times$ more oracle queries to match Online EI under two LLM orchestrators and $10.27\times$ more under the non-LLM Chemeleon+MLIP workflow. Online surrogate repair introduces a novel third feedback regime between fixed-surrogate operation and high-fidelity feedback after every episode, separating the frequency of high-fidelity evaluation from the duration of the agent's search.

</details>


### [350] [Accuracy is Not Enough: A Divergence-Based Approach to Evaluate Fidelity Loss in Quantized LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07664)
*Shahzeb Qamar,Lorenz Sparrenberg,Christian Bauckhage,Baha Rababah,Carson Leung,Murat Kantarcioglu,Cuneyt Gurcan Akcora,Rafet Sifa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于分布的评估框架，通过计算全精度与量化大语言模型在token决策边界处的全词表预测分布之间的统计距离（如Jensen-Shannon散度和总变差距离），量化量化带来的信息损失。实验表明，该指标随量化强度增加而单调上升，能补充任务准确率，揭示top-1准确率无法捕捉的预测分布漂移；混合精度Q4_K在相似内存下比统一量化Q4_0产生更小的分布偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有量化大模型评估主要依赖零样本任务准确率（基于argmax预测），对底层预测分布的变化不敏感，导致在渐进量化下准确率表现出非单调、不稳定的行为，掩盖了相对于BF16基础模型的实质性保真度损失，给部署决策提供误导性信号。

Method: 构建分布敏感评估框架：在token决策边界处，计算全精度（BF16）与量化模型输出的全词表预测分布之间的统计距离，采用Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD）和总变差距离（TVD）作为核心指标，量化概率质量位移和分布漂移。实验覆盖5种基础架构、4个推理基准、从BF16到Q2_K的渐进量化方案，共120次运行。

Result: 1. 散度指标随量化强度增强普遍单调上升，与任务准确率互补，提供保真度信号。2. 在llama.cpp量化方案中，混合精度Q4_K在相近内存占用下比统一量化Q4_0产生更低的分布散度。3. 该框架捕捉了top-1准确率无法反映的预测分布变化。

Conclusion: 分布感知评估作为任务准确率的实用诊断补充，能揭示量化导致的分布保真度损失；但需注意，该指标不直接等同于正确性、校准度、安全性或用户感知质量。

Abstract: Deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) on memory-constrained edge devices relies heavily on aggressive post-training quantization. However, evaluating these models is largely based on zero-shot task accuracy, which depends solely on argmax predictions and is insensitive to changes in the underlying predictive distribution. Consequently, accuracy can exhibit unstable, non-monotonic behavior under progressive quantization, masking substantial fidelity loss relative to the BFloat16 (BF16) uncompressed base model and providing misleading deployment signals. We introduce a distribution-sensitive evaluation framework quantifying information loss in quantized LLMs as the divergence between full-vocabulary predictive distributions at the token decision boundary. We compute statistical distances, including Jensen-Shannon Divergence and Total Variation Distance, between outputs of full-precision and quantized models, enabling a fine-grained analysis of distributional shift. Using this framework, we quantify probability mass displacement and distributional drift relative to the BF16 reference, capturing predictive distribution changes not reflected in top-1 accuracy. We conduct a 120-run experimental matrix across five foundation architectures and four reasoning benchmarks under progressive quantization regimes, from uncompressed BF16 to Q2_K, providing a systematic fidelity analysis. Our results show divergence metrics generally increase under stronger quantization, complementing task accuracy with a fidelity signal. Across tested llama-cpp schemes, mixed-precision Q4_K generally yields lower divergence than uniform Q4_0 at similar memory footprints. These findings motivate distribution-aware evaluation as a practical diagnostic complement to task accuracy; they do not directly establish correctness, calibration, safety, or user-perceived quality.

</details>


### [351] [MpSub: A Momentum $p$-Dimensional Subspace Trust-Region Method for Derivative-Free Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07666)
*Yuyang Wang,Haoyu Yao,Pengcheng Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出动量 p 维子空间信任域法 (MpSub)，一种无需学习率调节的零阶优化方法，用于大语言模型微调。通过在 p 维子空间内搜索（一个方向保留动量，其余随机采样），利用中心差分估计子空间梯度，配合线性信任域模型和自适应信任域半径，消除了学习率超参数。理论上证明了在无正交化高斯方向下的有限差分误差界、子空间捕获的梯度能量及几乎必然收敛到驻点。实验显示在相同前向传播预算下，MpSub 在 OPT-125M 和 OPT-350M 上达到与调优 MeZO 相当的测试准确率，且无需学习率搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全参数微调大语言模型因反向传播需存储激活和梯度而内存开销大。零阶优化通过损失函数评估估计更新方向避免反向传播，但现有方法需为每个模型和任务敏感地调节学习率。因此需要一种无学习率、内存高效且理论有保证的零阶优化方法。

Method: MpSub 每次迭代在 p 维子空间搜索：一个方向沿用最近接受步骤的历史动量，其余 p-1 方向从高斯分布重新随机采样。用中心差分估计子空间梯度，构建线性信任域模型求试探步长，信任域半径根据预测下降量与实际下降量的一致性自适应调整，从而省去学习率。LLM 微调时，同一迭代内的多次评估共享一个小批量，方向通过种子原地重生成，仅需前向传播。

Result: 在 8,400 次训练目标前向传播的预算下，于 CommitmentBank 数据集微调 OPT-125M 和 OPT-350M。使用相同的预设参数，MpSub 在三个随机种子上平均测试准确率分别为 0.673 和 0.690，与经过学习率调优的 MeZO (0.685) 持平，且完全免去了学习率搜索。理论分析给出了有限差分误差界、子空间捕获梯度能量的量化，并证明在保护性半径更新下梯度范数几乎必然收敛到零。

Conclusion: MpSub 通过动量增强的子空间信任域框架，实现了无学习率、内存高效的零阶 LLM 微调，兼具理论收敛保证与实验性能，解决了现有零阶方法对学习率敏感的痛点，为大模型微调提供了实用的新选择。

Abstract: Full-parameter fine-tuning of large language models has substantial memory costs because backpropagation stores activations and gradients. Zeroth-order optimization avoids this by estimating update directions from loss evaluations, but existing methods require tuning a sensitive learning rate for each model and task. We propose the momentum $p$-dimensional subspace trust-region method (MpSub). At each iteration, MpSub searches within a $p$-dimensional subspace: one direction preserves historical momentum from the most recent accepted step, while the remaining directions explore via fresh random sampling. The subspace gradient is estimated by central differences, a trial step is computed from a linear trust-region model, and the trust-region radius adapts according to the agreement between predicted and observed loss reduction, eliminating the learning rate. For LLM fine-tuning, evaluations within an iteration share a minibatch, and directions are regenerated in place from seeds, using forward passes alone. For smooth deterministic objectives under unorthogonalized Gaussian directions, we bound the finite-difference error, quantify gradient energy captured by the subspace, and prove that $\lim_{k\to\infty} \|\nabla f(x_k)\|_2 = 0$ almost surely under a safeguarded radius update. Under a matched budget of 8,400 training-objective forward passes, we fine-tune OPT-125M and OPT-350M on CommitmentBank. With the same preset parameters at both model sizes, MpSub attains mean test accuracies of 0.673 and 0.690 over three seeds, matching tuned MeZO (0.685) without any learning-rate search.

</details>


### [352] [On the Recall Scaling Laws in Mamba: A Theoretical and Mechanistic Study via Hashing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07681)
*Yuval Koren,Assaf Ben-Kish,Raja Giryes,Lior Wolf,Itamar Zimerman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文从机制可解释性角度分析Mamba的关联回忆能力，发现其通过隐式学习线性哈希函数实现回忆，提出Recall Scaling Laws理论框架，可预测完美回忆所需维度、回忆成功概率，并分析多层多头模式，实验验证理论准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关联回忆是评估语言模型上下文记忆能力的基准，与语言建模性能强相关。现有研究缺乏对Mamba内部回忆算法的机制理解，需要从可解释性角度逆向工程其内部电路，并建立理论框架预测回忆能力随词汇量、状态维度、嵌入维度等因素的缩放规律。

Method: 采用机制可解释性方法逆向工程Mamba的回忆电路，识别其隐式学习的线性哈希函数。受Johnson-Lindenstrauss引理启发，构建Recall Scaling Laws理论框架，结合词汇量和上下文事实数量，推导嵌入维度和状态维度对完美回忆的需求、回忆成功概率预测、多层多头SSM模式分析。

Result: 理论预测与实验结果高度吻合：框架能准确预测Mamba实现完美回忆所需的嵌入和状态维度，给定模型维度可预测回忆成功概率，并解释多层和多头SSM的回忆模式。实验验证了理论在不同词汇量、状态大小、嵌入维度和架构下的准确性和预测能力。

Conclusion: Mamba的关联回忆机制基于隐式线性哈希，Recall Scaling Laws为理解记忆容量随模型规模和架构的缩放提供了定量理论工具，揭示了词汇量、状态维度、嵌入维度与回忆性能的精确关系，指导高效架构设计。

Abstract: Associative Recall (AR) is the cognitive ability to learn and retrieve links between items in memory. In NLP, AR is used as a benchmark for evaluating the in-context memory capacity of architectures such as Mamba, and has been found to strongly correlate with language modeling performance. This paper explores AR from the perspective of mechanistic interpretability, aiming to reverse-engineer the exact internal algorithm used by Mamba to perform recall. Our key insight is that Mamba performs recall by implicitly learning linear hash functions, and we identify the low-level circuit that enables this behavior. Building on these findings and inspired by theoretical tools in similarity-preserving hashing, such as the Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma, we develop a theoretical framework for analyzing AR, which we term Recall Scaling Laws. Given the vocabulary size and the number of facts in context, this framework allows us to (1) predict the embedding and state dimensions required for Mamba to achieve perfect recall, (2) predict recall success probability given the model dimensions, and (3) analyze multi-layer models and multi-head SSM patterns. Empirical results show that our theoretical findings are accurate and predictive, offering insights into how AR capacity scales with vocabulary, state, embedding size, and architecture.

</details>


### [353] [Emergent Charging Coordination in Electric Delivery Fleets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07689)
*Javier Vales-Alonso,Juan J. Alcaraz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于本地强化学习的电动配送车队中途充电协调范式，无需中央调度，车辆仅依据自身时间预算和广播的充电站占用率独立决策，通过涌现式协调实现接近全知预言机的性能。在20个真实城市的OpenStreetMap网络仿真中，NEAT和PPO训练的策略零样本泛化至未见城市，分别完成96.8%和98.6%的班次，远超贪心基线（73%）和启发式阈值方法（~80%），并将排队等待从45分钟降至2分钟以下。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电动配送车队在班次中途充电决策复杂：车辆需自主决定充电时机、地点和充电量，以按时完成班次并保持安全电量下限。多车辆选择同一充电站会导致排队拥堵，决策相互耦合。现有工作依赖中央调度、预计算时间表或预约系统，但充电基础设施罕见支持此类机制。因此需要一种去中心化、仅需本地信息的协调方法。

Method: 采用纯本地控制的学习智能体范式：每辆车运行相同策略，仅根据自身时间预算和广播的充电站占用率独立决策，无需中央控制或车辆间通信。使用神经进化（NEAT）和策略梯度（PPO）在4个城市训练策略，随后在20个城市（含16个未见城市）进行零样本部署评估。对比基线包括全知预言机、贪心最近站规则、调优启发式阈值方法。

Result: 预言机完成99.5%班次，贪心规则仅73%，启发式阈值在拥堵城市约80%。NEAT和PPO策略零样本泛化至20城市，分别完成96.8%和98.6%班次。PPO在需求或车辆特性漂移时更鲁棒。训练过程中智能体重新发现了部分充电、短时机会充电和绕行拥堵站策略，将单次充电排队等待从约45分钟降至2分钟以下。

Conclusion: 该协调范式在最小实现成本下平衡了本地紧迫性与公共占用率，实现了接近全知预言机的性能。纯本地强化学习策略能涌现出高效的协调行为，具有极强的零样本泛化能力和鲁棒性，为大规模电动车队充电管理提供了实用的去中心化解决方案。

Abstract: In electric delivery fleets, mid-shift charging is non-trivial: each vehicle must decide when, where and how much to charge to finish on time with battery above a safety floor. The choices are coupled: queues build where too many vehicles pick the same station. Prior work resolves this coupling with central dispatching, precomputed schedules or reservations, machinery that charging infrastructure rarely supports. Instead, we use a family of learning agents under purely local control: every vehicle runs the same policy, deciding alone from its time budgets and broadcast station occupancies, leading to emergent coordination without central control or messaging. We validate this paradigm in simulation on real OpenStreetMap networks of twenty cities, each with a frozen scenario calibrated by an omniscient Oracle (99.5% of shifts completed on time), whereas a naive greedy rule (nearest station on low battery) completes just 73%. Agents trained with neuroevolution (NEAT) and policy gradients (PPO) on four cities and deployed zero-shot across all twenty, sixteen never seen in training, complete 96.8% and 98.6% of shifts, with the policy-gradient controllers proving more robust when demand or vehicle characteristics drift beyond the trained regime. In contrast, tuned threshold heuristics that read vehicle urgency alone fall short in contended cities (~80%). Through training, these learning agents rediscover partial charging and short opportunistic sessions, and route around busy stations, cutting per-session queue waits from about 45 minutes to under 2. In summary, this coordination paradigm balances local urgency against public occupancy, reaching near-Oracle performance at minimal implementation cost.

</details>


### [354] [ParetoTransport: Generative Optimization by Mass Transport Toward The Pareto Front](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07706)
*Stephanie Holly,Sepp Hochreiter,Werner Zellinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需训练的引导方法 ParetoTransport，用于预训练的流匹配模型，通过在目标空间显式指定和细化种群级分布，解决离线多目标优化中分布级建模能力未被充分利用的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的生成方法在离线多目标优化中主要保留经典的基于样本的引导策略，未能充分利用生成方法的分布级建模能力，导致候选设计的目标向量难以有效分布在帕累托前沿。

Method: ParetoTransport 引导流匹配采样器迭代地将经验离线分布通过 Wasserstein 匹配到中间代理分布，从而向帕累托前沿传输，直接控制分布位移和沿前沿的质量分配。

Result: 在标准离线多目标优化基准上达到最先进性能，评估指标扩展至超体积之外，包括代际距离、倒代际距离和 Wasserstein 距离。

Conclusion: ParetoTransport 通过分布级引导显著提升了离线多目标优化的性能，建立了收敛性结果，并为生成方法在多目标优化中的应用提供了新范式。

Abstract: Offline multi-objective optimization requires not only moving the objective vectors of candidate designs toward the Pareto front, but also distributing them effectively along it. Generative methods have recently emerged as a natural approach because they learn a distribution over feasible designs while allowing generation to be steered toward promising designs. Existing methods, however, largely retain classical sample-wise guidance strategies, leaving the distribution-level modeling capability of generative methods underused. We propose ParetoTransport, a training-free guidance method for pre-trained flow-matching models that explicitly specifies and refines a population-level distribution in objective space. ParetoTransport guides a flow-matching sampler to iteratively transport the empirical offline distribution toward the Pareto front, with Wasserstein matching to intermediate proxy distributions. This directly controls distributional displacement and mass allocation along the front. We establish a convergence result and demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on standard offline MOO benchmarks, extending recent evaluations beyond hypervolume to generational distance, inverted generational distance, and Wasserstein distance.

</details>


### [355] [Attributing Cohen's d: Training Data Attribution for Disease-Related Effects in Normative Age Biomarkers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07729)
*Jakob Snel,Marc-Andre Schulz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于影响函数的方法，直接将疾病相关的效应量归因于训练样本，通过移除最有影响力的10%训练样本，显著提高了多种疾病和生物标志物模态下的疾病相关效应量，并揭示了诊断排除遗漏的亚临床心血管代谢负担。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的规范年龄模型通过预测年龄与实际年龄的差距来评估疾病风险，但传统方法使用预测层面的损失作为归因目标，无法直接量化单个训练样本对疾病相关效应量的贡献，且诊断标准排除可能遗漏亚临床病理。

Method: 针对Cohen's d效应量，推导了闭式影响函数，并通过留一重训练验证，根据训练样本对保留病例-对照分离的影响进行排序；在UK Biobank的四种疾病和两种生物标志物模态上实验，移除最有影响力的10%训练样本并评估效应量变化。

Result: 移除最有影响力的10%训练样本在所有随机种子下均提高了保留数据的疾病相关效应量：代谢组学年龄对2型糖尿病的效应量翻倍以上，脑年龄对多发性硬化症的效应量提升约三分之一；随机移除即使50%也无效果，证实提升源于样本选择而非数量；被标记样本携带诊断排除遗漏的亚临床心血管代谢负担，且模型未见这些标记；对于2型糖尿病，恢复的标记是HbA1c。

Conclusion: 该方法能有效识别并移除降低疾病检测灵敏度的训练样本，显著提升规范年龄模型的疾病相关效应量，揭示亚临床病理，并发布了pyinfluence包以支持复现和复用。

Abstract: Normative age models are trained to predict chronological age in a nominally healthy cohort. Applied to patients, they deviate, and the gap between predicted and chronological age is read as disease risk. Here, we attribute the disease-related effect size of the age gap directly to individual training samples, rather than using a prediction-level loss as the attribution target. For Cohen's $d$, the resulting closed-form influence functional, validated against leave-one-out retraining, ranks training samples by their effect on held-out case-control separation. Across four diseases and two biomarker modalities in UK Biobank, removing the 10% most influential training samples raises held-out disease-related effect size in every seed. It more than doubles the metabolomic-age effect for type-2 diabetes and raises the brain-age effect for multiple sclerosis by roughly a third. Random removal leaves effect size flat even at 50% removal, confirming the gain comes from which samples are removed, not how many. Flagged subjects carry subclinical cardiometabolic burden that diagnosis-based exclusion misses, on markers the model never sees. For type-2 diabetes, where the method gains most, the marker recovered is HbA1c, the standard measure of blood sugar control. We release pyinfluence, our influence-function package, for reproducibility and reuse.

</details>


### [356] [Guiding Worker Self-Selection in Crowdsourcing Contests: An LLM-Augmented Algorithmic Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07749)
*Nguyen Thach,Hau Chan,David Parkes,Karim Lakhani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出GRAF框架和LLMScore方法，解决众包平台中工人自选择导致的竞赛参与不足和工人后悔问题，实现平台效用和工人满意度的联合优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 众包平台中工人自主选择竞赛并投入精力，这种自选择可能导致重要竞赛参与者太少或精力投入不足，同时工人可能后悔选择了让他们比可用替代方案更差的竞赛。需要平台推荐竞赛给工人，解决自选择中的图拉克竞赛（SSTC）问题。

Method: 提出GRAF（贪婪多项式时间框架），通过根据得分向量对工人排序来构建自选择结果，保证零工人后悔和特殊情况下的平台最优性。由于工人异质性导致有效排序难以设计，提出LLMScore（基于LLM的进化框架），自动设计GRAF的评分算法，解决联合优化平台效用和工人满意度、以及在精确计算不可行时评估工人后悔的挑战。

Result: 在跨越四种设置的1000个合成实例上，GRAF结合LLMScore持续实现高质量、往往接近最优的结果，工人后悔低，同时使平台和工人受益。且仅在小规模实例上训练即可迁移到更大且结构不同的设置，输出可读代码供操作员检查修改。

Conclusion: 该工作通过GRAF和LLMScore有效解决了众包平台中的自选择问题，实现了平台效用和工人满意度的双赢，具有良好的泛化性和可解释性。

Abstract: Crowdsourcing platforms coordinate large pools of online workers who strategically choose which contests to enter and how much effort to invest. This self-selection can leave important contests with too few participants or too little effort, while workers may regret entering contests that leave them worse off than available alternatives. We study how platforms can recommend contests to workers using self-selection in Tullock contests (SSTC), a two-stage model in which workers first choose contests and then compete within them. We introduce GRAF, a greedy polynomial-time framework that constructs self-selection outcomes by ordering workers according to a score vector, with guarantees of zero worker regret and platform optimality in special cases of SSTC. Because effective orderings are difficult to design under worker heterogeneity, we propose LLMScore, an LLM-driven evolutionary framework that automatically designs GRAF's scoring algorithm. LLMScore addresses two challenges: jointly optimizing platform utility and worker satisfaction, and evaluating worker regret when exact computation is intractable. Trained only on small instances of one setting, it transfers to larger and structurally different settings; moreover, its output is human-readable code that platform operators can inspect and modify. Across 1,000 synthetic instances spanning four settings, GRAF with LLMScore consistently achieves high-quality, often near-optimal, outcomes with low worker regret, benefiting both platforms and workers.

</details>


### [357] [Local gradient neural operator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07752)
*Baiming Zhang,Jinsong Tang,Ying Xu,Lihua Chen,Shiying Xiong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出局部梯度神经算子(LGNO)，一种轻量级可解释的神经算子，用于动力学系统中的场时序预测和源识别。该方法基于非线性梯度离散先验，利用MLP卷积层学习平移不变的局部核，通过零一致模板分解实现系数学习与场重构分离，并采用网络折叠共享对称分量减少参数量。在涵盖线性/非线性、静态/动态、低/高维的PDE基准测试中，LGNO展现出准确性、参数效率和长时演化稳定性，并适用于扩散、流动和量子现象等力学问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的全局神经算子（如神经算子）虽然提供了数据驱动的PDE求解范式，但通常需要大量训练数据、大量可学习参数，且可解释性和泛化能力有限。本文旨在开发一种轻量级、可解释的替代方案，利用离散数值方法的先验知识（梯度离散、模板）来构建具有物理意义的局部算子，解决参数效率、可解释性和长时滚动稳定性问题。

Method: LGNO方法包含三个核心创新：1) 基于非线性梯度离散先验，使用多层感知机卷积层学习平移不变的局部卷积核，模仿有限差分/有限体积模板；2) 零一致模板分解，将算子系数学习与场重构解耦，保证算子的一致性并提高透明度；3) 针对具有对称性的问题，采用网络折叠技术共享等价组件，大幅减少参数量。整体架构保持局部性、平移不变性和物理一致性。

Result: 在涵盖线性/非线性、静态/动态、低维/高维的多个PDE基准测试中，LGNO在保持预测精度的同时，实现了显著的参数效率优势（参数量比全局神经算子少几个数量级），并展现出优异的长时滚动预测稳定性。方法成功应用于扩散方程、纳维-斯托克斯流动、薛定谔方程等力学问题，验证了其广泛适用性。

Conclusion: LGNO通过融合数值离散先验与深度学习，构建了轻量级、可解释、参数高效的局部神经算子。零一致模板分解和网络折叠机制有效解决了可解释性和参数冗余问题。实验证明该方法在多种力学PDE问题上具有优异的准确性、泛化能力和长时稳定性，为数据驱动的科学计算提供了实用的新范式。

Abstract: Field temporal prediction and source identification constitute canonical problems in dynamical systems. Conventional approaches to these problems depend on a thorough understanding of the governing partial differential equations (PDEs). Recently, deep learning, as represented by neural operators, has provided a data-driven paradigm for addressing such tasks. However, most existing global neural operators for PDEs require large training datasets and many learnable parameters, with limited interpretability and generalization. We propose the local gradient neural operator (LGNO) as a lightweight and interpretable alternative for field temporal evolution prediction and source identification in typical mechanical problems. The method builds on priors from nonlinear gradient discretization and uses multilayer perceptron convolutional layers to learn translation-invariant local kernels that resemble discrete stencils. A zero consistent stencil factorization separates coefficient learning from field reconstruction, rendering the learned operators more transparent. For problems with symmetries, network folding shares equivalent components and reduces parameter counts. We evaluate the method on PDE benchmarks covering linear and nonlinear, static and dynamic, and low and high dimensional cases. Results show that LGNO maintains accuracy, parameter efficiency, and rollout stability across these tasks, and further exhibits wide applicability to mechanical problems including diffusion, flow, and quantum phenomena.

</details>


### [358] [A Theoretical Analysis of Generalization Dynamics in Neural Networks under Gradient Descent with Weight Decay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07755)
*Yuqing Wang,Ioannis G. Kevrekidis,Mikhail Belkin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出理论框架，分析数据、架构、训练动态如何共同塑造泛化性能。研究带权重衰减的梯度下降训练神经网络，证明收敛到经验损失全局极小值邻域，将总体误差分解为数据误差、优化误差、预测变化误差并分别界定。提出(局部)近似齐次性，给出单元级和层级的预测变化误差演化界，揭示层级泛化行为差异的必要条件，并给出延迟泛化和grokking现象的充分条件刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解泛化仍是机器学习核心挑战，因为需要联合考虑数据、架构、训练动态。现有理论往往孤立地分析这些因素，缺乏统一框架刻画其在训练过程中的相互作用。

Method: 研究一类宽泛神经网络，在ℓ²损失下用带权重衰减的梯度下降训练。证明梯度下降收敛到经验损失全局极小值邻域。基于输入数据划分空间，将总体误差分解为数据误差、优化误差、预测变化误差并分别界定。针对预测变化误差，提出(局部)近似齐次性，推导其沿训练轨迹的单元级和层级显式界。

Result: 得到两个重要启示：(1) 改善泛化的必要条件解释了层级泛化行为差异；(2) 延迟泛化的充分条件为grokking现象提供了理论刻画。

Conclusion: 该理论框架统一了数据、架构、训练动态对泛化的影响，通过预测变化误差的层级演化分析，为深度学习泛化现象（如grokking）提供了新的理论视角。

Abstract: Understanding generalization remains a central challenge in machine learning because it requires jointly considering data, architecture, and training dynamics. In this paper, we develop a theoretical framework that characterizes how these factors jointly shape generalization performance throughout training. More precisely, we study a broad class of neural networks trained under the $\ell^2$ loss by gradient descent (GD) with weight decay, and prove the convergence of GD to a neighbourhood of the global minimizers of the empirical loss. By partitioning the space based on the input data, we then decompose the population error into data error, optimization error, and prediction variation error, and bound them separately. In particular, for the prediction variation error, which measures the oscillations of the learned function, we propose (local) approximate homogeneity and derive explicit cellwise and layerwise bounds for its evolution along the training trajectory. These bounds yield two important implications: a necessary condition of improved generalization explains differences in layerwise generalization behavior; a sufficient condition describes delayed generalization and provides a theoretical characterization of grokking.

</details>


### [359] [Decomposition-Guided Diffusion Language Models for Inertial Confinement Fusion Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07756)
*Xiang Zhang,Varchas Gopalaswamy,Rahman Ejaz,Riccardo Betti,Dongfang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ICF-DLM，首个基于语言模型的惯性约束聚变（ICF）波形预测器，针对激光脉冲与靶设计参数直接预测 512 步中子率诊断波形，解决时间稀疏、数据极少、峰值时序敏感等难题。在 ICFBench 上将峰值时序误差从 11.6 步降至 9.2 步，超越同规模自回归 LLaMA-3-8B 及经典序列模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 国家点火装置（NIF）单次实验成本约百万美元，亟需高精度 AI 代理模型替代昂贵实验。现有时序预测器面临三大挑战：皮秒级峰值嵌入纳秒窗口的极端时间稀疏性；仅有不足 300 次真实实验数据的输入输出尺度失配；以及对峰值时序极度敏感的皮秒级精度要求。

Method: ICF-DLM 采用三大创新：(i) 物理类型分解，将波形解耦为总产额 Y_DT、峰值时刻 t_peak 与局部波形 w_local；(ii) 双向去噪机制，延迟峰值位置的确定承诺；(iii) 物理驱动的 PPO 奖励，将度量结构重注入数值 token 空间。模型基于 LLaMA-3-8B 架构，在 50 万模拟 + 232 实验样本的 ICFBench 上训练。

Result: 在 ICFBench 测试集上，ICF-DLM 将峰值时序预测误差从基线自回归 LLaMA-3-8B 的 11.6 步降至 9.2 步（降幅约 21%），同时在总产额与波形整体拟合上均显著优于经典序列模型（如 Transformer、LSTM）及其他 LLM 时序预测基线。

Conclusion: ICF-DLM 验证了将物理先验融入大语言模型可高效解决低数据、稀疏事件的科学预测问题。其分解-去噪-强化学习的范式可推广至核聚变之外的多物理场、高稀疏性、小样本科学建模任务。

Abstract: Inertial confinement fusion (ICF) is a leading pathway toward clean energy, but each shot at the National Ignition Facility costs on the order of one million dollars, making accurate AI surrogates a high-value target. We study exogenous-driven ICF waveform prediction, where a 512-step neutron-rate diagnostic must be inferred directly from a laser pulse and target design parameters, with no historical response observed. The regime stresses standard time-series predictors with temporal sparsity (picosecond peak in a nanosecond window), input-output scale mismatch (under 300 real shots), and peak sensitivity (picosecond timing). We propose ICF-DLM, to our knowledge the first LM-based ICF predictor, combining (i) a physics-typed decomposition into yield $Y_{DT}$, peak timing $t_{\mathrm{peak}}$, and local waveform $w_{\mathrm{local}}$; (ii) bidirectional denoising that defers commitment to peak location; and (iii) a physics-driven PPO reward re-injecting metric structure across numeric tokens. On ICFBench (50K simulations + 232 experimental shots), ICF-DLM cuts peak-timing error from 11.6 to 9.2 steps over a matched autoregressive LLaMA-3-8B and outperforms classical sequence models and LLM-based time-series predictors. Beyond ICF, the recipe shows potential to address science domains with low data and sparse events.

</details>


### [360] [Latent-MoE: Domain-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for PDEs with Multi-Regime Physics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07814)
*Hanwen Wang,Paris Perdikaris*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在处理物理规律随空间变化的偏微分方程（PDE）时表现不佳的问题，指出标准坐标网络的神经切线核（NTK）具有平移不变性，导致长程耦合和梯度冲突。提出带有中心化、紧支撑路由器的混合专家（MoE）架构可产生均匀带状NTK，实现学习的局部化。进而提出Latent-MoE，在共享骨干网络中插入域感知MoE块，既保持局部化优势又允许跨区域容量流动。在均匀物理基准上具有竞争力，在多阶段时变物理基准上性能提升一个数量级以上，且显著减少梯度冲突。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PINNs在处理物理规律随空间位置变化的PDE时性能下降。根本原因在于标准坐标网络的NTK具有平移不变性，使得大坐标幅度的训练点对远处预测产生不成比例的影响，导致长程耦合和训练时的梯度冲突。现有的域分解方法（如FB-PINNs、X-PINNs）僵硬地划分域和参数，无法跨子域共享容量。

Method: 理论分析证明带有中心化、紧支撑路由器的MoE架构可产生均匀带状NTK，其核回归权重随距离指数衰减，从而实现学习的局部化。在此基础上提出Latent-MoE架构：在共享骨干网络中交错插入域感知MoE块。不同于僵硬的域分解方法，Latent-MoE保留了域感知路由的局部化优势，同时通过共享骨干允许容量在区域间流动。

Result: 在标准均匀物理基准测试中，Latent-MoE与现有基线方法性能相当。在具有多阶段时变物理的基准测试中，全局模型和僵硬域分解均陷入虚假解，而Latent-MoE性能提升超过一个数量级，且训练过程中梯度冲突显著减少。

Conclusion: Latent-MoE通过结合域感知MoE路由的局部化特性与共享骨干的跨区域容量共享，有效解决了PINNs处理非均匀物理PDE时的长程耦合和梯度冲突问题，在复杂多物理场景中显著优于现有方法。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) struggle on PDEs whose governing physics varies across the domain. We trace this to a structural property of standard coordinate networks: their neural tangent kernel (NTK) is translation-variant and lets training points of large coordinate magnitude disproportionately influence predictions elsewhere, producing long-range coupling and gradient conflict during training. We show analytically and empirically that mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures with centered, compact-support routers yield a uniformly banded NTK whose kernel-regression weights decay exponentially with distance, localizing the learning. Building on this, we propose \emph{Latent-MoE}, which interleaves domain-aware MoE blocks within a shared backbone. Unlike FB-PINNs or X-PINNs, which rigidly partition both the domain and the parameters so that the parameters on different subdomains are updated independently, Latent-MoE is designed to preserve the localization benefit of domain-aware routing while allowing capacity to flow across regions through the shared backbone. On standard homogeneous-physics benchmarks Latent-MoE is competitive with established baselines; on benchmarks with multi-stage time-variable physics, where global models and rigid domain decompositions both fall into spurious solutions, it improves over them by more than an order of magnitude, with markedly reduced gradient conflict during training.

</details>


### [361] [Kalman Delta Networks: Uncertainty-aware Associative Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07816)
*Ngoc Bui,Tinglin Huang,Rex Ying*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Kalman Delta Networks (KDNs)，将循环联想记忆重构为线性高斯状态空间模型，利用卡尔曼滤波实现最优递归估计，并引入两种扫描兼容近似（对角KDN和各向同性KDN），在750M和1.3B参数规模上持续超越最先进线性注意力模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性注意力的固定大小循环记忆需要在线决策写入内容与覆盖强度，但Delta规则模型仅从当前token嵌入学习强度，不跟踪记忆估计的置信度，导致写入无法根据累积证据自适应调整。

Method: 将循环联想记忆建模为线性高斯状态空间模型，引入卡尔曼增益根据累积证据和观测可靠性加权残差写入；提出对角KDN（通过在线均值场变分推理投影到对角高斯族）和各向同性KDN（单不确定性标量）两种扫描兼容近似，其不确定性递推为Mobius映射，支持对数深度并行关联扫描。

Result: 在750M和1.3B参数的受控预训练中，KDN变体在困惑度和平均下游任务准确率上均持续优于最先进的线性注意力模型。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模记忆不确定性并利用卡尔曼滤波原理，KDN有效解决了线性注意力中写入自适应性不足的问题，其近似变体在保持并行效率的同时显著提升了模型性能。

Abstract: Linear attention is increasingly used in frontier language models for efficient long-context inference and constant-memory decoding. Its fixed-size recurrent memory, however, requires an online decision at each token: what to write and how strongly to overwrite existing associations before knowing which information future queries will require. Delta-rule models learn this strength from the current token embedding but do not track confidence in the memory estimate, preventing each write from adapting to accumulated evidence. To represent this uncertainty explicitly, we reformulate recurrent associative memory as a linear--Gaussian state-space model, for which the Kalman filter is the optimal recursive estimator, and introduce a new family of models, Kalman Delta Networks (KDNs). Within KDNs, the transition propagates both the memory state and its uncertainty, allowing the Kalman gain to weight each residual write by accumulated evidence and observation reliability. Under this formulation, Delta-style updates emerge as a special case that substitutes a token-wise isotropic surrogate for predictive covariance and omits covariance tracking. Exact tracking, however, entails a dense, state-dependent Riccati recursion that is poorly suited to GPU-parallel linear-attention scans. To address this issue, we introduce two scan-compatible KDN approximations. Diagonal KDN projects each one-step posterior onto the diagonal Gaussian family through online mean-field variational inference, whereas Isotropic KDN uses an isotropic approximation with a single uncertainty scalar per head. Their uncertainty recurrences are Mobius maps, enabling associative scans with logarithmic parallel depth. Across controlled pretraining at 750M and 1.3B parameters, KDN variants consistently improve perplexity and mean downstream accuracy over state-of-the-art linear-attention models.

</details>


### [362] [Foundation Models for Generalizable Semantic and Goal-Oriented Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07853)
*Boliang Liu,Wint Yi Poe,Riccardo Trivisonno,Giuseppe Caire*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Foundation Model-Guided Semantic and Goal-Oriented Communication (FMSGOC) 框架，利用视觉语言基础模型先验指导语义锚点选择与传输，结合扩散模型完成掩码重建，在极低比特率(0.039 BPP)下实现高语义保真度与泛化能力，超越现有端到端基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对 6G 语义与目标导向通信在严格速率预算下泛化能力差、易过拟合、极低比特率性能急剧下降的问题，现有系统试图压缩整个信号导致过拟合，需要引入基础模型先验缓解过拟合并提升速率效率。

Method: FMSGOC 解耦‘发送什么’与‘如何重建’：视觉语言基础模型选择并传输稀疏的、目标对齐的语义锚点；预训练扩散模型经掩码补全微调后在接收端重建图像，利用生成式基础模型先验补全被掩码区域。

Result: 实验显示 FMSGOC 达到 0.039 BPP，在 CIFAR-10 上语义相似度 0.87-0.90，ImageNet 未见数据上 0.83-0.86，感知相似度分别为 0.1278/0.1558 (CIFAR-10/ImageNet)，在更低比特率下优于强端到端基线。

Conclusion: FMSGOC 通过基础模型引导的稀疏语义锚点传输与生成式重建，有效解决了极低比特率下的过拟合与泛化难题，为 6G 语义通信提供了高效、鲁棒的新范式。

Abstract: Semantic and goal-oriented communication is increasingly studied for 6G, but generalization beyond seen data remains a key weakness under tight rate budgets. Many existing systems overfit their training data and degrade sharply at very low bit rates because they attempt to compress the entire signal. We introduce Foundation Model-Guided Semantic and Goal-Oriented Communication (FMSGOC), a framework that uses broad visual-linguistic Foundation Model priors to mitigate overfitting. It further improves rate efficiency by concentrating bits on sparse, goal-aligned anchors and relying on generative foundation-model priors to reconstruct the masked regions. By decoupling what to send from how to reconstruct, a vision-language foundation model selects and transmits a sparse set of semantic anchors, while a pretrained diffusion model, fine-tuned for masked completion, reconstructs the image at the receiver. In our experiments, FMSGOC reaches 0.039 bits per pixel (BPP), maintains high semantic fidelity (cosine similarity 0.87-0.90 on CIFAR-10), remains robust on previously unseen inputs (0.83-0.86 on ImageNet), and shows good perceptual similarity (0.1278/0.1558, CIFAR-10/ImageNet), outperforming strong end-to-end baselines at lower bit rates.

</details>


### [363] [InfluenceField: A Differentiable Field with Interventionally Identifiable Causal Structure for Multimodal World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07874)
*Zihao Yang,Zijia Wang,Zhiqiu Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 InfluenceField，一种干预感知的潜在场，插入视觉编码器和语言解码器之间，将补丁特征提升为连续空间表示，传播有向影响并预测局部干预效应，在 CausalVQA 上比骨干网络整体准确率提升 13.1 个百分点，规划和假设类别增益最大，实验表明增益源于因果目标而非额外容量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型虽然能捕捉视觉-语言相关性，但难以预测局部视觉干预如何传播并影响下游答案，缺乏对因果干预效应的建模能力。

Method: 引入 InfluenceField 潜在场，位于视觉编码器与语言解码器之间；将补丁特征提升为连续空间表示，通过共享转移算子进行多步有向影响传播，预测局部干预效应；联合优化语言建模、跨环境不变性、反事实回滚监督和结构正则化；理论上针对非线性有限基群体模型，证明目标对齐的干预监督配合一步分离条件可将可接受表示限制在位置内重参数化中，从而精确恢复完整转移的有向依赖图；线性特化给出精确部分覆盖表征和有限损失稳定性界，场分析导出系数干预的空间剖面和共享通道校准结果。

Result: 在 CausalVQA 基准上，InfluenceField 使整体准确率比骨干网络提升 13.1 个百分点，规划和假设类别增益最大；容量匹配的基线和结构控制实验表明，鲁棒性和事实-反事实一致性的提升归因于因果目标而非额外模型容量。

Conclusion: InfluenceField 通过显式建模干预传播机制，结合因果监督目标，显著增强了多模态模型对局部视觉干预的推理能力，实现了准确的因果依赖图恢复和反事实一致性，证明了因果目标而非模型规模是性能提升的关键。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models often capture visual-linguistic correlations but struggle to predict how local visual interventions propagate and affect downstream answers. We introduce InfluenceField, an intervention-aware latent field inserted between the visual encoder and language decoder. It lifts patch features into a continuous spatial representation, propagates directed influence over multiple steps, and predicts local intervention effects through a shared transition operator. Training jointly optimizes language modeling, cross-environment invariance, counterfactual rollout supervision, and structural regularization. For a nonlinear finite-basis population model, we show that target-aligned interventional supervision, together with a one-step separation condition on the transition, restricts admissible representations to within-location reparameterizations, so that the directed dependency graph of the full transition is recovered exactly. A linear specialization gives an exact partial-coverage characterization and a finite-loss stability bound, and the field analysis derives the spatial profile of coefficient interventions together with a shared-channel calibration result. On CausalVQA, InfluenceField improves overall accuracy over its backbone by 13.1 percentage points, with the largest gains on the planning and hypothetical categories. Capacity-matched baselines and structural controls attribute the gains in robustness and factual-counterfactual consistency to the causal objectives rather than to added capacity.

</details>


### [364] [The Accuracy Paradox: Empirical Diagnostic of Default Decision Thresholds in Multi-Label Enzyme Commission Prediction [With Code]](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07897)
*Bilal Ahmad,Rajed Mehmood*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究系统性诊断了酶委员会（EC）编号预测中固定决策阈值在严重类别不平衡下的失效问题，揭示了准确率悖论，并提出目标特定阈值优化和事后共形校准作为必要防护措施。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准多标签机器学习流程常采用默认决策阈值（t=0.5），假设目标类别先验分布均衡，但实际EC编号预测中存在严重类别不平衡（N=14,096化合物跨六大EC类），导致固定决策边界失效，掩盖关键预测错误。

Method: 开展系统性实证诊断，分析未校准固定决策边界在严重类别不平衡下的表现；计算宏观准确率、宏观F1、宏观召回率、ROC-AUC等指标；进行特征相关性分析，评估拓扑指数与指纹密度指标的线性冗余。

Result: 发现显著准确率悖论：平均准确率77.16%具有欺骗性，宏观F1仅0.3976，宏观召回率0.3872。多数类过度预测，少数类召回率急剧下降，EC6召回率为0%尽管ROC-AUC为0.5857。特征分析显示拓扑指数间高线性冗余。

Conclusion: 标准点预测掩盖生物信息学工作流中的关键错误；目标特定阈值优化和事后共形校准是可靠应用机器学习和深度学习架构的必要开源后处理防护措施。

Abstract: Automated prediction of Enzyme Commission (EC) numbers plays a central role in functional annotation and computational drug discovery. However, standard multi-label machine learning pipelines frequently rely on default decision thresholds (t=0.50), assuming balanced prior distributions across target heads. In this study, we present a systematic empirical diagnostic of uncalibrated fixed decision boundaries operating under severe class imbalance across N = 14,096 annotated compounds categorized into six primary EC classes (EC1-EC6). Our results highlight a pronounced Accuracy Paradox: while the multi-label system achieves a deceivingly high mean accuracy of 77.16%, the macro F1-score (0.3976) and macro recall (0.3872) reveal severe predictive breakdown. Majority target classes suffer from hyper-sensitivity and over-prediction, whereas minority classes exhibit sharp recall decay, culminating in a total decision boundary collapse for EC6 (Recall = 0.00%) despite underlying discriminative power (ROC-AUC = 0.5857). Feature correlation analysis further reveals high linear redundancy among topological indices relative to fingerprint density metrics. Ultimately, this diagnostic study demonstrates that standard point predictions mask critical errors in bioinformatics workflows. We establish target-specific threshold optimization and post-hoc conformal calibration as essential, open-source post-processing safeguards for reliable applied machine learning and deep learning architectures.

</details>


### [365] [AVCG: A Generalized Variational Framework for Counterfactual Generation under Hypothesis Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07917)
*Jamie Duell,Alejandro Jimenez Rodriguez,Mahault Albarracin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了 Amortized Variational Counterfactual Generator (AVCG)，一种针对反事实解释的新框架，它不再依赖单一确定性预测器，而是在多个合理预测假设的分布上进行优化，从而生成对模型更新和预测不确定性具有鲁棒性的反事实解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统反事实解释方法基于单一确定性点估计预测器，忽略了预测不确定性和假设空间的变异性，导致生成的解释脆弱，模型重新训练或更新后容易失效。

Method: AVCG 将反事实生成建模为在任意合理预测假设分布（如贝叶斯后验、Rashomon 限制假设空间等）上的优化问题，采用摊销变分推理实现单次前向传播的高效生成，统一了不确定性建模与反事实优化。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，AVCG 生成的反事实在预测不确定性和模型变更下保持高有效性，同时在合理性和单次推理运行时性能上与现有方法具有竞争力。

Conclusion: AVCG 通过分布层面的优化解决了反事实解释的脆弱性问题，为纳入预测不确定性提供了统一框架，是迈向可靠、鲁棒反事实解释的重要一步。

Abstract: Counterfactual explanations formalize "what-if" scenarios by identifying modifications to an input instance that obtain a desired alternative prediction. Traditionally, whether generated via instance-specific optimization or amortized single pass models, these approaches rely on a single, deterministic point-estimate predictor. However, this ignores predictive uncertainty and hypothesis variability, leading to brittle explanations that frequently become invalid if the underlying model is retrained or updated. To address this fragility, we propose the Amortized Variational Counterfactual Generator (AVCG), a generalized optimization framework that formulates counterfactual generation as optimization over an arbitrary distribution of plausible predictive hypotheses rather than a single deterministic predictor. This formulation naturally accommodates Bayesian posteriors, Rashomon-restricted hypothesis spaces, and other uncertainty representations within a unified optimization framework. Evaluation across multiple benchmark datasets demonstrates that the AVCG framework produces counterfactual explanations that remain highly valid under predictive uncertainty and model changes, while maintaining competitive plausibility and single-pass runtime performance.

</details>


### [366] [Prevalence calibration as shortcut mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07922)
*Mohamed Amine Kina,Eike Petersen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将捷径学习重构为校准问题，提出两种编码器无关的方法（训练中正则化器和事后患病率均衡重校准），在胸腔引流-气胸基准上显著优于基线，并揭示捷径依赖主要降低分类头而非底层表示的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有捷径学习缓解策略主要学习捷径不变表示，经验成功有限且无法应用于冻结基础模型编码器。作者发现无约束学习隐式地将每个捷径组校准到其训练集疾病患病率，导致分类器在一个组过度自信、另一个组自信不足。

Method: 提出两种编码器无关方法：1) 训练中正则化器，显式约束捷径组间的校准；2) 事后患病率均衡重校准步骤，调整预测概率以匹配各组患病率。两种方法均不依赖编码器架构，适用于微调CNN和冻结基础模型。

Result: 在CheXpert和SIIM-ACR胸腔引流-气胸基准上，两种方法均大幅优于所有基线。事后重校准将标准ERM训练的DenseNet在错位组上的AUROC从0.23提升至0.73，表明捷径依赖主要损害分类头而非底层表示。

Conclusion: 除了提供两种新的最先进捷径缓解方法外，研究从根本上将捷径学习与校准理论及算法公平性联系起来，揭示了捷径学习的本质是校准问题。

Abstract: Shortcut learning denotes the widespread situation in which a classifier exploits spurious correlations rather than diagnostic features. Existing mitigation strategies mostly aim to learn shortcut-invariant representations; their empirical success is limited and they cannot be applied to classifiers using frozen foundation model encoders. We propose to reframe shortcut learning as fundamentally a calibration problem: unconstrained learning implicitly calibrates each shortcut group to its training set disease prevalence, rendering the resulting classifier necessarily over-confident in one group and under-confident in the other. Building on this insight, we prevalence-equalize calibration between shortcut groups through two encoder-agnostic methods, an in-processing regularizer and a post-hoc prevalence-equalized recalibration step. Across chest-drain-pneumothorax benchmarks on CheXpert and SIIM-ACR, spanning fine-tuned CNNs and frozen foundation-model backbones, both methods substantially outperform all baselines. Post-hoc recalibration of a standard ERM-trained DenseNet raises misaligned-group AUROC from 0.23 to 0.73, indicating that shortcut reliance degrades the classification head rather than the underlying representation. Besides two new state-of-the-art shortcut mitigation approaches, our findings more fundamentally connect shortcut learning to calibration theory and algorithmic fairness.

</details>


### [367] [Structured Extrema Errors in Classical Surrogates for Viscous Burgers: A Physics-Consistent Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07952)
*Youssef Oubari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究四种机器学习代理模型（RBF核脊回归、线性Ridge、ExtraTrees、随机森林）在一维粘性Burgers方程时间演化预测中的局部误差。发现所有一步残差在预测极值附近形成清晰的弯曲分支，且与二阶空间导数（曲率）强相关。对KRR和Ridge的进一步分析显示，误差主要源于中高粘度下的粘性平滑不足，导致代理模型保留了比真实未来状态更多的小尺度结构。基于曲率的几何误差模型提出了一种仅使用预测量的校正方法，显著降低了一步预测误差和递归滚动预测误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解机器学习代理模型在求解偏微分方程（PDE）时的局部误差模式，特别是误差如何与物理项（对流/平流和扩散/平滑）相关联，以及为何在极值附近会出现系统性的几何误差结构。

Method: 在相同预测任务上对比四种模型，直接使用空间网格值。分析一步残差（真实值减预测值）与一阶、二阶空间导数的关系。对KRR进行详细几何分析，建立曲率-残差折叠模型。通过保留轨迹回归测试、打破扩散项空间对齐的控制实验、高频谱含量测试，验证物理解释。最后设计仅基于预测量的曲率校正方法。

Result: 1）四种模型的一步残差均在预测极值附近形成弯曲双分支结构。2）KRR误差与二阶导数（曲率）强相关，而非一阶导数。3）平滑极值处预测值与曲率形成局部双分支折叠，导致预测值-残差呈准抛物线关系。4）KRR和Ridge在中高粘度下表现出粘性平滑不足（保留过多小尺度结构），树模型则无此现象。5）基于预测曲率的校正同时降低了一步误差和递归滚动误差。

Conclusion: 局部误差几何揭示了核/线性代理模型在Burgers方程中的物理缺陷：扩散项建模不足。曲率感知的几何校正可在无真实状态信息的情况下改善单步和长期预测精度，为物理一致的机器学习代理模型提供了新思路。

Abstract: We study the local errors of classical machine-learning surrogate models, which approximate the time evolution of the one-dimensional viscous Burgers equation. Four models are compared on the same prediction task, using the spatial grid values directly: radial basis function (RBF) kernel ridge regression (KRR), linear Ridge, ExtraTrees, and Random Forests. Across all four models, the one-step residual, defined here as the true value minus the predicted value at each grid point, forms clear curved branches near predicted maxima and minima. A more detailed analysis of KRR shows that these errors are much more strongly related to the second spatial derivative, which measures local curvature, than to the first spatial derivative. Near a smooth extremum, predicted value and curvature form a local two-branch fold. Under our local curvature-based model of the residual, this fold predicts a leading-order near-parabolic relation between predicted value and residual. This geometric result motivates a direct test of the Burgers advection (transport) and diffusion (smoothing) terms. For KRR and Ridge, regression tests on held-out trajectories, a control that breaks the spatial alignment of the diffusion term, and a spectral test of high-frequency content are consistent with insufficient viscous smoothing at moderate and high viscosity. In this case, the surrogate retains more small-scale structure than the true future state. The same physical explanation is much weaker for the tree models. Finally, a correction that uses only predicted quantities reduces both one-step error and error during recursive rollout, where each prediction is used as the next input.

</details>


### [368] [Streaming Hierarchical Inference with Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07956)
*Vitor Crista,Afonso Lourenço,Diogo Martinho,Goreti Marreiros*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HINT，一种分层推理框架，结合边缘端图近似最近邻检索与云端表格基础模型（TFM），通过不确定性感知的选择性卸载，在保持预测性能的同时大幅降低通信开销和延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型（TFM）虽在语境学习中表现优异，但部署于高吞吐数据流时面临通信开销大、延迟高的挑战，需一种能平衡预测性能与资源消耗的推理架构。

Method: HINT维护滑动窗口上的图近似最近邻记忆，提供本地预测与不确定性估计；置信样本本地处理，不确定样本连同上下文卸载至云端TFM。框架暴露卸载阈值与邻域检索策略，可调节性能-通信权衡。

Result: 实验表明HINT持续识别出有利的性能-通信权衡点，在多个基准上优于纯云端或纯边缘基线，实现低延迟、低带宽下的高精度推理。

Conclusion: HINT通过边缘检索与云端TFM的协同，解决了TFM在流式场景部署的通信瓶颈，提供可调控的分层推理范式，适用于资源受限的高吞吐表格数据流应用。

Abstract: Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) have recently demonstrated strong predictive performance through in-context learning, but their deployment in high-throughput data streams remains challenging due to communication overhead and latency. We propose \textit{HINT}, a hierarchical inference framework that combines edge-based retrieval with cloud-based TFM inference. A graph-based approximate nearest neighbor memory maintained over a sliding window provides local predictions and uncertainty estimates, allowing confident samples to be processed locally while uncertain instances are selectively offloaded, together with their retrieved context, to a cloud-hosted TFM. The framework exposes an offloading threshold and a neighborhood retrieval policy that can be varied to balance predictive performance and communication cost. Experiments show \textit{HINT} consistently identifies favorable trade-offs.

</details>


### [369] [$α$-Graph: Attention-Infused Normalizing Flow Approach to Tractable Graph Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07961)
*Thanh-Dat Truong,Sarah Alharbi,Susan Gauch,Xinghui Zhao,Marios Savvides,Khoa Luu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于注意力的正规化流方法（ANFA，即α-Graph），用于显式、可解释且可计算的图建模，包含无条件图正规化流（带可逆注意力机制）和条件图正规化流（带可学习查询），在三个基准测试上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图建模方法依赖传统图神经网络和预训练方法隐式学习图数据的关系结构，难以捕捉复杂的图结构和输入间的相关性，缺乏显式性、可解释性和可计算性。

Method: 提出两个核心组件：(1) 无条件图正规化流，引入可逆注意力机制捕捉复杂关系结构；(2) 条件图正规化流，引入可学习查询高效建模图结构数据中的相关性。两者行为相似，在保持训练稳定性和效率的同时增强表达能力。

Result: 在三个基准测试上的实验结果证明了α-Graph方法的有效性，达到了最先进（SOTA）性能。

Conclusion: α-Graph通过注意力机制和正规化流的结合，实现了显式、可解释、可计算的图建模，在捕捉复杂图结构和相关性方面优于现有隐式学习方法，且保持了训练的稳定性和效率。

Abstract: Graph modeling, a crucial task for representing complex relationships in graph-structured data, has achieved significant success in recent years. However, current graph modeling methods rely on traditional Graph Neural Networks and pre-training approaches to implicitly learn the underlying relational structure of graph data. Thus, these prior methods cannot capture the complex graph structure and correlations among inputs. In this paper, we introduce a novel Attention-based Normalizing Flow-based Approach\footnote{Our implementation and models will be released publicly for research reproducibility.} (ANFA or $α$) that provides an explicit, interpretable, and tractable Graph Modeling ($α$-Graph).
