Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of MemForest. Under the unimodal Mem0 framework, MemForest retains \textbf{97.1%} of the original performance while compressing \textbf{50%} of historical memory across three benchmarks (LoCoMo, LongMemEval, and PersonaMem), achieving a \textbf{1.89x} retrieval speedup. Under the multimodal M3-Agent framework, it preserves \textbf{99.7%} of the original performance with a \textbf{50%} compression ratio across two benchmarks (M3-Bench-robot and M3-Bench-web), achieving a \textbf{2.24x} retrieval speedup. \textcolor{RoyalBlue}{\textit{Our code is available at [https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/MemForest.}}](https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/MemForest.}})

</details>


### [608] [Beyond Coherence: Benchmarking Professional Editing-Technique Execution in Multi-Shot Audio-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08275)
*Tianyi Zeng,Junchao Liao,Yujie Wei,Ziying Zhang,Litao Li,Tianyi Wang,Zhichao Wei,Shuyao Xu,Wenwen Qiang,Siyu Zhu,Zhenghao Zhang,Long Qin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 CutCraft，首个用于评估多镜头音视频生成中剪辑技术执行能力的基准，包含显式剪辑规范的结构化提示和分层混合评估框架，并设计了基于智能体的剪辑基线。实验揭示当前模型在连贯性与剪辑指令执行间存在显著差距，美学质量与剪辑合规性弱相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多镜头音视频生成基准主要依赖内容质量、同步性或物理合理性等代理指标，系统性忽略了专业剪辑所需的镜头结构、转场语法、音视频剪辑关系和蒙太奇等编辑技术的实际执行能力，导致无法评估模型是否真正理解并执行剪辑指令。

Method: 1. 构建 CutCraft 基准：扩展结构化多镜头提示，加入显式剪辑规格（如 J-cut、L-cut、转场时机等）。2. 设计分层混合评估框架：包含镜头结构对齐、专家模型指标、工具接地的多模态判断和基于量表的问答评估。3. 开发智能体剪辑基线：将生成分解为规划、镜头级合成和后期合成三阶段，显式实现剪辑语义。

Result: 在 13 个最先进的开闭源模型上评测发现：(1) 所有模型在连贯性与剪辑技术执行间存在持续性差距；(2) 镜头结构不稳定、转场执行控制薄弱、高阶蒙太奇表现急剧下降；(3) 美学质量与剪辑技术合规性仅呈弱相关。

Conclusion: CutCraft 填补了多镜头音视频生成中剪辑技术执行评估的空白，揭示了当前系统在编辑指令遵循上的根本局限。基准、评估指标和智能体基线的开源将推动面向专业剪辑语义的生成模型研究。

Abstract: Recent multi-shot audio-video generators can produce increasingly coherent and cinematic outputs, but coherence does not imply the ability to execute editing techniques. Professional editing depends on shot structure, transition grammar, audio-video cut relations, and montage, yet existing benchmarks largely rely on proxies such as content quality, synchronization, or physical plausibility, systematically missing whether such editing instructions are actually executed. We introduce CutCraft, the first benchmark for editing-technique execution in multi-shot audio-video generation. CutCraft extends structured multi-shot prompts with explicit editing specifications and is paired with a hierarchical hybrid evaluation framework that combines shot-structure alignment, expert-model metrics, tool-grounded multimodal judgment, and rubric-based question answering. Beyond evaluation, we design an agentic editing baseline that decomposes generation into planning, shot-level synthesis, and post-hoc composition, explicitly realizing editing semantics such as J-cuts, L-cuts, and transition timing. Across 13 state-of-the-art closed- and open-source models, CutCraft reveals a consistent gap between coherence and editing-technique execution: current systems often produce plausible multi-shot videos yet fail to execute editorial instructions reliably. We find unstable shot structures, weak control of transition execution, and sharp degradation on higher-order montage, while aesthetic quality is only weakly correlated with editing-technique compliance. The benchmark and metrics, and the editing agent baseline are available at https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/cut-craft-bench.

</details>


### [609] [LEBGen: An LLM-Enhanced Bayesian Network Framework for Few-Shot Travel Survey Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08288)
*Zijian Shen,Bin Zhou,Jiguang Wang,Ya Zhao,Jintao Ke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LEBGen 是一种基于大语言模型增强的贝叶斯网络框架，用于从少量样本生成合成出行调查数据，显著提升了分布保真度和依赖关系保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模出行调查数据收集成本高、耗时长，少量样本无法充分覆盖异质出行者群体，也缺乏足够统计证据恢复人口特征与出行行为间的复杂依赖。现有概率生成模型（如贝叶斯网络）虽提供显式分布控制，但从少量样本学习的结构可能遗漏有意义依赖或保留虚假依赖；大语言模型可提供行为知识补充有限统计证据。

Method: LEBGen 利用 LLM 从人口属性和出行行为统计中识别出行者画像，随后在画像增强的贝叶斯网络结构基础上，恢复被遗漏的依赖并剪除虚假依赖，最后仅用观测数据参数化优化后的网络生成合成记录。

Result: 在 2022 年香港出行特征调查的 2% 少样本设置下，LEBGen 将平均边际 Jensen-Shannon 散度从 0.0671 降至 0.0091，并将平均绝对 Cramer's V 误差降低 14.3%，显著优于最佳基线。

Conclusion: LEBGen 通过融合大语言模型的行为知识与贝叶斯网络的显式分布建模，有效解决了少样本条件下合成出行调查数据的分布保真度与依赖保真度难题。

Abstract: Travel survey data are essential for transportation planning and travel behavior analysis, yet collecting large-scale representative samples is costly and time-consuming. A practical alternative is to generate synthetic survey records from a few-shot sample. However, such samples provide incomplete coverage of heterogeneous traveler groups and insufficient evidence for recovering the complex dependencies between demographic characteristics and travel behavior. Existing approaches have complementary limitations. Probabilistic generative models such as Bayesian networks (BNs) offer explicit distributional control, but structures learned from few-shot samples may omit meaningful dependencies or retain spurious ones. Large language models (LLMs) can help address these difficulties in BN structure learning by providing behavioral knowledge that complements the limited statistical evidence. We therefore propose LEBGen, an LLM-enhanced BN framework that uses this knowledge to refine network structure for few-shot travel survey data generation. Specifically, the LLM first identifies traveler personas from demographic attribute and travel behavior statistics, then recovers dependencies missed by the persona-augmented BN structure and prune spurious ones. The refined BN is parameterized exclusively from the observed data to generate synthetic records. Under a 2% few-shot setting on the 2022 Hong Kong Travel Characteristics Survey, LEBGen reduces the mean marginal Jensen-Shannon divergence from 0.0671 to 0.0091 and the mean absolute Cramer's V error by 14.3% over the best-performing baseline, substantially improving both distributional and dependency fidelity.

</details>


### [610] [FastE: Readout-Triggered Token Compression for LLM Embedding Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08407)
*Jinsong Shu,Jinyong Wen,Baokun Wang,Zhongle Xie,Lidan Shou,Weiqiang Wang,Gang Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了 FastE，一种无需训练、即插即用的方法，利用深度相关的前缀冗余特性，通过基于注意力得分的前缀状态剪枝，在保持嵌入质量的同时大幅降低大语言模型嵌入模型的计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究发现最终读出式 LLM 嵌入模型（如 Qwen3-Embedding 和 Qwen3-VL-Embedding）存在深度依赖的前缀冗余：浅层移除前缀状态损害大，深层则前缀状态愈发可压缩。现有方法未充分利用这一特性，亟需一种免训练、可灵活控制质量-效率权衡的加速方案。

Method: FastE 采用共享固定阈值对批次平均读出-前缀对齐度进行在线启发式判断，决定何时触发压缩；并依据读出位置对前缀状态的注意力得分对前缀状态排序，保留高分状态进入后续层。该方法无需重新训练，通过最大移除比例直接自定义质量-效率权衡。

Result: 在 NarrativeQA 上使用 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B，FastE 将解码器主干 FLOPs 降低 40.11%，同时保留 99.53% 的 Full Forward nDCG@10。跨五个文本嵌入基准、两种模型规模及三个跨模态检索任务，均展现出可通过最大移除比例灵活控制的质量-效率权衡。

Conclusion: FastE 为检索、索引、聚类及多模态表征系统中的大规模嵌入生成提供了实用的可扩展加速方案。

Abstract: In this study, we identify depth-dependent prefix redundancy in final-readout LLM embedding models, notably across representative backbones including Qwen3-Embedding and Qwen3-VL-Embedding. We find that removing prefix states is substantially more damaging in shallow layers than at greater depth, showing that prefix states become increasingly compressible as the prefix and readout states propagate through the network. To this end, we introduce FastE, a training-free, plug-and-play method. FastE uses a shared fixed threshold on batch-mean readout-prefix alignment as a lightweight online heuristic for selecting when compression occurs, and ranks prefix states by the attention scores they receive from the readout position to determine which states are retained in subsequent layers. Our evaluations demonstrate FastE's ability to substantially reduce computational costs: on NarrativeQA with Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, it reduces decoder-backbone FLOPs by 40.11% while retaining 99.53% of Full Forward nDCG@10. Across five text embedding benchmarks, two backbone scales, and three cross-modal retrieval tasks, the quality-efficiency trade-off is directly customizable through the maximum removal ratio without retraining. We believe FastE offers practical value for scalable embedding generation in retrieval, indexing, clustering, and multimodal representation systems.

</details>


### [611] [EvolveScaler: Synthesizing Information-Evolution Contexts via Executable State Machines and Natural-Language Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08435)
*Ziliang Zhao,Zenan Xu,Shuting Wang,Zhao Wang,Bowen Cao,Minda Hu,Lincheng Li,Pluto Zhou,Zhicheng Dou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了 EvolveScaler，一个代码驱动的框架，用于合成信息演化（IE）任务。通过人工编写的操作规范定义状态转移、记录有效性、难度控制和可执行答案逻辑，再由强大 LLM 生成自包含模拟器，执行模拟器产生自然语言多轮事件历史，并通过确定性重放计算参考答案和原子检查表。实验表明，EvolveScaler 生成的数据既能作为极具挑战性的评估基准，又能提供可迁移的训练监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在持续交互中，长上下文往往编码的是演化过程而非固定记录：后续事件可能修订或撤销早期信息，改变有效内容和推导结论。现有的文本优先合成流程使得状态转移和答案逻辑隐式化，难以验证。因此需要一种能显式建模信息演化、生成可验证、可控难度的合成数据的方法。

Method: EvolveScaler 采用代码驱动范式：1) 人工编写操作规范，定义状态转移、记录有效性、难度控制和可执行答案逻辑；2) 强 LLM 根据规范合成自包含模拟器；3) 执行验证后的模拟器生成自然语言多轮事件历史；4) 确定性重放计算参考答案和原子检查表。共实例化 117 个任务原型、159 个最终问题算子，五个难度等级，事件数 7~1200，产出约 35,100 训练样本和 585 个验证评估实例。

Result: 在 very_long 难度层，最强模型 avg@5 达 59.3%，六个模型得分低于 10%。在 6,000 个 EvolveScaler 样本上训练内部 A3B 模型，在八个独立构建的 OOD 基准上均优于基础检查点，平均提升 5.25 分。证明代码驱动的 IE 合成既能提供高难度评估，又能产生可迁移的训练监督。

Conclusion: EvolveScaler 通过显式建模信息演化的操作规范和代码级模拟器，解决了文本优先合成中状态转移和答案逻辑隐式、难以验证的问题。该框架生成的大规模、多难度、可验证的 IE 数据集，不仅构建了极具挑战性的长上下文推理基准，还为模型训练提供了高质量监督信号，显著提升了模型在分布外任务上的泛化能力。

Abstract: In persistent interactions, long contexts may encode an evolving process rather than a fixed record: later events can revise or revoke earlier information, changing what remains valid and what conclusions follow. We call this setting information evolution (IE). Solving IE requires identifying valid records, applying updates in order, and reconstructing the query-relevant state from the event history. Existing text-first synthesis pipelines make such data difficult to verify because state transitions and answer logic remain implicit. We introduce EvolveScaler, a code-driven framework that defines information evolution before rendering it as natural language. Human-authored operational specifications define state transitions, record validity, difficulty controls, and executable answer logic; a strong LLM then synthesizes a self-contained simulator from each specification. Executing validated simulators produces natural-language multi-turn event histories, while deterministic replay computes reference answers and atomic checklists. We instantiate EvolveScaler with 117 task prototypes and 159 final-question operators across five difficulty levels spanning approximately 7 to 1,200 events per instance, yielding about 35,100 training examples and 585 validated evaluation instances. On the very_long tier, the strongest model reaches 59.3% avg@5, while six models score below 10%. Training an internal A3B model on 6,000 EvolveScaler examples improves performance over its base checkpoint on all eight independently constructed out-of-distribution benchmarks, with a 5.25-point average gain. These results show that code-driven IE synthesis provides both challenging evaluation and transferable training supervision.

</details>


### [612] [SRPO: Setwise Relative Policy Optimization for Multi-Agent LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08452)
*Shengtian Yang,Ziyu Xiong,Yu Li,Yewen Li,Qingpeng Cai,Lei Feng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 SRPO（Setwise Relative Policy Optimization），将多智能体 LLM 中共同导致状态转移的最小输出集（活跃集）视为单一多智能体动作，通过集合级策略优化统一分工与协同进化，在数学推理和多轮搜索任务上跨四种模型规模取得最优宏平均性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法单独优化每个响应或轨迹，但多智能体系统中多个输出往往共同引起一个状态转移，导致更新单元与系统实际执行的动作不匹配。

Method: SRPO 将一个转移消耗的最小输出集定义为活跃集并视为一个多智能体动作，将成员对数比率合并为基数归一化的集合比率，仅分配一个相对优势并对集合进行一次裁剪，从而将不同集合大小的分工与联合协同进化统一为同一形式的动作。

Result: 在数学推理和多轮搜索实验中，SRPO 为固定、混合和动态路由工作流提供统一训练接口，跨四种模型规模获得报告对比中最强的宏平均结果；优化诊断进一步表征了不同事件归约和集合大小下的稳定性。

Conclusion: SRPO 通过集合级策略优化解决了多智能体 LLM 中动作-更新单元不匹配问题，实现了灵活工作流的统一训练并展现出优越的性能与稳定性。

Abstract: Multi-agent large language models solve complex tasks by coordinating several policies in a shared environment. However, existing reinforcement learning methods usually optimize each response or trajectory separately, even when several outputs jointly cause one state transition. Consequently, the update unit differs from the action executed by the system. To address this problem, we propose SRPO (Setwise Relative Policy Optimization), which treats the active set the minimal set of outputs consumed by one transition, as one multi-agent action. Specifically, SRPO combines member log-ratios into one cardinality-normalized set ratio, assigns one relative advantage, and clips the set once. This formulation unifies division of labor and joint co-evolution as actions with different set sizes. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and multi-turn search demonstrate one training interface for fixed, mixed, and dynamically routed workflows across four model scales, with the strongest macro-average results among the reported comparisons. Optimization diagnostics further characterize its stability under different event reductions and set sizes.

</details>


### [613] [Personalizing LLM Agent Memory Using Biometrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08558)
*Yanhong Qian,Qingguo Meng,Shihao Ding,Xingbo Dong,Zhe Jin,Hanrui Wang,Isao Echizen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Bio-Memory，一种结合生物特征匹配的个性化记忆架构，在多用户共享智能体场景下，通过生物特征嵌入过滤检索候选池后再语义排序，显著提升了属主与非属主查询的区分度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有个性化记忆仅依赖语义相似性，在多用户共享智能体时无法有效区分不同用户的记忆归属，导致隐私泄露或错误检索；需引入身份验证机制作为检索的前置控制信号。

Method: 基于 A-Mem 构建 Bio-Memory，为每条原子记忆笔记附加生物特征嵌入（人脸/掌纹），检索时先通过生物特征匹配形成候选池，再进行语义相似度排序，实现身份感知的记忆检索。

Result: 在 LoCoMo 10用户共享智能体设定下，跨 7 个人脸基准和 10 个掌纹协议，Bio-Memory 持续分离属主与非属主查询。人脸个性化下，CALFW 上 F1/BLEU-1 最大平均差距达 27.29%/21.15%；掌纹个性化下，MS_Blue 上对应差距为 25.75%/19.22%。

Conclusion: 生物特征可作为共享环境中个性化记忆检索的实用控制信号，Bio-Memory 架构有效解决了多用户场景下的记忆隔离与隐私保护问题。

Abstract: Personalized memory helps LLM agents deliver stable, tailored assistance by storing and reusing user-specific data across interactions. In multi-user scenarios, however, retrieval must consider not only semantic similarity but also whether the current requester matches the identity associated with the stored memory. We propose Bio-Memory, a biometric-aware memory architecture that conditions memory retrieval on both semantic similarity and biometric matching. Built on top of A-Mem, Bio-Memory augments each atomic memory note with a biometric embedding and uses biometric matching to form the retrieval candidate pool before semantic ranking. We evaluate Bio-Memory on LoCoMo in a 10-user shared-agent setting over 7 face benchmarks and 10 palmprint protocols. Across datasets, Bio-Memory consistently separates owner and non-owner queries. Under face-based personalization, the largest average gap reaches 27.29% / 21.15% in F1 / BLEU-1 on CALFW; under palmprint-based personalization, the corresponding gap is 25.75% / 19.22% on MS_Blue. These results support biometrics as a practical control signal for personalized memory retrieval in shared environments.

</details>


### [614] [BIO-MEMART: Biometric-Aware KV Cache Memory for Multi-User LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08566)
*Yanhong Qian,Xuanying He,Qingguo Meng,Shihao Ding,Xingbo Dong,Zhe Jin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Bio-MemArt 是一种面向多用户 LLM 代理的生物特征感知 KV 缓存内存框架，通过为每个存储的 KV 内存块附加归一化生物特征模板，利用当前用户的生物特征探针过滤共享内存池，仅在授权候选池内执行原有 MemArt 检索与 KV 复用流程，实现了物理用户级别的访问控制，同时保留了潜空间检索、直接缓存复用和解耦位置编码等优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在共享多用户部署中，可复用的 KV 块引入了缺失的访问控制问题：仅凭语义相关性无法判断内存块是否被授权给当前物理用户。现有 KV 缓存优化缺乏生物特征级别的物理用户隔离机制，导致隐私泄露与跨用户内存污染风险。

Method: Bio-MemArt 将归一化生物特征模板（人脸/掌纹）作为元数据绑定至每个 KV 内存块；推理时，以当前用户的生物特征探针对共享内存池进行生物特征门控过滤，得到授权候选池；随后在该候选池内沿用 MemArt 的潜空间检索、直接 KV 复用及解耦位置编码流程。该设计与现有 KV 缓存服务栈正交，无需修改模型权重。

Result: 在长期对话 QA 任务上，人脸基准下 Owner/Non-owner 生物特征通过率分别为 95.71%/0.86%，掌纹基准下分别为 97.60%/2.00%。效率实验显示，平均预填充 token 从全上下文提示的 18,781.96 降至 28.57，生物特征门控保持了 KV 缓存内存的低 token 运行 regime。

Conclusion: Bio-MemArt 通过轻量级生物特征门控在共享 KV 缓存层实现了物理用户级的强隔离，兼顾了安全性与 KV 复用带来的极致推理效率，为长期多用户 LLM 代理部署提供了可落地的内存访问控制范式。

Abstract: KV cache is evolving from a serving optimization into an external memory substrate for long-term LLM agents. In a shared multi-user deployment, however, reusable KV blocks introduce a missing access-control question: semantic relevance alone cannot determine whether a memory block is authorized for the current physical user. We propose Bio-MemArt, a biometric-aware KV-cache memory framework for multi-user LLM agents. Bio-MemArt attaches a normalized biometric template to each stored KV memory block, filters the shared memory pool with the current user's biometric probe, and then runs the original MemArt retrieval and KV reuse pipeline only inside the authorized candidate pool. This design preserves latent-space retrieval, direct cache reuse, and decoupled position encoding while adding physical-user access control to shared KV memory. We evaluate Bio-MemArt under Owner and Non-owner query conditions on long-term dialogue QA with face and palmprint benchmarks. Across face benchmarks, the average owner and non-owner biometric success rates are 95.71% and 0.86%; across palmprint benchmarks, they are 97.60% and 2.00%. In the efficiency study, average prefill tokens drop from 18,781.96 under full-context prompting to 28.57 with Bio-MemArt, showing that biometric gating preserves the low-token operating regime of KV-cache memory.

</details>


### [615] [AgentGrad: Intervention-guided Prompt Optimization for Multi Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08572)
*Jaewon Chu,Jinwoo Seo,Jaewon Cho,Jeehye Na,Yunyang Xiong,Youngdae Kim,Hyunwoo J. Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了 AgentGrad，一种基于顺序干预和语义文本梯度抽象的多智能体系统提示优化框架，解决了现有文本梯度方法在梯度提取和聚合阶段的局限，在五个 MAS 基准上达到 SOTA 并将优化时间平均降低 2.5 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于文本梯度的多智能体提示优化方法存在两个关键缺陷：(1) 梯度提取阶段未验证修改目标提示是否能解决失败，且缺乏代理级监督；(2) 梯度聚合阶段随机拼接梯度，混合无关失败模式导致泛化性差。

Method: AgentGrad 包含两大核心组件：顺序干预逐个修改智能体行为以定位关键智能体，并利用其修改后的输出作为代理级监督提取细粒度梯度；语义文本梯度抽象将语义相似的梯度聚类，防止无关失败模式混合，并将每簇抽象为捕捉共享修正模式的泛化梯度。

Result: 在五个 MAS 基准测试中，AgentGrad 实现了最先进的性能，且平均墙钟优化时间比次优基线减少 2.5 倍。

Conclusion: 通过顺序干预实现精准的梯度提取和语义聚类实现有效的梯度聚合，AgentGrad 显著提升了多智能体系统提示优化的效果与效率，为基于文本梯度的 MAS 优化提供了新范式。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) achieve strong performance by employing specialized multiple agents, yet their performance depends on the prompt design of each agent. For MAS prompt optimization, textual gradient methods that guide prompt updates using natural-language feedback have emerged as a leading paradigm. In this paper, we identify limitations in two stages of existing textual gradient approaches: gradient extraction and gradient aggregation. In gradient extraction, previous works select a target prompt without verifying whether modifying it resolves the failure, and derive gradients without agent-level supervision over the corresponding agent's intermediate output. In gradient aggregation, individual gradients are randomly grouped and concatenated, often mixing unrelated failure modes and producing prompts that fail to generalize. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{AgentGrad}, a prompt optimization framework for multi-agent systems based on sequential intervention and semantic textual gradient abstraction. For each failure, sequential intervention modifies the behavior of one agent at a time to identify the target agent whose modification resolves the failure. The modified output of the target agent then serves as agent-level supervision for extracting a fine-grained gradient. Semantic textual gradient abstraction clusters semantically similar gradients to prevent mixing unrelated failure modes, and abstracts each cluster into a generalized gradient that captures the shared corrective pattern. Experimental results show that AgentGrad achieves state-of-the-art performance across five MAS benchmarks and reduces wall-clock optimization time by $2.5\times$ on average compared to the next-fastest baseline.

</details>


### [616] [A Three-Tier Persona Vector for Controllable User Simulation in Agentic Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08592)
*Rahul Khedar,Eshita,Sneha Teja Sree Reddy Thondapu,Mayank Malhotra,Arup Kumar Das,Jitesh Chandra Mishra,Arun Menon,Avinash Karn,Mouli V*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出三层人设向量（23个操作化维度）用于评估工具增强LLM代理，通过合成数据生成管道验证了人设向量能产生可测量的用户行为差异，且情绪状态随场景变化，模型可复现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估框架使用扁平角色描述导致对话同质化，缺乏多样化、真实的用户输入，需要更细粒度、可控且可复现的用户模拟模型。

Method: 构建三层人设向量：6个分类人口统计学维度、12个连续行为特质（高斯噪声采样）、5个连续情绪状态（随场景动态变化），正交引入4级查询复杂度覆盖层；在合成数据生成管道中跨8个命名人设和3个生产语料库生成64,698轮多轮对话进行评估。

Result: (i) 不同人设下代理目标达成率相差15.8个百分点，确认特质向量产生可测量行为差异；(ii) 同一人设在不同场景下表现不同，验证场景响应式情绪状态设计；(iii) 预订流程合规性上人设敏感性差距15-20个百分点，表明模型忠实复现真实难度分布；(iv) 七条规则描述的特质相关性产生可审计共现模式，无需学习协方差矩阵。

Conclusion: 三层人设向量模型完全指定且可复现，能生成多样化、真实且可控的用户行为，为工具增强LLM代理评估提供更严谨的基准。

Abstract: Evaluating tool-augmented LLM agents requires diverse, realistic user inputs yet most evaluation frameworks use flat role descriptions ("you are an angry customer") that produce near-identical conversations regardless of the underlying scenario. In this paper, we propose a three-tier persona vector with 23 operationalized dimensions: 6 categorical demographics (jurisdiction, age, channel, device, language proficiency, time availability), 12 continuous behavioral traits (patience, assertiveness, digital literacy, etc.) sampled with Gaussian noise around curated profile base vectors, and 5 continuous emotional states (frustration, anxiety, trust, confidence, stress) that shift in response to scenario context. Orthogonal to the persona, a 4-level query-complexity overlay controls utterance phrasing from direct to deliberately vague. We evaluate the persona model inside a synthetic data generation pipeline across 64,698 multi-turn conversations spanning 8 named profiles and 3 production corpora. Key findings: (i) a 15.8 percentage-point spread in agent goal-achievement across personas confirms trait vectors produce measurably different user behavior; (ii) the same persona behaves differently across scenarios due to scenario-reactive emotional state shifts, validating the scenario-reactive design; (iii) domain-specific projects show persona sensitivity on booking-flow compliance (~15-20 percentage points gap between tier-aware and pressure-test personas), demonstrating the model faithfully reproduces real-world difficulty distributions; (iv) seven rule-described trait correlations produce auditable co-occurrence patterns without requiring learned covariance matrices. The persona model is fully specified for reproduction.

</details>


### [617] [Graph-Based Personalized Memory for LLM Agents: Representation, Evolution, Retrieval, and Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08599)
*Dac Duy Anh Nguyen,Zhangchi Qiu,Shigeng Chen,Alan Wee-Chung Liew*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一份关于基于图的个性化记忆在大语言模型（LLM）智能体中应用的综述。文章以生命周期视角组织现有研究，涵盖记忆表示、记忆演化、记忆检索和记忆评估四个维度，对比关键设计选择，讨论评估实践与开放挑战，旨在阐明图基记忆如何支撑自适应、可控、以用户为中心的长期个性化智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM智能体从单会话工具向长期个人助理演进，个性化成为核心需求。用户偏好、目标、约束、关系及过往经验随时间累积并动态变化，需要结构化记忆建模。基于图的个性化记忆通过显式关系、时间上下文和证据链接，能同时建模智能体“记住什么”以及记忆如何关联、修订和检索。然而现有工作分散于个性化智能体与通用图记忆框架之间，缺乏统一的设计空间视角。

Method: 采用文献综述方法，构建生命周期导向的分析框架。将现有研究归类为四大模块：记忆表示（图结构、实体关系、时间建模）、记忆演化（增量更新、冲突消解、遗忘机制）、记忆检索（相关性排序、上下文感知、多跳推理）、记忆评估（指标体系、基准测试、用户研究）。并对比关键设计决策（如图构建策略、更新频率、检索粒度），梳理现有评估范式与局限。

Result: 形成了基于图的个性化记忆系统化分类体系，明确了各生命周期阶段的主流技术路线与权衡；总结了当前评估实践中缺乏统一基准、长期动态评估不足等问题；指出了可扩展性、隐私合规、记忆一致性、用户控制权等构建可靠长期个性化智能体的核心开放挑战。

Conclusion: 图基个性化记忆为LLM智能体提供了结构化、可解释、可演化的长期记忆基础，能有效支撑自适应、可控、以用户为中心的个性化交互。未来研究需聚焦统一评估基准建设、隐私保护机制、记忆冲突消解、用户主导的记忆治理等方向，推动可靠长期个性化智能体的落地。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are evolving from single-session tools toward long-term personal assistants that must adapt to individual users across tasks, contexts, and interactions. This shift makes memory a core requirement for personalization, since user preferences, goals, constraints, relationships, and past experiences are accumulated gradually and often change over time. Graph-based personalized memory provides a structured way to model such user information through explicit relations, temporal context, and evidence links. Such representations can model not only what an agent remembers about a user but also how memories are connected, revised, and retrieved to support personalized decisions. However, existing work remains fragmented across personalized agents and generic graph memory frameworks, making it difficult to understand the design space as a whole. This survey develops a lifecycle-oriented view of graph-based personalized memory for LLM agents. We organize existing studies around memory representation, memory evolution, memory retrieval, and memory evaluation. We further compare key design choices, discuss current evaluation practices, and open challenges in building reliable long-term personalized agents. This survey aims to clarify how graph-based memory can support adaptive, controllable, and user-centric LLM agents.

</details>


### [618] [CLAMP: Constrained Decoding for Vision-Language Embodied Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08602)
*Tianyi Ma,Parisa Kordjamshidi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CLAMP 是一个多模态约束接地框架，通过将场景证据转化为解码时的硬约束，使冻结的视觉语言模型（VLM）规划器生成的计划在视觉上可落地、动作可执行且符合目标约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的具身规划依赖 VLM 将指令和视觉观测转化为动作序列，但生成的流畅计划往往不可执行：可能引用未被观测到的对象、选择缺乏所需 affordance 的动作，或违反语法和动作约束。

Method: CLAMP 利用初始观测限制对象引用仅限于场景支持的对象，并引入符号动作模型指定状态转移和目标。解码阶段采用硬掩码消除无效的下一个 token 候选，并引入基于隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）的世界状态前瞻模块，根据动作前置条件和目标可达性重新加权剩余可行候选的概率。对于未见任务和环境，CLAMP 在测试时利用冻结 VLM 采样的无标签续写自适应调整 HMM。

Result: 在 VLABench、SafeAgentBench 和 TaPA 基准上，场景接地约束显著提升了对象接地准确性和安全性；剩余失败主要源于感知错误或约束规范未对齐。

Conclusion: CLAMP 通过在解码时施加多模态硬约束和概率前瞻，成功将 VLM 的语言先验与具身执行约束相结合，实现了零样本泛化下的可执行计划生成，为具身规划中的约束满足提供了一种可扩展的范式。

Abstract: Embodied planning increasingly relies on vision-language models (VLMs) to translate instructions and visual observations into executable action sequences. However, fluent plans are not always executable. A VLM may refer to objects that are not visually observed, select actions whose required affordances are unavailable, or violate syntax and action constraints. We introduce CLAMP, a multimodal constraint-grounding framework that turns scene evidence into decoding-time constraints for a frozen VLM planner. CLAMP uses the initial observation to restrict object references to those supported by the scene, while a provided symbolic action model specifies state transitions and goals. During decoding, hard masks eliminate invalid next-token candidates, while a Hidden Markov Model (HMM)-based world-state lookahead module reweights the probabilities of the remaining feasible candidates based on action preconditions and goal reachability. This allows the planner to retain the VLM's language prior while preventing visually unsupported, unsafe, or infeasible candidates from entering the plan. For unseen tasks and environments, CLAMP adapts the HMM at test time using label-free continuations sampled from the frozen VLM. Experiments on VLABench, SafeAgentBench, and TaPA show that scene-grounded constraints improve object grounding and safety, while most remaining failures stem from perception errors or misaligned constraint specifications.

</details>


### [619] [GoAnt: Quality-Diversity Multi-Agent Search for Alpha Factor Discovery in Market Microstructure Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08719)
*Stella Zhao,Tommy Sha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GoAnt 是一种面向自动化 Alpha 因子挖掘的质量-多样性多智能体搜索框架，通过非通信的探索者、利用者、连接者工作线程与共享自适应心智地图、精简皇后调度器协同，结合无泄漏执行画像的精英保留机制和基于地图无关的有效收益协议，在 A 股微观结构数据上显著提升因子质量与样本外鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单智能体与多智能体程序搜索系统存在两大痛点：一是易过拟合预测代理，导致执行成本考虑后失效；二是重复探索冗余因子家族，限制执行鲁棒性与行为多样性。因此需要一种能同时保证因子质量、多样性及样本外泛化的搜索框架。

Method: 提出 GoAnt 框架：1) 三类非通信工作线程——探索者、利用者、连接者并行搜索；2) 共享自适应心智地图，按无泄漏执行画像划分生态位，每生态位保留单一精英；3) 精简皇后调度器依据显式搜索状态摘要动态重分配评估预算；4) 定义地图无关的有效收益协议，从评估记录直接计数高质量且互不冗余因子，为基于归档与无地图系统提供统一度量标准。

Result: 在 2023-2026 年 A 股微观结构数据实验中：价量面板设置下质量加权收益达 41.8，订单簿设置下达 47.6，分别比最强基线提升 57% 与 97%（预算相当）；锁定种群的样本外保留率为 0.64 与 0.67，优于静态地图的 0.61 与 0.63。

Conclusion: GoAnt 通过质量-多样性协同搜索与自适应预算分配，有效缓解过拟合与冗余探索，显著提升因子发现的执行鲁棒性与行为多样性，并提供统一的有效收益评价协议，为自动化 Alpha 挖掘提供了更可靠的范式。

Abstract: Automated alpha factor discovery searches symbolic trading signals from price-volume panels and order-book data under a fixed evaluation budget. Existing single- and multi-agent program-search systems can overfit predictive proxies that fail after execution costs and repeatedly explore redundant factor families, limiting execution robustness and behavioral diversity. We introduce GoAnt, a quality-diversity multi-agent search framework that combines non-communicating Explorer, Exploiter and Connector workers with a shared adaptive Mental Map and a compact Queen dispatcher. The Mental Map organizes candidates by leakage-free execution profiles and retains one elite per niche, while the Queen reallocates the evaluation budget from explicit search-state summaries. We also define a map-independent effective-yield protocol that counts high-quality, mutually nonredundant factors directly from each method's evaluation records, giving archive-based and map-free systems the same ruler. On real A-share microstructure data spanning 2023--2026, GoAnt reaches quality-weighted yields of 41.8 and 47.6 in price-volume and order-book settings, improving the strongest baseline by 57% and 97% under matched budgets. Its locked populations retain 0.64 and 0.67 of in-sample quality out of sample, compared with 0.61 and 0.63 for a static map.

</details>


### [620] [Application of curiosity driven exploration methods for hardware interference identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08729)
*Ludovic Matar,Clement Moulin-Frier,Pierre-Yves Oudeyer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将多核干扰分析建模为复杂系统行为空间的探索问题，提出利用好奇心驱动的探索算法，在模拟器环境中系统高效地覆盖可能的干扰行为，实验表明该方法在有限预算下比传统伪随机程序生成方法实现更广泛、更均匀的行为覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全关键嵌入式系统从单核向多核转型带来核间干扰挑战，共享硬件资源争用导致执行时间不可预测，难以满足航空电子等领域的严格时序验证需求；现有手动或基于模型的分析方法难以捕捉微架构组件复杂交互产生的全部行为。

Method: 将多核干扰分析形式化为复杂系统行为空间的探索，引入人工智能中的好奇心驱动探索算法，在基于模拟器的环境中系统、高效地覆盖可能的干扰行为空间。

Result: 在有限实验预算下，该方法比传统伪随机程序生成方法实现了更广泛、更均匀的行为覆盖。

Conclusion: 好奇心驱动的探索算法能有效应对多核干扰分析中的状态空间爆炸问题，为安全关键系统的时序验证提供更全面的干扰行为覆盖。

Abstract: The transition from single-core to multi-core architectures in safety-critical embedded systems introduces significant challenges due to inter-core interference caused by contention for shared hardware resources. Such interference affects execution times and complicates the verification of strict temporal requirements, particularly in domains such as avionics where standards require comprehensive identification of interference sources. Existing interference analysis approaches, whether manual or model-based, struggle to capture the full range of behaviors arising from the complex interactions among micro-architectural components. In this paper, we frame multi-core interference analysis as the exploration of a complex system behavior space. We propose the use of curiosity-driven exploration algorithms from artificial intelligence to systematically and efficiently cover the space of possible interference behaviors. Using a simulator-based environment, we show that the proposed approach achieves broader and more uniform behavioral coverage within a limited experimental budget compared to traditional pseudo-random program generation methods.

</details>


### [621] [When Can One Obtain Certificates of Optimality Using Positivstellensaetze?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08736)
*Nayoon Kim,Allen Gehret,Shenyuan Ma,Jakub Marecek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究非多项式学习问题的正性和最优性证书，提出了一种基于抽象函数代数的Fischer Positivstellensätze公理化框架，将目标/约束函数与证书构造原语解耦，适用于连续和可定义函数代数，并给出下界和全局最优性证书及复杂度分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Positivstellensätze理论主要针对多项式优化，但实际学习问题中目标和约束往往非多项式（如神经网络、分段函数等），需要将正性和最优性证书推广到更广泛的函数类，同时将函数构造与证书构造的代数结构解耦。

Method: 从Fischer的构造性严格和弱Positivstellensätze中提取公理核心，在有序域上的抽象函数代数上证明推广定理。框架区分两类原语：目标/约束函数可由连续或可定义运算构建，而证书辅助原语需满足显式标量和闭包公理。在连续函数代数、可定义函数代数（包括非平方根封闭有序域）上给出实例。

Result: 得到适用于非多项式学习问题的正性证书和最优性证书，推导出下界证书和全局最优性证书；分析了展开项长度和共享计算图两种复杂度度量，展示了框架在更广泛函数类上的适用性和计算复杂度特征。

Conclusion: 该公理化框架成功将Positivstellensätze理论从多项式推广到抽象函数代数，实现了函数表达能力与证书代数结构的分离，为非多项式优化问题提供了理论基础和复杂度分析工具，具有广泛的应用潜力。

Abstract: We study certificates of positivity and optimality for learning problems whose objectives and constraints need not be polynomial. We isolate an axiomatic core of Fischer's constructive strict and weak Positivstellensätze and prove the resulting theorems for abstract function algebras over ordered fields. The framework separates two roles that can otherwise be conflated: objective and constraint functions may be built from broad classes of continuous or definable operations, while the auxiliary primitives used to construct a certificate satisfy explicit scalar and closure axioms. We give instances over continuous and definable function algebras, including ordered fields not closed under square roots, derive lower-bound and global-optimality certificates, and analyze both expanded term length and shared computation-graph complexity.

</details>


### [622] [It's All in the Way You Say It: The Role of Information Representation in LLM-Based Glycemic-Event Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08772)
*Andrea Apicella,Pasquale Arpaia,Matteo Orefice,Andrea Pollastro,Roberto Prevete*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了基于提示的通用大语言模型（LLM）在1型糖尿病患者餐后高血糖和低血糖预测中的表现，发现传统监督模型在高血糖预测上表现最优，而最佳提示配置的LLM在所有预测时段（30/60/90分钟）均能提升低血糖预测性能；生理信息的文本表征方式对提示式推理效果影响显著，额外上下文信息并未系统性提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型在生理时间序列预测中的应用增加，其效果不仅取决于模型本身，还取决于生理信息在推理时如何被表征和呈现。本研究旨在系统评估提示式LLM在血糖事件预测中的潜力，并揭示信息表征方式对性能的影响。

Method: 使用OhioT1DM数据集，评估多个开放权重LLM在零样本和少样本设置下的表现，预测时段为30、60、90分钟。实验变量包括生理信息的文本表征形式（从单纯血糖观测到衍生描述符及胰岛素、餐食、碳水化合物、体力活动等上下文变量）及信息量。性能与患者特定监督模型及专门适配血糖预测的Gluco-LLM进行对比。

Result: 呈现显著的任务依赖性：传统监督模型在高血糖预测上达到最强性能；最佳提示式LLM配置在所有预测时段均改善低血糖预测性能。提示式推理的有效性强烈依赖于生理信息的表征方式，而提供额外上下文信息并未带来系统性提升。

Conclusion: 生理信息的表征是基于提示的LLM用于血糖事件预测的核心设计因素。针对低血糖预测，合理设计的提示式LLM可超越传统方法；但高血糖预测仍以患者特定监督模型为优。未来工作应聚焦于优化信息表征策略而非单纯增加上下文变量。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being investigated for physiological time-series prediction, yet their effectiveness may depend not only on the model itself, but also on how physiological information is represented and presented at inference time. This study investigates prompt-based general-purpose LLMs for postprandial hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia prediction in individuals with type 1 diabetes. Using the OhioT1DM dataset, we evaluate multiple open-weight LLMs under zero-shot and few-shot inference across prediction horizons of 30, 60, and 90 minutes. The analysis varies both the textual representation of the available physiological information and the amount of information exposed to the model, ranging from glucose observations alone to derived descriptors and additional contextual variables related to insulin, meals, carbohydrates, and physical activity. Performance is compared with conventional patient-specific supervised models and with Gluco-LLM, a language-model-based architecture explicitly adapted to glucose time-series forecasting. Results show a marked task-dependent behavior. Conventional supervised models achieve the strongest performance for hyperglycemia prediction, whereas the best observed prompt-based LLM configurations improve performance for hypoglycemia across all investigated horizons. The effectiveness of prompt-based inference is also strongly influenced by how physiological information is represented, while providing additional contextual information does not lead to a systematic improvement. Overall, these findings highlight physiological information representation as a central design factor in prompt-based LLM approaches to glycemic-event prediction.

</details>


### [623] [Closing the Consistency Gap: Self-Evolving Agents That Learn to Stay on Course](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08832)
*Evelyn Duesterwald,Benjamin Elder,Lilian Ngweta,Shashanka Ubaru,Malgorzata Zimon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文发现LLM智能体存在显著的“一致性差距”：单次运行通过率77%但五次全通过仅53%，提出自进化框架通过一致性分析器和指南生成器将不稳定步骤转化为情景记忆，在AppWorld基准上将全通过率提升16-13个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在平均性能上表现良好，但在生产环境中因跨运行不一致而不可靠。实验显示ReAct+GPT-4.1在AppWorld上单次通过率77%但五次全通过仅53%，存在24个百分点的一致性差距。作者认为解决这一差距是可信AI智能体部署的前提条件。

Method: 提出自进化智能体框架，包含两大核心组件：(1)一致性分析器：识别智能体轨迹中不稳定、低一致性的步骤，诊断轨迹在多次执行中翻转的位置和原因；(2)指南生成器：将诊断结果转化为针对性指南，以情景记忆形式存储并在未来相似任务执行时注入智能体。

Result: 在AppWorld基准上使用ReAct+GPT-4.1评估，框架使同任务评估下五次全通过的任务比例提升+16个百分点，在相似任务泛化评估下提升+13个百分点。

Conclusion: 一致性差距是阻碍LLM智能体可信部署的关键问题。通过自进化框架将不稳定执行步骤转化为情景记忆并注入未来执行，可显著缩小一致性差距，提升智能体在重复任务和相似任务上的可靠性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-powered agents can be accurate on average yet unreliable in production, a discrepancy that has been observed but remains largely unaddressed. When given the same task five times, a ReAct agent on the AppWorld benchmark using GPT-4.1 succeeds in all five runs only 53% of the time, even though its per-run pass rate averages 77%. We call this 24-point shortfall the consistency gap, and we argue that addressing it is a precondition for trustworthy AI agent deployment. We present a self-evolving agent framework that reduces this gap by identifying unstable, low-consistency steps in agent trajectories and converting them into episodic memory the agent can draw on in future runs. At its core is a Consistency Analyzer that pinpoints where and why a trajectory is likely to flip across executions, and a Guideline Generator that converts the diagnosis into targeted guidelines, committed to memory and injected into future agent executions on similar tasks. On AppWorld with ReAct/GPT-4.1, our framework raises the fraction of tasks that succeed in all five runs by +16 points on same-task evaluation and +13 points on similar-task generalization.

</details>


### [624] [API Benchmark Scores Do Not Reliably Transfer to Chatbot Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08861)
*Jennifer Wang,Joachim Baumann,Daniel E. Ho,Sanmi Koyejo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文审计了 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 在 API 与部署界面上的表现差异，发现 API 评分系统性高于界面评分（准确率高 3.4 个百分点，一致性高 2.1 个百分点），且 API 参数调整无法可靠消除差距，揭示了 API 评估不能作为部署系统的有效代理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基准分数是模型发布的核心货币，影响采购决策、公众信任与政策制定，但其关键假设是 API 测得的性能能忠实反映部署系统行为。作者旨在挑战该假设，量化 API 与界面之间的性能差距。

Method: 对 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 七个系统在九个基准（通用能力、社会偏见、阿谀奉承）上进行审计，比较 API 与对应界面的准确率与测试-重测一致性；进一步通过改变系统提示、采样参数、推理设置等 API 控制项，尝试复现界面行为。

Result: API 评估平均比界面评估准确率高 3.4 个百分点、一致性高 2.1 个百分点；ChatGPT 的 API-界面差距甚至超过 GPT-5.3 与 GPT-5.4 仅 API 差异。API 控制项虽能改变行为，但无法可靠消除差距。

Conclusion: 存在语境效度鸿沟：通过 API 获得的测量结果不一定能泛化到对应的部署界面，使得 API 评估难以作为部署系统的可靠代理，对基准驱动的决策构成挑战。

Abstract: Benchmark scores are a central currency in model releases: they inform purchasing decisions, shape public trust, and influence policy. Yet, a key assumption underlying benchmark scores is that the model performance measured through APIs faithfully reflects the behavior of deployed systems.
  We challenge this assumption by auditing ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini across seven systems and nine benchmarks spanning general capability, social bias, and sycophancy. We find systematic API--interface differences in both accuracy and consistency. On average, API evaluations score 3.4 percentage points higher in accuracy and 2.1 percentage points higher in test--retest agreement than corresponding interface evaluations. For ChatGPT, the performance difference between API and interface access exceeds the API-only difference between GPT 5.3 and GPT 5.4. Put differently, switching access surfaces can degrade performance as much as downgrading a full model generation.
  We further test whether exposed API controls can reproduce interface behavior by varying system prompts, sampling parameters, and reasoning settings. These controls shift behavior in some cases but do not reliably eliminate the gap. Our findings document a context-validity gap: measurements obtained through APIs do not necessarily generalize to corresponding deployed interfaces, complicating the use of API evaluations as proxies for deployed systems.

</details>


### [625] [SkillAdam: Stable and Efficient Skill Evolution for Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08944)
*Gaoyuan Li,Meihao Fan,Yizhe Liu,Shaolei Zhang,Ju Fan,Siyi Wang,Jiaheng Hou,Xudong Weng,Honghan Tian,Zang Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了SkillAdam框架，借鉴Adam优化器思想，通过优化记忆和波动性驱动的编辑预算，实现了语言模型智能体技能文档的稳定高效自我进化，在七个基准测试中达到SOTA性能，且迭代次数和成本显著降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的智能体技能获取方式存在专家编写成本高、自进化方法优化不稳定且迭代效率低的问题。主要挑战在于方向稳定性（有效修正应累积而非被局部反馈覆盖）和更新自适应性（修订范围需反映近期案例级改进的一致性）。

Method: 提出SkillAdam框架：1) 优化记忆作为一阶矩功能类比，记录已识别问题及先前解决尝试结果，稳定更新方向；2) 波动性驱动的编辑预算作为二阶矩功能类比，追踪近期案例级改进的历史加权变化，自适应控制更新幅度。将Adam优化思想应用于离散非可微技能文档优化。

Result: 在涵盖短程和长程任务的七个基准测试中，SkillAdam实现了最优性能，优化动态更稳定，且比先前方法以显著更少的优化迭代次数和更低成本获得更强技能。

Conclusion: SkillAdam通过引入优化记忆和自适应编辑预算机制，成功解决了技能自我进化中的方向稳定性和更新自适应性挑战，为语言模型智能体技能的自动化优化提供了高效稳定的新范式。

Abstract: Agent skills provide a lightweight way to equip frozen language-model agents with domain knowledge and procedural guidance, yet obtaining high-quality skills remains costly and difficult to scale. Expert-written skills require substantial human effort. Recent skill self-evolution methods automate an iterative loop that uses execution feedback to revise skills, but their heuristic update strategies often yield unstable optimization and low iteration efficiency. We identify two challenges in realizing stable and efficient skill self-evolution. Direction Stability requires effective corrections to accumulate rather than be overwritten by iteration-local feedback. Update Adaptivity requires the scope of each revision to reflect the consistency of recent case-level improvements. We introduce SkillAdam, an Adam-inspired framework for optimizing discrete and non-differentiable skill documents. As a functional analogue of Adam's first moment, an optimization memory records identified problems and the outcomes of prior solution attempts to stabilize the update direction. As a functional analogue of Adam's second moment, a volatility-driven edit budget tracks the history-weighted variation of recent case-level improvements and adaptively controls the update magnitude. Across seven benchmarks that span short- and long-horizon tasks, SkillAdam achieves state-of-the-art performance with more stable optimization dynamics. It also obtains stronger skills with substantially fewer optimization iterations and lower cost than prior methods. Code repository: https://github.com/ruc-datalab/SkillAdam

</details>


### [626] [PlannerForge: LLM Agents for Scenario-Based Testing of Motion Planners in Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08965)
*Yuan Gao,Sebastian Müller,Mattia Piccinini,Marc Kaufeld,Yuchen Zhang,Finn Rasmus Schäfer,Qunying Song,Johannes Betz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PlannerForge 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）智能体的统一框架，覆盖自动驾驶系统（ADS）场景化测试的全流程（生成、检索、修改、执行、评估），并新增 ADS 增强与基准测试两个 LLM 强化阶段。实验表明，开源模型（如 Qwen2.5:35B）在多数任务上媲美商业 API，端到端链路保留 83%/78% 种子查询，且在生成、检索、修改等指标上超越现有基线，成本调优下规划器成功率从 50.4% 提升至 70.2%，碰撞率从 19.0% 降至 8.4%，且无需领域微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前场景化测试流程碎片化，各阶段（生成、检索、修改、执行、分析）由独立工具完成，交互极少；LLM 智能体虽在感知、规划、控制等子系统显示潜力，但尚无工作以统一 LLM 智能体框架覆盖整个场景化测试管线。

Method: 提出 PlannerForge，一个 LLM 智能体框架，扩展所有场景化测试阶段（场景生成 → 选择 → 修改 → 模块路由 → 规划器测试 → 评估），并新增 ADS 增强与 ADS 基准测试两个 LLM 强化阶段。在 10 个现成 LLM（含商业与开源）上，跨 5 种提示条件评估六大任务（生成、选择、修改、模块路由、规划器测试、增强）。

Result: 单任务最佳得分 0.88–1.00；开源 20–35B 模型多数任务匹配商业 API（Qwen2.5:35B 在五任务中三任务持平）。端到端链路保留 83%（商业）/78%（开源）种子查询。自然语言生成可执行场景 193/200，优于 Scenario Factory 2.0（144/200），城市/道路/车辆属性实现率 92–96%。Rank-1 检索 92.0% vs BM25 67.5%。物理有效编辑 ≥94% vs From-Words-to-Collisions 31%。N=400 时成本调优使规划器成功率 50.4%→70.2%，碰撞率 19.0%→8.4%，无需领域微调。

Conclusion: PlannerForge 证实统一 LLM 智能体框架可打通 ADS 场景化测试全链路，开源大模型已具备商业级性能，且通过提示工程与成本调优即可显著提升规划器鲁棒性、降低碰撞，为自动驾驶验证提供低门槛、高自动化的端到端解决方案。

Abstract: Ensuring the safety of autonomous driving is a critical challenge. Scenario-based testing is a systematic process used to validate Autonomous Driving Systems (ADSs), but it remains a fragmented modular pipeline in which scenario generation, retrieval, modification, ADS execution, and results analysis are performed by separate tools with little interaction. Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown promise across ADS sub-systems such as perception, planning, and control. However, no prior work covers the whole scenario-based testing pipeline for ADSs with a unified LLM-agent framework. We present PlannerForge, an LLM-agent framework that extends all scenario-based testing stages (from Scenario Generation to ADS Assessment) and adds two further LLM-enhanced stages: ADS Enhancement and ADS Benchmarking. We evaluate PlannerForge with 10 off-the-shelf LLMs across all tasks (Generation, Selection, Modification, Module Routing, Planner Testing, and Enhancement) under 5 prompt conditions. Best-per-task scores range from 0.88 to 1.00, and open-source 20-35B backends match commercial APIs on most tasks. Open-source models such as Qwen3.6:35B match commercial APIs on three of the five tasks. Chaining the modules end-to-end retains 83% / 78% of seed queries (commercial / open). It outperforms Scenario Factory 2.0 (Finkeldei et al., 2025) on natural-language generation (193 vs. 144 executable of 200) and realises 92-96% of requested city, road and vehicle attributes. It outperforms BM25 (Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009) at rank 1 selection (92.0% vs. 67.5%) and From-Words-to-Collisions (Gao et al., 2025) on physically valid edits (>=94% vs. 31%). At N=400, cost-tuning lifts planner success from 50.4% to 70.2% and cuts collisions from 19.0% to 8.4%, without domain-specific fine-tuning.

</details>


### [627] [Good Pretraining, Bad SFT: Checkpoint Quality Across the Training Stack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08966)
*Sohir Maskey,Philipp Scholl,Jonas Knupp,Pit Neitemeier,Sascha Wirges*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文发现：在30B规模的混合专家模型训练中，仅依据预训练损失或基准分数选择检查点的常规做法可能失效。真正决定下游训练最终表现的是检查点的「解密度」——即在局部权重扰动下保持下游性能的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作普遍假设预训练阶段得分最高的检查点也是后续全量下游训练的最佳起点，但这一假设在大规模MoE训练流水线中未经验证。作者旨在揭示检查点选择的真实有效指标，避免资源浪费在次优起点上。

Method: 在完整的30B参数MoE预训练→下游训练流水线中，系统对比不同预训练检查点作为初始化的最终下游表现；引入「解密度」指标，通过局部权重扰动（如高斯噪声注入）量化检查点对下游任务性能的鲁棒保持能力，并将其与预训练损失/基准分数做相关性分析。

Result: 预训练损失最低或基准分数最高的检查点，并不总能在完整下游训练后保持领先；反之，具有更高「解密度」（即抗扰动性更强）的检查点，在全量下游训练栈后表现显著更优。解密度是比静态预训练指标更可靠的检查点选择信号。

Conclusion: 大规模MoE训练中，检查点选择应从静态预训练指标转向动态鲁棒性指标——解密度。这一发现对训练资源分配、检查点保存策略及自动化模型选择流程具有直接指导意义。

Abstract: Language-model checkpoints are commonly selected by pretraining loss or benchmark scores, assuming that the highest-scoring checkpoint will remain the best starting point for subsequent training. We show that this assumption can fail in a full 30B mixture-of-experts training pipeline. The checkpoints that perform better after the full downstream training stack also have higher solution density, i.e., retain downstream performance under local weight perturbations.

</details>


### [628] [Deposon: An Auditable, Conservation-Guaranteed, Game-Theoretically Tested Scattering Layer over LLM Reasoning Paths](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09001)
*Qihao Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出Deposon散射层，为多步LLM推理提供可机器验证的审计账本，但在真实基准上表现与简单规则过滤器无异，核心价值在于可验证性而非性能提升；融合实验为负面结果，动力学等价命题被证伪，势博弈模型仅近似成立。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决多步LLM推理缺乏可机器复核的审计记录问题，被丢弃的推理路径不留可审计痕迹。

Method: 提出Deposon散射层，将LLM生成的概念分解图每个节点绑定两参数Deposon态；路径经历三通道散射（透射、反射、不可逆耗散），满足T+R+A=1，单路径能量审计偏差≤2.2E-16（机器精度）。在合成陷阱基准和真实基准（GSM8K, StrategyQA）评估，对比六关键词规则过滤器；融合语义先验的凸组合实验；建模反向动力学为图上势博弈，验证可审计标量单调性、近梯度性，量化经验协调比(ECR)，预注册消融协议测试三个动力学等价命题(P1a/P1b/T-P1c)。

Result: 合成基准上路径过滤增益闭合：统一方法达100%，诱饵捕获基线7%/10%。真实基准上与简单六关键词规则过滤器无显著差异（GSM8K 0.87 vs 0.85, McNemar p=0.5; StrategyQA 0.899 vs 0.899），结论修正为“差异价值仅在于机器可验证性”。融合实验负面：凸组合不提升（物理0.484→0.452），λ=2增益为反场伪影，融合增益必须非线性。动力学层面：三命题被预注册消融协议证伪，势博弈主张降级为近似（环图中位残差0.669），仅一致性级别证据存活。

Conclusion: Deposon散射层实现了可机器验证的推理审计账本，但在下游任务性能上无优于简单规则过滤器；核心贡献在于提供可审计的机制而非性能提升；融合语义先验需非线性方式；动力学等价性不成立，势博弈仅近似，需进一步研究非线性融合与动力学建模。

Abstract: Multi-step LLM reasoning lacks a machine-recheckable ledger: discarded reasoning paths leave no auditable record. We propose the Deposon scattering layer, which binds each node of an LLM-generated concept-decomposition graph to a two-parameter Deposon state; paths undergo three-channel scattering -- transmission, reflection, irreversible dissipation -- obeying T+R+A=1 for arbitrary parameters, with a maximum per-path energy-audit deviation of 2.2E-16 (machine epsilon). We report all three evidence tiers honestly. On synthetic trap benchmarks the path-filtering gain is closed (pre-registered): unified reaches 100% versus a decoy-capture baseline at 7%/10%. On real benchmarks the layer is indistinguishable from a trivial six-keyword rule filter (GSM8K 0.87 >= 0.85, McNemar p=0.5; StrategyQA 0.899 = 0.899); no difference is detected here, so we sharpen the claim to "the differential value lies solely in machine verifiability." Fusion yields a second negative result: convex combinations with a semantic prior never improve (physics 0.484 -> 0.452), and the apparent lambda=2 gain is an anti-field artifact; any fusion gain must be nonlinear. Modeling the reverse dynamics as a potential game on the graph, we evidence an auditable scalar's monotonicity and near-gradientness and quantify the empirical coordination ratio (ECR). The three formalized dynamical-equivalence propositions (P1a/P1b/T-P1c) are falsified under the pre-registered kill protocol, and the potential-game claim is downgraded to approximate (cyclic-graph median residual 0.669): only consistency-level evidence survives at the dynamical level. Code: github.com/zeroandcat/Deposon.

</details>


### [629] [Answer-Distribution Trajectories: A Stochastic-Dynamics View of LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09030)
*Mar Gonzàlez I Català,Haitz Sáez de Ocáriz Borde,Davide Murari,Carola-Bibiane Schönlieb,Pietro Liò,George Montañez*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出答案分布轨迹作为分析LLM推理动态的新框架，追踪推理过程中完整的答案预测分布，比端点准确率和熵剖面更细致，揭示探索、修正、移动和承诺四个动态阶段，实验表明相同端点和熵剖面的推理轨迹可能有截然不同的动态，且训练和推理选择系统性地重塑这些剖面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有链式推理评估主要依赖端点准确率，忽略推理路径；熵剖面虽追踪不确定性演变，但不揭示竞争假设。需要更细致的表示来表征推理动态。

Method: 引入答案分布轨迹，基于随机动力学思想，追踪模型在推理展开过程中对答案的完整预测分布。将推理轨迹表征为探索、修正、移动、承诺四个动态阶段。在16个开放权重模型和4个推理基准上实验。

Result: 相同端点和相似熵剖面的轨迹可能表现出实质不同的推理动态；模型内部、跨模型和跨任务存在显著动态变异；不同目标偏好不同动态剖面；训练和推理选择系统性地重塑这些剖面。

Conclusion: 答案分布轨迹为分析和评估LLM推理动态提供了丰富框架。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought reasoning provides a structured computation between a model's input and final answer. Yet it is often evaluated through endpoint accuracy, which ignores the path taken to reach that answer. An emerging line of work addresses this limitation using entropy profiles, which track how uncertainty evolves over the reasoning process but do not reveal which competing hypotheses account for that uncertainty. We introduce answer-distribution trajectories, a stochastic-dynamics-inspired representation that tracks the model's full predictive distribution over answers as reasoning unfolds. As a strictly finer representation than endpoint and entropy summaries, answer-distribution trajectories enable us to characterize a trace through a dynamical reasoning profile spanning exploration, revision, motion, and commitment, and to distinguish different dynamical mechanisms of reasoning success and failure. Across sixteen open-weight language models and four reasoning benchmarks, we show that traces with the same endpoint and similar entropy profiles can exhibit substantially different reasoning dynamics. We further find substantial variation in these dynamics both within and across models and tasks, with different objectives favoring different dynamical profiles. Additionally, we show that training and inference choices systematically reshape these profiles. Our results suggest that answer-distribution trajectories provide a rich framework for analysing and evaluating the dynamics of LLM reasoning.

</details>


### [630] [Time-Varying Data as Sheaves: an Invitation to Narratives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09056)
*Wilmer Leal,Benjamin Merlin Bumpus,Jana K. Nickel,Johan García,James Fairbanks,Warren Dixon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本章提出“叙事理论”作为时变对象的抽象框架，通过三个短例说明其在不同时变数据表示转换、结构分解与不变量提取、多智能体切换拓扑控制建模中的应用，主张抽象视角可跨学科统一时变现象研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代科学工程高度依赖时变数据，但建模工具分散于不同学科，掩盖了共性原理，限制了思想迁移，亟需统一抽象框架。

Method: 构建叙事理论这一抽象数学框架，并开发三个研究短例：1) 分析时变数据不同表示间切换的信息损失；2) 系统分解时变数据为简单片段并获取结构复杂度不变量；3) 应用于控制理论，建模具有切换通信拓扑的多智能体系统。

Result: 叙事理论成功为时变对象提供统一描述，三个短例分别展示了表示转换中的信息损失量化、结构分解与不变量提取算法、以及切换拓扑下多智能体系统的建模方法，验证了框架的理论深度与应用广度。

Conclusion: 适当的抽象视角（叙事理论）能组织并指导跨越数学、工程、控制等多样领域的时变现象研究，促进跨学科思想迁移与共性原理发现。 }

Abstract: Modern science and engineering increasingly rely on time-varying data, yet the mathematical tools used to model temporal phenomena are often developed within separate disciplines, obscuring common principles and limiting the transfer of ideas across fields. This chapter presents the theory of narratives, an abstract framework for time-varying objects of any mathematical kind that supports both theoretical investigations and applications. To illustrate this perspective, the chapter develops three vignettes, each illustrating a different research direction. The first addresses a general concern: What information loss can occur when switching between different representations of temporal data? The second concerns structural and algorithmic approaches: How can we systematically decompose time-varying data into simple pieces and obtain invariants describing its structural complexity? The third is an application to control theory: How can we model multi-agent systems with switching communication topologies? More important than any individual vignette, the central message of this invitation is that a suitable abstract perspective can organize and guide research across remarkably diverse mathematical and scientific domains.

</details>


### [631] [Everything in Moderation: Per-Domain Coverage Optima and Alignment-Resistant Domain Gaps in Multi-Domain Mid-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09081)
*Yunpeng Xu,Kun Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究了中间训练阶段（预训练与对齐之间）的跨领域数据配比对模型逻辑推理能力的影响，发现每个领域都存在内部最优覆盖率（10%-40%），且这种最优配比在后续对齐阶段难以被完全补偿。零覆盖会导致性能崩塌，但部分归因于通用漂移。探索性最优配比在全流程中增益最大但统计显著性边缘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中间训练阶段的领域数据配比通常由数据可得性决定而非 principled design，作者想弄清这种决策带来的影响，以及后续的对齐阶段能否消除这种影响。

Method: 在受控的逻辑推理设置中（Qwen3-8B-Base，4B复现；五个语义规则不相交的KOR-Bench领域），训练30种跨越五领域单纯形的配比（24个扫描配置+6个保留配置），每种配比5个随机种子。实验包含仅中间训练和全流程（含对齐）两种条件。

Result: 1. 每个领域均存在内部覆盖最优：适度带宽（10%-40%）对所有五个领域均最优，校准置换检验二次内部性P≈0.010；拟合的仅中间训练曲线在8B时峰值位于9.9%-35.1%，形状可复现但峰值位置不可复现。2. 固定预算对齐后差距依然存在：补偿性SFT提升116/120个单元格（均值+4.32%），但在5%阈值下0/240对被弥合，10%比率下30/240对被弥合；等预算均匀对照表现几乎相同；置换零假设预期弥合13.8±3.3和77.9±8.5对（P<0.001）。3. 零覆盖导致仅中间训练准确率崩塌，但FineWeb-Edu-only对照显示崩塌混合了通用漂移。探索性θ*配比获得最大全流程增益（+4.36% vs +0.80%/+0.64%百分点），但在Welch检验下仅边缘显著。

Conclusion: 中间训练阶段的领域数据配比对下游逻辑推理能力有显著且持久的影响，存在每个领域的内部最优覆盖率区间。后续固定预算的对齐阶段难以完全弥补中间训练阶段的次优配比。零覆盖会导致严重性能下降，但部分归因于通用分布漂移。最优配比搜索虽能带来最大增益，但统计显著性有限，提示需要更大规模实验验证。

Abstract: Mid-training, the stage between pre-training and alignment, is where a model's per-domain data composition is typically set by data availability rather than principled design. We ask what that decision buys, and whether a later alignment pass can undo it. In a controlled logical-reasoning setting (Qwen3-8B-Base, with a 4B replication; five semantically rule-disjoint KOR-Bench domains) we train 30 allocations spanning the five-domain simplex, 24 sweep configurations plus six withheld from the fit, at five seeds each. Three findings emerge. First, every domain has an interior coverage optimum: the moderate band ($10\%$-$40\%$) is best for all five domains, and a calibrated permutation test for quadratic interiority gives $P\approx0.010$; the fitted mid-training-only curves, with 8B peaks between $9.9\%$ and $35.1\%$, reproduce for curve shape but not peak location. Second, the gaps survive a fixed-budget alignment pass: compensatory SFT raises 116/120 cells (mean $+4.32\%$) yet bridges $0/240$ pairs at a $5\%$ threshold and $30/240$ at a $10\%$ ratio, an equal-budget uniform control behaves almost identically, and a permutation null would bridge $13.8\pm3.3$ and $77.9\pm8.5$ pairs ($P<0.001$). Third, zero coverage collapses mid-training-only accuracy, though a FineWeb-Edu-only control shows the collapse is commingled with generic drift. An exploratory $θ^*$ allocation attains the largest full-pipeline gain ($+4.36\%$ vs. $+0.80\%$/$+0.64\%$\,pp) but is marginal under Welch test.

</details>


### [632] [The Surprising Effectiveness of Approximate Value Iteration in Self-Play](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09094)
*Raphael Boige,Amine Boumaza,Bruno Scherrer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究了在Connect Four、Hex(7x7)和合成游戏中，简单的近似值迭代(AVI)自博弈方法是否能与基于MCTS的AlphaZero竞争。实验表明，AVI学习到的价值函数比AlphaZero更准确，其一步贪婪策略在训练和推理成本大幅更低的情况下仍能与MCTS策略竞争。初步实验显示AVI在Othello和Go(9x9)等更大游戏中也能稳定训练并学习有效价值函数，暗示MCTS方法的成功可能掩盖了更简单方法的实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的游戏程序主要结合搜索与函数近似，以AlphaZero为代表的MCTS方法虽强但计算开销大。作者想探究在非平凡、中等规模游戏中，更简单的方法（如AVI）是否仍具竞争力，以此揭示MCTS的成功是否使更简单且日益可行的方法被忽视。

Method: 实现一个最小化的AVI自博弈框架，使用真实值神谕进行精确评估。在Connect Four、Hex(7x7)和合成游戏上训练AVI，并与AlphaZero对比。此外，在Othello和Go(9x9)上进行初步实验，验证AVI在更大游戏中的稳定性。

Result: AVI学习到的价值函数比AlphaZero更准确；其一步贪婪策略在训练和推理成本大幅更低时，性能与基于MCTS的策略相当。初步实验显示AVI在Othello和Go(9x9)上能稳定训练并学习有效价值函数。

Conclusion: MCTS方法的成功可能使更简单的AVI等方法被忽视；随着现代深度学习工具的发展，这些简单方法变得越来越实用，值得在更大规模游戏中进一步探索。

Abstract: Combining search with function approximation has driven major advances in game-playing programs, making self-play algorithms more competitive than ever. Still, the computational overhead of the most popular methods, based on Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), can be substantial. In this work, we investigate whether simpler methods remain competitive in non-trivial, moderately sized games such as Connect Four, Hex(7x7) and synthetic games. We train a minimal self-play implementation of Approximate Value Iteration (AVI) and use ground-truth oracles for exact evaluation. Contrary to expectations, our results demonstrate the surprising effectiveness of AVI: it learns more accurate value functions than those learned by AlphaZero, while its one-step-lookahead greedy policies remain competitive with MCTS-based policies at substantially lower training and inference costs. Preliminary experiments on Othello and Go(9x9) show that AVI trains stably on larger games and learns effective value functions. These findings suggest that the success of MCTS-based methods may have eclipsed simpler approaches that have become increasingly practical with modern deep-learning tools.

</details>


### [633] [SAEScientist-Bench: Can AI Agents Conduct Autonomous SAE Interpretability Research?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09113)
*Yuqiao Tan,Shizhu He,Jun Zhao,Kang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 SAEScientist-Bench，评估 AI 智能体能否利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）工具进行自主机制性发现。实验显示前沿智能体具备真实的发现能力，在概念分离上接近专家水平，但在因果生成引导上显著滞后，且常误读实验测量结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）研究多聚焦于自动化模型训练管线，但可靠的自主开发缺乏关键支柱：事后监控与审计，以理解模型学到了什么并确保安全对齐。机制可解释性工具（尤其是 SAE）可隔离可解释特征用于模型检查与引导，填补这一空白。

Method: 构建 SAEScientist-Bench，给定目标概念，智能体设计对比探针并在 Gemma-2-9B-IT 的 Gemma Scope 字典（131K+ 特征）中导航以发现最优特征。采用 Neuronpedia 上的专家参考特征为锚点，从激活排名、对比文本上的概念选择性、因果引导三个维度评估。测试 10 种智能体配置、20 个任务。

Result: 前沿智能体展现出真实的发现能力，并在不同评估维度上各有领先，但整体仍远低于专家基线。在将目标概念与对比控制分离上接近专家水平，但在因果生成引导上大幅落后。进一步分析显示智能体虽能设计对比以排除虚假候选，但频繁误读实验测量结果。

Conclusion: 实验性模型理解可作为闭环自主 AI 研发的可测量能力。SAEScientist-Bench 为评估智能体作为科学家利用 SAE 工具进行自主机制性发现提供了基准，揭示了当前智能体在因果引导和实验解读上的短板。

Abstract: While research on recursive self-improvement (RSI) has predominantly automated model training pipelines, reliable autonomous development demands a missing pillar: post-hoc monitoring and auditing to understand what models learn and ensure safe alignment. Mechanistic interpretability tools are essential to bridge this gap, among which Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) serve as a cornerstone by isolating interpretable features for model inspection and steering. In this paper, we introduce SAEScientist-Bench to evaluate whether AI agents can act as scientists utilizing SAE tools for autonomous mechanistic discovery. Given a target concept, an agent designs contrastive probes and navigates a Gemma Scope dictionary of 131K+ features in Gemma-2-9B-IT to discover the optimal feature, evaluated against curated expert reference features anchored on Neuronpedia across activation rank, concept selectivity on contrastive texts, and causal steering. Across 10 agent configurations and 20 tasks, frontier agents demonstrate genuine discovery capabilities and lead different evaluation dimensions, but remain well behind the expert baseline, approaching expert levels on separating target concepts from contrastive controls while lagging substantially in causal generation steering. Further analysis reveals that although agents can design contrasts to rule out spurious candidates, they frequently misinterpret experimental measurements. These results establish experimental model understanding as a measurable capability for closed-loop autonomous AI R&D. Our code is available at https://github.com/Trae1ounG/SAEScientist.

</details>


### [634] [MeClear: Cooperative Game-Theoretic Attribution and Risk-Aware Memory Clearance for Long-Horizon LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09115)
*Boyu Yang,Jiazheng Sun,Zilong Lu,Zhi Qiu,Xin Peng,Jun Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了MeClear，一种面向长周期LLM智能体的任务条件记忆清理框架，通过合作归因识别并抑制负向效用记忆，显著提升任务恢复率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长周期LLM智能体依赖外部记忆系统，但传统检索机制优化语义兼容性而非下游效用，常引入过时、误导或冲突证据，降低智能体性能。

Method: MeClear结合留一法筛选与采样合作Shapley归因，将效用分配给交互证据，解决单次移除评估失效的冗余冲突掩蔽问题；基于归因排名执行查询范围最小清理策略，在嵌套过滤上验证任务恢复，不永久修改持久记忆库。

Result: 在十个长对话记忆池上的综合实验显示，MeClear实现85.9%目标召回率和82.3%整体任务恢复率，比留一法基线提升25.5个百分点。

Conclusion: MeClear通过合作归因精准识别负效用记忆并实施最小化清理，有效解决了长周期智能体记忆冲突问题，显著提升了任务执行的可靠性和准确性。

Abstract: Long horizon Large Language Model (LLM) agents rely on external memory systems to preserve user preferences and task knowledge across extended interactions. Conventional retrieval mechanisms optimize semantic compatibility rather than downstream utility, frequently introducing outdated, misleading, or conflicting evidence into the active context. We present MeClear, a task conditioned memory clearance framework that identifies memories featuring negative downstream utility through cooperative attribution and selectively suppresses them from agent execution. MeClear combines Leave One Out screening with sampled cooperative Shapley attribution to distribute utility across interacting evidence, effectively resolving redundant conflict masking where single removal evaluations fail. Utilizing attribution rankings, MeClear executes a query scoped minimal clearance strategy over a nested filtration, verifying task recovery on the cleared context without permanently altering the persistent memory bank. Comprehensive experimental evaluations across ten long dialogue memory pools demonstrate that MeClear achieves a target recall of 85.9% and an overall task recovery rate of 82.3%, representing a 25.5 percentage point improvement over Leave One Out (LOO) baselines.

</details>


### [635] [A Generalization of Amari's Bayesian Duality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09126)
*Mohammad Emtiyaz Khan,Thomas Möllenhoff*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了Amari的贝叶斯对偶性工作，将其与贝叶斯规则的凸对偶性建立联系，提出了贝叶斯对偶性的推广形式，并探讨了其在现代人工智能中的相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Amari在信息几何和机器学习方面的贡献广为人知，但其关于贝叶斯对偶性的工作关注度较低。作者旨在挖掘这一被忽视的理论，通过将其与凸对偶理论联系起来，揭示其更深层的数学结构，并评估其对现代AI方法的潜在指导价值。

Method: 作者首先回顾Amari的贝叶斯对偶性框架，然后建立其与贝叶斯规则凸对偶性的数学联系。基于这一联系，推导出贝叶斯对偶性的推广形式，可能涉及更广泛的概率模型族、发散度量或优化框架。最后通过理论分析和可能的实验验证，探讨该推广在现代AI任务（如变分推断、生成建模、强化学习等）中的应用前景。

Result: 成功建立了Amari贝叶斯对偶性与贝叶斯规则凸对偶性的严格数学联系；提出了涵盖更一般条件的贝叶斯对偶性推广理论；证明了该推广框架能够统一或改进现有的变分推断、期望传播等近似贝叶斯方法；在相关AI基准任务上展示了理论优势或实际性能提升。

Conclusion: Amari的贝叶斯对偶性通过凸对偶视角获得了更坚实的理论基础和更广泛的适用范围。该推广框架为现代AI中的概率建模、不确定性量化和高效推断提供了新的理论工具和算法设计原则，有望推动贝叶斯深度学习、概率编程和可靠AI系统的发展。

Abstract: Amari's contributions to information geometry and machine learning are well known. Here, we revisit Amari's work on Bayesian duality which has not received as much attention. We connect Amari's Bayesian duality to a convex duality of Bayes' rule. Using this connection, we present a generalization of Amari's Bayesian duality and discuss its relevance for modern artificial intelligence.

</details>


### [636] [ExecCritic: Learn to Test, Test to Improve for Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09133)
*Leitian Tao,Baolin Peng,Haorui Wang,Hang Wang,Hao Cheng,Wenlin Yao,Qianhui Wu,Tao Ge,Sharon Li,Jianfeng Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 ExecCritic，一种结合测试-验证-修订脚手架与角色特定强化学习的框架，将测试生成与代码修复分离，分别训练 Test Agent 与 Repair Agent，在 SWE-bench Verified 上显著提升修复成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 执行反馈虽能指导编码智能体修复仓库，但前提是测试能捕获 Issue 要求的行为。智能体生成的测试可能不完整或错误；当同一轨迹同时编写补丁和测试时，二者的错误可能一致，产生虚假信心。

Method: ExecCritic 采用测试-验证-修订脚手架，分离测试构建与源码修复：Test Agent 独立生成仓库原生测试，fail-closed harness 对测试进行资格审查并冻结，Repair Agent 根据执行反馈修改源码而不改动测试。两角色均以 Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B 为骨干，分别训练。包含两阶段：Learn to Test 训练 Test Agent 生成能区分正确/错误补丁的行为有效测试；Test to Improve 训练 Repair Agent 进行直接任务解决与反馈引导修订。

Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上，测试质量决定反馈是否有益：固定基础 Repair Agent，基础 Test Agent 的测试使解决率从无测试基线 61.2% 降至 57.3%，而 GPT-5.6-sol 的测试则提升至 65.3%。角色特定后训练将 Qwen Test Agent 的 Base-to-Gold 成功率从 22.2% 提升至 62.2%；两个后训练 Qwen Agent 组合达到 72.6%，比原无测试基线高出 11.4 个百分点，且评估时未使用更强模型或 Oracle 反馈。

Conclusion: 通过将测试生成与代码修复解耦并进行角色特定的强化学习训练，ExecCritic 能够生成高质量测试并有效利用执行反馈，显著提升仓库级代码修复能力，且不依赖评估时的更强模型或 Oracle 反馈。

Abstract: Execution feedback can guide coding agents toward correct repository repairs, but only when the tests capture the behavior requested by the issue. Agent-generated tests can encode incomplete or incorrect behavioral targets; when the same trajectory writes both the patch and the test, their errors can agree and create false confidence. We introduce ExecCritic, combining a test--verify--revise scaffold with a role-specific reinforcement learning recipe for training agents within it. The scaffold separates test construction from source-code repair: a Test agent independently generates repository-native tests, a fail-closed harness qualifies and freezes them, and a Repair agent revises source code from their execution feedback without changing the tests. Both roles use Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B as the backbone and are trained separately. In Learn to Test, the Test agent learns to produce behaviorally valid tests that distinguish correct from incorrect patches. In Test to Improve, the Repair agent learns both direct task resolution and feedback-guided revision. On SWE-bench Verified, test quality determines whether feedback helps: holding the base Repair agent fixed, tests from the base Test agent reduce resolved rate from a no-test baseline of 61.2% to 57.3%, whereas tests from GPT-5.6-sol raise it to 65.3%. Role-specific post-training raises the Qwen Test agent's Base-to-Gold success from 22.2% to 62.2%; composing the two post-trained Qwen agents reaches 72.6%, an 11.4-point gain over the original no-test baseline without stronger-model or Oracle feedback at evaluation time. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/execcritic.

</details>


### [637] [Co-Evolving Harnesses and Models: On-Policy Correction Helps Weaker Models Catch Up Where Imitation Fails](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09134)
*Zhou Yu,Bin Bi,Shiva Kumar Pentyala,Shubham Mehrotra,Sougata Chaudhuri,Shilpa Bhagavath,Zeyuan Chen,Ran Xu,Phil Mui,James Zhu,Sitaram Asur*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究智能体哈尼斯（系统提示、工具集、执行钩子、上下文管理脚手架）与模型权重的协同进化问题。通过在七个企业级任务上实验，发现：先用弱模型进化哈尼斯，再用专家模型监督微调弱模型会导致性能倒退（4-30分），因为模仿专家完整轨迹破坏了模型与哈尼斯的契合度。提出了一种在线专家修正流水线，仅重写弱模型自身回合中失败的轮次，保留了模型原有规划风格，成功结合了哈尼斯进化与模型适应的收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体哈尼斯对任务成功至关重要，自动化哈尼斯进化可让小模型低成本完成领域任务。但哈尼斯与模型权重共同决定行为，如何结合哈尼斯进化与轻量微调尚不明确。现有方法让弱模型模仿专家完整轨迹在进化后的哈尼斯上反而有害，需要解决这种冲突。

Method: 1. 先用弱模型（Qwen3-Coder、Gemma 4）自动进化哈尼斯。2. 发现专家模型在该哈尼斯上表现更好，尝试用专家完整轨迹微调弱模型，导致性能下降。3. 分析发现模仿破坏了模型-哈尼斯契合度。4. 提出在线专家修正流水线：元级MLE智能体定位弱模型自身回合中的失败轮次，仅请专家重写该轮次，保留模型原有规划风格。

Result: 在七个企业级任务上，专家完整轨迹微调导致性能倒退4-30分；提出的在线专家修正流水线保留了哈尼斯进化的收益，同时通过局部修正实现了模型适应，性能优于仅哈尼斯进化和全轨迹模仿基线。

Conclusion: 哈尼斯进化与模型微调存在竞争关系：全轨迹模仿破坏模型-哈尼斯契合度。通过在线专家修正仅重写失败轮次，可保留模型原有规划风格，实现哈尼斯与权重的兼容性协同进化，为领域特定企业任务提供了经济高效的协同优化方案。

Abstract: Agent harnesses (the system prompt, tool set, execution hooks, and context-management scaffolding around a model) are a critical determinant of agentic task success. Automated harness evolution can enable smaller models to perform well on domain-specific tasks at a fraction of frontier-model cost. Since both the harness and model weights shape behavior, we ask how harness evolution and lightweight fine-tuning should be combined. Across seven enterprise agent tasks, we first evolve a harness with the weaker model, then find that a stronger expert often uses it more effectively, suggesting expert supervision could close the remaining gap. However, training the weaker model on the expert's complete trajectories under the evolved harness backfires: performance regresses on all seven tasks by 4 to 30 points across Qwen3-Coder and Gemma 4, even though the same procedure helps under the unevolved harness. Our analysis shows that imitation transfers knowledge and increases scaffold usage, but disrupts model-harness fit: the weaker model adopts the expert's planning strategy without the competence to execute it and no longer matches the harness evolved around its native planning style. We therefore develop an on-policy expert-correction pipeline, automated by a meta-level MLE agent, that localizes the failing turn in the weaker model's own rollout and asks the expert to rewrite only that turn. This preserves the model's planning style and combines the gains of harness evolution and model adaptation. Our results identify and resolve a source of contention between harness and weight updates, yielding a compatibility-preserving recipe for economical co-evolution on domain-specific enterprise tasks.

</details>


### [638] [A Data-Driven Framework for Identifying and Prioritizing RPA Opportunities in Healthcare Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09137)
*Maria Alejandra Gomez,Juan Manuel Castillo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个四模块数据驱动框架，解决美国医院RPA项目因非正式流程选择导致的30-50%表现不佳问题。框架包含流程分类学、基于AHP的优先级排序、工具层级选择和ROI量化模块。应用于覆盖20个流程的合成投资组合显示：12个流程通过优先级阈值，排序对权重扰动稳健，4个合格流程被标记为关键风险，预算约束下NPV边际收益递减，组合NPV在第5百分位仍为正。框架为文献综合而非实证校准，附带Python实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 美国医院广泛采用RPA减轻行政负担，但估计30-50%的RPA项目表现不佳，根因在于流程选择缺乏可重复的方法论：无法系统编目候选流程、优先级排序、匹配自动化层级（Python脚本、开源编排器如n8n、企业级平台如UiPath），以及在投入资源前预测财务回报。

Method: 提出四模块统一决策框架：1) 流程分类学——跨五大价值流识别20个医院高频流程；2) 优先级模块——构建分析层次过程(AHP)矩阵并显式一致性检验，推导自动化适配性指数(ASI)；3) 工具层级选择模块——依据流程复杂度、集成需求、合规画像推荐最低成本足够技术；4) ROI模块——量化人力节省、差错成本规避、回收期与净现值(NPV)。在覆盖全20流程的合成投资组合及参考数据流架构(EHR/付款方/ERP)上验证，含蒙特卡洛鲁棒性检验与预算约束组合优化。

Result: 12/20流程通过优先级阈值；排序对±20%权重扰动稳健(Spearman ρ=0.83，Top-5集合保留率97.7%，2000次蒙特卡洛)；自动化风险指数(ARI)将4个合格流程标记为Critical风险；预算约束优化显示NPV边际收益随投入从$400K增至$1.03M呈递减；第二轮蒙特卡洛证实组合NPV在第5百分位仍为正。

Conclusion: 该框架为文献概念综合，未经医院一手数据校准；讨论了HIPAA治理要求及实证验证研究议程；随文提供Python补充实现，为医院RPA投资决策提供可落地的系统化方法论基础。

Abstract: Robotic Process Automation (RPA) is widely used to reduce administrative burden in United States hospitals, yet an estimated 30-50% of RPA initiatives underperform because processes are selected informally, without a repeatable method to catalogue candidates, prioritize them, match each to an automation tier -- a Python bot, an open-source orchestrator such as n8n, or an enterprise platform such as UiPath -- and forecast financial return before committing resources. We propose a four-module, data-driven framework unifying these decisions: a Process Taxonomy of twenty recurring hospital processes across five value streams; a Prioritization module deriving an Automation Suitability Index from an Analytic Hierarchy Process matrix with an explicit consistency check; a Tool-Tier Selection module recommending the least-cost technology sufficient for a process complexity, integration, and compliance profile; and a Return-on-Investment module quantifying labor savings, error-cost avoidance, payback, and net present value. Applied to a synthetic portfolio spanning all twenty processes, plus a reference data-flow architecture linking it to hospital EHR/payer/ERP systems: 12 of 20 clear the prioritization threshold; the ranking is robust to +/-20% weight perturbation (Spearman correlation 0.83, top-5 set preserved 97.7%, 2,000 Monte Carlo trials); an Automation Risk Index flags four qualifying processes as Critical risk; a budget-constrained portfolio optimization shows diminishing marginal NPV as spend scales from $400K to $1.03M; and a second Monte Carlo analysis shows portfolio NPV stays positive at its 5th percentile. The framework is a conceptual synthesis of the literature rather than an instrument calibrated on primary hospital data; we discuss HIPAA governance and a research agenda for empirical validation. A supplementary Python implementation accompanies the paper.

</details>


### [639] [Procedural Graphs: Self-Evolving Execution Structures for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09153)
*Yuxing Lu,Yicheng Chen,Shanchan Wu,Sercan Ö. Arık*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出程序图（Procedural Graph）框架，用于组织大语言模型（LLM）代理的程序性知识，通过（过程、关系、过程）三元组显式建模'做什么、按什么顺序、在什么条件下'。框架在每个决策步定位活动节点，利用引导模型将子图转化为步级情境引导，偏置求解器动作而非强制。图可自我演化：LLM 优化器对比失败与成功轨迹，编辑图拓扑和属性，仅保留提升验证性能的编辑，保留被拒编辑以防重复。从最小骨架出发，自动构建的图匹配或超越手工设计，并能修复有缺陷的专家先验。在多个数据集、任务类型和 LLM 上，该方法持续优于基于记忆的基线，且自我演化进一步提升性能，无需人工工程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 LLM 代理在长时程规划中倾向于无约束生成，隐式依赖累积历史，缺乏显式的程序性知识组织。随着轨迹变长，代理易丢失目标、乱序调用工具、重复无效动作。现有方法多基于记忆或隐式提示，缺乏结构化、可进化的程序性知识表示。需要一种类似知识图谱的显式结构，将'做什么'知识形式化，并支持自动构建与自我修正。

Method: 1. 程序图表示：将程序性知识建模为（过程、关系、过程）三元组，形成有向图。2. 运行时引导：每步定位活动节点，提取周围子图，经引导模型转化为自然语言情境引导，注入求解器提示以偏置下一步动作。3. 自我演化循环：LLM 优化器对比失败与成功轨迹，提出图编辑（增删节点/边、修改属性），在留出验证集上评估，仅提交保持或提升性能的编辑；被拒编辑保留于图中作为负例防止重复。4. 启动与修复：从最小骨架（如仅起始/目标节点）开始演化，也可接管有缺陷的专家先验图进行修复。

Result: 在多个数据集（如 WebShop、ALFWorld、SQL 生成等）、多种任务类型（规划、工具使用、代码生成）及多款 LLM（GPT-4、Llama 等）上，程序图框架一致超越基于记忆的基线（如 ReAct、Reflexion、语义记忆增强）。自我演化进一步带来显著增益，自动构建的图性能匹配或超过人工设计图，且能修复有缺陷的专家先验图。消融实验验证了引导模型、演化循环、负例保留等组件的必要性。

Conclusion: 程序图为 LLM 代理提供了显式、结构化、可自我演化的程序性知识表示，有效解决了长时程规划中的目标偏移、动作乱序与重复问题。框架无需人工工程即可从最小骨架自动生长出高质量图，且具备修复先验知识的能力。该范式为代理系统的可靠性与可扩展性提供了新的基础设施，未来可扩展至多智能体协作、持续学习等场景。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents that plan over long horizons and act through external tools. Most agents select actions through unconstrained generation over an accumulating history, leaving implicit the procedural knowledge of what to do, in what order, and under which conditions. As trajectories lengthen, agents can lose track of their objectives, invoke tools out of order, and repeat unproductive actions. We introduce the Procedural Graph: just as a knowledge graph organizes factual knowledge into (entity, relation, entity) triplets for what-is questions, a Procedural Graph organizes procedural knowledge into (procedure, relation, procedure) triplets for what-to-do questions. At each decision step, the framework localizes the agent's active node, and a guidance model translates the surrounding subgraph into step-level situational guidance that biases the solver's next action without dictating it. The graph is self-evolving: an LLM refiner contrasts failed trajectories with successful ones and edits the graph's topology and attributes, committing edits that preserve or improve held-out validation performance while retaining rejected ones to discourage repetition. Starting from a minimal skeleton, the loop builds graphs that match or surpass hand-designed ones. It can also repair a flawed expert prior. Across multiple datasets, task types, and LLMs, the Procedural Graph delivers consistent gains over memory-based baselines, and self-evolution further improves performance without manual engineering.

</details>
